### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/dct_tables.hpp
```
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

#pragma once

/// @file dct_tables.hpp
/// @brief The two constant tables the 8^3 DCT is defined by: the orthonormal
///        1-D DCT-II basis and the 3-D zigzag coefficient order.
///
/// Internal (under src/, never installed). Built on the host and uploaded once,
/// rather than evaluated in the shader, so every device transforms against the
/// same bits: a GPU `cos()` is only as accurate as its vendor makes it, and the
/// codec's per-device reproducibility (the 2026-09-26 decision) should not
/// depend on that. The tests build their double-precision reference from the
/// same definitions, so the kernel and the oracle cannot disagree about *what*
/// the transform is -- only about how precisely it was computed.

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <tuple>

#include "volumetric_kit/grid/codec/codec_params.hpp"

namespace volumetric_kit::grid::codec::detail {

/// One block edge, unsigned: the length of every line the separable transform
/// runs along.
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kEdge = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(kBlockSize);

/// A voxel's linear index inside a block is `x + kStrideY * y + kStrideZ * z`
/// -- the order the volume tier lays a block's voxels out in
/// (`BlockIndex::ptr + local`).
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kStrideY = kEdge;
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kStrideZ = kEdge * kEdge;
static_assert(kStrideZ * kEdge == kVoxelsPerBlock, "a block is kEdge^3");

/// Entries in the 1-D DCT matrix, `kEdge x kEdge`.
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kBasisSize = kEdge * kEdge;

/// @return The linear index of voxel `(x, y, z)` inside a block.
constexpr std::uint32_t voxel_index(std::uint32_t x, std::uint32_t y,
                                    std::uint32_t z) {
  return x + y * kStrideY + z * kStrideZ;
}

/// @brief The orthonormal 1-D DCT-II matrix, row-major `basis[k * kEdge + n]`.
///
/// With `N = kEdge`, `basis[k][n] = a(k) * cos(pi * k * (2n + 1) / (2N))`,
/// `a(0) = sqrt(1/N)` and `a(k) = sqrt(2/N)`. Orthonormal, so the forward
/// transform is `X[k] = sum_n basis[k][n] * x[n]`, the inverse is its
/// transpose, and the 3-D transform is this applied along x, then y, then z.
/// Evaluated in double.
/// @tparam T  `double` for the tests' reference, `float` for the upload.
template <typename T>
std::array<T, kBasisSize> dct_basis() {
  constexpr double kPi = 3.14159265358979323846;
  constexpr double n_points = kEdge;
  std::array<T, kBasisSize> basis{};
  for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < kEdge; ++k) {
    const double alpha =
        k == 0 ? std::sqrt(1.0 / n_points) : std::sqrt(2.0 / n_points);
    for (std::uint32_t n = 0; n < kEdge; ++n) {
      basis[k * kEdge + n] = static_cast<T>(
          alpha * std::cos(kPi * k * (2.0 * n + 1.0) / (2.0 * n_points)));
    }
  }
  return basis;
}

/// @brief The 3-D zigzag order: `order[j]` is the voxel index (see
///        @ref voxel_index) of the `j`-th coefficient kept.
///
/// Sorted by total frequency `x + y + z`, ties broken lexicographically by
/// `(x, y, z)`. That rule reproduces the prior engine's hand-written 512-entry
/// table exactly (checked when it was ported), and is written as a rule so the
/// order is reviewable rather than a wall of literals.
inline std::array<std::uint32_t, kVoxelsPerBlock> zigzag_order() {
  std::array<std::tuple<std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t>,
             kVoxelsPerBlock>
      cells{};
  std::size_t i = 0;
  for (std::uint32_t x = 0; x < kEdge; ++x) {
    for (std::uint32_t y = 0; y < kEdge; ++y) {
      for (std::uint32_t z = 0; z < kEdge; ++z) {
        cells[i++] = {x, y, z};
      }
    }
  }
  std::sort(cells.begin(), cells.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
    const auto [ax, ay, az] = a;
    const auto [bx, by, bz] = b;
    return std::make_tuple(ax + ay + az, ax, ay, az) <
           std::make_tuple(bx + by + bz, bx, by, bz);
  });
  std::array<std::uint32_t, kVoxelsPerBlock> order{};
  for (std::size_t j = 0; j < cells.size(); ++j) {
    const auto [x, y, z] = cells[j];
    order[j] = voxel_index(x, y, z);
  }
  return order;
}

}  // namespace volumetric_kit::grid::codec::detail
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/dct_transform.cpp
```
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

#include "dct_transform.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <utility>

#include "dct_tables.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/core/vulkan/command_batch.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/core/vulkan/compute_util.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/core/vulkan/device.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/base/device_requirements.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/base/dispatch.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/volume/hash_map_internal.hpp"

// Embedded SPIR-V (generated by vgrid_embed_shaders onto a PRIVATE include
// path).
#include "dct_forward_comp.spv.hpp"
#include "dct_inverse_comp.spv.hpp"
#include "dct_observed_comp.spv.hpp"
#include "dct_surface_comp.spv.hpp"

namespace volumetric_kit::grid::codec::detail {
namespace {

// Mirrors `PushConstants` in dct_common.glsl. All 4-byte scalars, so scalar
// layout puts each at its host offset; a drift is a compile error here, not a
// kernel reading one field as another.
struct PushConstants {
  std::uint32_t item_base;  // the first list entry a dispatch covers
  std::uint32_t num_blocks;
  std::uint32_t coefficient_count;
  float trunc_dist;
  float observed_weight;
  float decoded_weight;
  std::int32_t num_buckets;
  std::int32_t bucket_size;
  std::int32_t max_chain;
  std::int32_t max_quantized;
  std::uint32_t tick;  // the map's tick, which the inverse stamps blocks with
  std::uint32_t true_sdf;
  std::uint32_t surface_pass;
  float cut_distance;
  float near_distance;
};
static_assert(sizeof(PushConstants) == 60, "PushConstants must be 60 bytes");
static_assert(offsetof(PushConstants, item_base) == 0, "layout drift");
static_assert(offsetof(PushConstants, num_blocks) == 4, "layout drift");
static_assert(offsetof(PushConstants, coefficient_count) == 8, "layout drift");
static_assert(offsetof(PushConstants, trunc_dist) == 12, "layout drift");
static_assert(offsetof(PushConstants, observed_weight) == 16, "layout drift");
static_assert(offsetof(PushConstants, decoded_weight) == 20, "layout drift");
static_assert(offsetof(PushConstants, num_buckets) == 24, "layout drift");
static_assert(offsetof(PushConstants, bucket_size) == 28, "layout drift");
static_assert(offsetof(PushConstants, max_chain) == 32, "layout drift");
static_assert(offsetof(PushConstants, max_quantized) == 36, "layout drift");
static_assert(offsetof(PushConstants, tick) == 40, "layout drift");
static_assert(offsetof(PushConstants, true_sdf) == 44, "layout drift");
static_assert(offsetof(PushConstants, surface_pass) == 48, "layout drift");
static_assert(offsetof(PushConstants, cut_distance) == 52, "layout drift");
static_assert(offsetof(PushConstants, near_distance) == 56, "layout drift");

// The kernels' lane-to-line mapping is written for this edge (kEdge in
// dct_common.glsl), which is why a grid with another block size is refused.
static_assert(kBlockSize == 8, "dct_common.glsl's kEdge is 8");

// Mirrors the `Tables` buffer in dct_common.glsl.
struct Tables {
  float basis[kBasisSize];
  std::uint32_t zigzag[kVoxelsPerBlock];
};
static_assert(sizeof(Tables) == kBasisSize * sizeof(float) +
                                    kVoxelsPerBlock * sizeof(std::uint32_t),
              "Tables layout drift");

// Mirrors the counter buffer in dct_common.glsl. Only the observed pass uses
// the second word; the transform directions read back the first alone.
struct Counts {
  std::uint32_t rejected = 0;
  std::uint32_t observed = 0;
};
static_assert(sizeof(Counts) == 8, "Counts layout drift");
static_assert(offsetof(Counts, observed) == 4, "Counts layout drift");

// The set-0 bindings of both kernels, mirroring the VGRID_DCT_BINDING_* defines
// in dct_common.glsl -- the compute core is explicit, not reflected
// (2026-07-05).
enum Binding : std::uint32_t {
  kBindingBlocks = 0,
  kBindingTsdf = 1,
  kBindingWeight = 2,
  kBindingTables = 3,
  kBindingCoefficients = 4,
  kBindingMasks = 5,
  kBindingEntries = 6,
  kBindingRejected = 7,
  kBindingStamps = 8,
  kBindingQuantization = 9,
  kBindingCut = 10,
  kBindingKeep = 11,
  kBindingCount = 12,
};

// The cut set's bytes for a grid of @p slots block slots: a bit a voxel.
VkDeviceSize cut_bytes(std::int32_t slots) {
  return VkDeviceSize(slots) * kMaskWordsPerBlock * sizeof(std::uint32_t);
}

// How far from zero a corner of a sign-change cell is cut, in metres: past
// sqrt(3) voxels, no crossing of a distance field has a corner, and the
// 1e-6 m margin keeps float rounding of a true one from reaching it. One
// fused multiply-add, so every host computes the same float.
float cut_distance(float voxel_size) {
  return std::fma(std::sqrt(3.0f), voxel_size, 1e-6f);
}

core::Status fail(const char* op, const std::string& why) {
  return core::Status::invalid_argument(std::string("DctTransform::") + op +
                                        ": " + why);
}

// The int16 an entry takes on the device (coefficient_words).
std::size_t padded_count(std::uint32_t k) {
  return std::size_t(coefficient_words(k)) * 2;
}

}  // namespace

core::Result<std::unique_ptr<DctTransform>> DctTransform::create(
    core::Device& device, core::Allocator& allocator) {
  VKC_TRY(check_device_requirements(device, "DctTransform::create"));
  std::unique_ptr<DctTransform> owned(new DctTransform());
  DctTransform& t = *owned;
  t.device_ = &device;
  t.allocator_ = &allocator;

  VkPushConstantRange push_range{};
  push_range.stageFlags = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT;
  push_range.offset = 0;
  push_range.size = sizeof(PushConstants);
  core::KernelSetBuilder kb(device);
  VKC_TRY(kb.add(t.forward_kernel_, "codec_dct_forward",
                 vgrid_dct_forward_comp_spv, vgrid_dct_forward_comp_spv_size,
                 kBindingCount, &push_range));
  VKC_TRY(kb.add(t.inverse_kernel_, "codec_dct_inverse",
                 vgrid_dct_inverse_comp_spv, vgrid_dct_inverse_comp_spv_size,
                 kBindingCount, &push_range));
  VKC_TRY(kb.add(t.observed_kernel_, "codec_dct_observed",
                 vgrid_dct_observed_comp_spv, vgrid_dct_observed_comp_spv_size,
                 kBindingCount, &push_range));
  VKC_TRY(kb.add(t.surface_kernel_, "codec_dct_surface",
                 vgrid_dct_surface_comp_spv, vgrid_dct_surface_comp_spv_size,
                 kBindingCount, &push_range));
  VKC_TRY(volumetric_kit::grid::detail::add_dispatch_args(
      kb, t.observed_args_kernel_, "codec_dct_observed_args"));
  VKC_TRY(volumetric_kit::grid::detail::add_dispatch_args(
      kb, t.forward_args_kernel_, "codec_dct_forward_args"));
  VKC_ASSIGN(t.pool_, kb.build());

  VkPhysicalDeviceProperties props{};
  vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(device.physical_device(), &props);
  t.max_workgroup_count_x_ = props.limits.maxComputeWorkGroupCount[0];
  t.max_storage_buffer_range_ = props.limits.maxStorageBufferRange;

  // The tables are the same for every call, so they are uploaded once and
  // bound once.
  Tables tables{};
  const std::array<float, kBasisSize> basis = dct_basis<float>();
  const std::array<std::uint32_t, kVoxelsPerBlock> zigzag = zigzag_order();
  std::copy(basis.begin(), basis.end(), tables.basis);
  std::copy(zigzag.begin(), zigzag.end(), tables.zigzag);
  VKC_ASSIGN(t.tables_, core::device_storage_buffer(allocator, sizeof(tables)));
  VKC_ASSIGN(t.rejected_,
             core::device_storage_buffer(allocator, sizeof(Counts)));
  VKC_ASSIGN(t.observed_counts_,
             core::device_storage_buffer(allocator, sizeof(Counts)));
  VKC_ASSIGN(
      t.quantization_steps_,
      core::device_storage_buffer(allocator, kVoxelsPerBlock * sizeof(float)));
  // Real buffers from the start, so every call's bindings name one; the true
  // SDF passes grow them to the grid's heap.
  VKC_ASSIGN(t.cut_, core::device_storage_buffer(allocator, cut_bytes(1)));
  VKC_ASSIGN(t.keep_,
             core::device_storage_buffer(allocator, sizeof(std::uint32_t)));
  core::CommandBatch batch(device, allocator);
  VKC_TRY(batch.upload(t.tables_, 0, &tables, sizeof(tables)));
  VKC_TRY(batch.submit());
  device.set_object_name(VK_OBJECT_TYPE_BUFFER,
                         core::debug_object_handle(t.tables_.handle()),
                         "codec.dct_tables");
  device.set_object_name(VK_OBJECT_TYPE_BUFFER,
                         core::debug_object_handle(t.rejected_.handle()),
                         "codec.rejected");
  device.set_object_name(VK_OBJECT_TYPE_BUFFER,
                         core::debug_object_handle(t.observed_counts_.handle()),
                         "codec.observed_counts");
  device.set_object_name(
      VK_OBJECT_TYPE_BUFFER,
      core::debug_object_handle(t.quantization_steps_.handle()),
      "codec.quantization_steps");
  device.set_object_name(VK_OBJECT_TYPE_BUFFER,
                         core::debug_object_handle(t.cut_.handle()),
                         "codec.cut_set");
  device.set_object_name(VK_OBJECT_TYPE_BUFFER,
                         core::debug_object_handle(t.keep_.handle()),
                         "codec.keep_flags");
  // The observed pass and the true SDF passes before it count into their
  // own words, which the forward's zeroing of its own leaves for the batch's
  // later commands.
  for (core::ComputeKernel* kernel :
       {&t.forward_kernel_, &t.inverse_kernel_, &t.observed_kernel_,
        &t.surface_kernel_}) {
    const bool observes =
        kernel == &t.observed_kernel_ || kernel == &t.surface_kernel_;
    kernel->set.write_storage_buffer(kBindingTables, t.tables_.handle(), 0,
                                     VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    kernel->set.write_storage_buffer(
        kBindingQuantization, t.quantization_steps_.handle(), 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    kernel->set.write_storage_buffer(
        kBindingRejected,
        observes ? t.observed_counts_.handle() : t.rejected_.handle(), 0,
        VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  }
  return owned;
}

core::Result<DctTransform::GridViews> DctTransform::check_inputs(
    const char* op, const volume::VoxelBlockGrid& grid,
    const CodecParams& params) const {
  VKC_TRY(params.validate());
  if (!grid.valid()) {
    return fail(op, "moved-from grid");
  }
  const volume::VoxelGridParams& gp = grid.grid();
  if (gp.block_size != kBlockSize) {
    return fail(op, "the codec transforms blocks of edge " +
                        std::to_string(kBlockSize) +
                        " only, and this grid's block_size is " +
                        std::to_string(gp.block_size));
  }
  if (!std::isfinite(gp.trunc_dist) || !(gp.trunc_dist > 0.0f)) {
    return fail(op, "the grid's trunc_dist must be finite and positive");
  }
  GridViews views;
  VKC_ASSIGN(views.tsdf, grid.attribute(volume::kTsdfAttribute));
  VKC_ASSIGN(views.weight, grid.attribute(volume::kWeightAttribute));
  if (views.tsdf.element_size != sizeof(float) ||
      views.weight.element_size != sizeof(float)) {
    return fail(op, "the grid's tsdf and weight must be 4-byte floats");
  }
  return views;
}

core::Status DctTransform::record(
    core::CommandBatch& batch, core::ComputeKernel& kernel,
    const volume::VoxelBlockGrid& grid, const GridViews& views, VkBuffer list,
    std::uint32_t count, const CodecParams& params, VkBuffer coefficients,
    VkBuffer masks, VkDeviceSize masks_bytes, const TrueSdf& true_sdf,
    const volumetric_kit::grid::detail::IndirectSlices* slices,
    const core::Buffer& counts, core::GpuStageScope* stage) {
  // Another tier sized this one (and every resize doubles it), so it is bound
  // at its real size and range-checked, as the mesher binds it.
  const VkDeviceSize entries_bytes =
      volume::VoxelHashMap::Internal::entries_buffer_size(grid.map());
  VKC_TRY(core::check_storage_buffer_range("DctTransform: the hash entries",
                                           entries_bytes,
                                           max_storage_buffer_range_));
  kernel.set.write_storage_buffer(
      kBindingBlocks, list, 0,
      VkDeviceSize(count) * sizeof(volume::BlockIndex));
  kernel.set.write_storage_buffer(kBindingTsdf, views.tsdf.buffer->handle(), 0,
                                  VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  kernel.set.write_storage_buffer(kBindingWeight, views.weight.buffer->handle(),
                                  0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  if (coefficients != VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
    const VkDeviceSize coeff_bytes = VkDeviceSize(count) *
                                     padded_count(params.coefficient_count) *
                                     sizeof(std::int16_t);
    kernel.set.write_storage_buffer(kBindingCoefficients, coefficients, 0,
                                    coeff_bytes);
  }
  if (masks != VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
    kernel.set.write_storage_buffer(kBindingMasks, masks, 0, masks_bytes);
  }
  kernel.set.write_storage_buffer(
      kBindingEntries,
      volume::VoxelHashMap::Internal::entries_buffer(grid.map()), 0,
      entries_bytes);
  kernel.set.write_storage_buffer(
      kBindingStamps, grid.map().stamps_buffer().handle(), 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  // On every call, as the grid's are: the true SDF passes regrow both with
  // the grid's heap, which frees the buffers an earlier call bound.
  const core::Buffer& cut = true_sdf.cut != nullptr ? *true_sdf.cut : cut_;
  kernel.set.write_storage_buffer(kBindingCut, cut.handle(), 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  kernel.set.write_storage_buffer(kBindingKeep, keep_.handle(), 0,
                                  VK_WHOLE_SIZE);

  const volume::VoxelGridParams& gp = grid.grid();
  PushConstants push{};
  push.num_blocks = count;
  push.coefficient_count = params.coefficient_count;
  push.trunc_dist = gp.trunc_dist;
  push.observed_weight = volume::kObservedWeight;
  push.decoded_weight = kDecodedWeight;
  push.num_buckets = gp.num_buckets;
  push.bucket_size = gp.bucket_size;
  push.max_chain = gp.max_chain;
  push.max_quantized = kMaxQuantizedMagnitude;
  push.tick = grid.map().tick();
  push.true_sdf = true_sdf.on ? 1u : 0u;
  push.cut_distance = cut_distance(gp.voxel_size);
  push.near_distance = gp.voxel_size;
  VKC_TRY(batch.fill(counts, 0, sizeof(Counts), 0u));
  // A workgroup a block. Room0 alone (~107 k blocks) passes the 65535 groups
  // Vulkan guarantees, so a longer list takes several dispatches, which touch
  // disjoint list entries; the batch barriers every dispatch, so a pass sees
  // all of the last one's. Sized on the device, the slices hold the count's
  // groups alone.
  for (std::uint32_t pass = 0; pass < true_sdf.passes; ++pass) {
    push.surface_pass = pass;
    VKC_TRY(slices != nullptr ? volumetric_kit::grid::detail::dispatch_slices(
                                    batch, kernel, push, *slices, stage)
                              : volumetric_kit::grid::detail::dispatch_items(
                                    batch, kernel, push, count, 1,
                                    max_workgroup_count_x_, stage));
  }
  return {};
}

core::Status DctTransform::record_steps(core::CommandBatch& batch,
                                        const CodecParams& params) {
  // The same float products validate() checked.
  std::array<float, kVoxelsPerBlock> steps{};
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < steps.size(); ++i) {
    steps[i] = params.quantization_scale * params.quantization_weights[i];
  }
  return batch.upload(quantization_steps_, 0, steps.data(), sizeof(steps));
}

core::Status DctTransform::check_rejected(const char* op,
                                          std::uint32_t rejected,
                                          std::uint32_t count) {
  if (rejected != 0) {
    return fail(op, std::to_string(rejected) + " of " + std::to_string(count) +
                        " block list entries name no block of this grid (each "
                        "coord must be in its hash table); they were neither "
                        "read nor written");
  }
  return {};
}

core::Status DctTransform::ensure_scratch(core::Buffer& buffer,
                                          VkDeviceSize bytes,
                                          const char* name) {
  return core::ensure_device_scratch(*device_, *allocator_, buffer, bytes,
                                     max_storage_buffer_range_, name);
}

core::Status DctTransform::check_grid(
    const volume::VoxelBlockGrid& grid) const {
  return check_inputs("observed", grid, CodecParams{}).status();
}

core::Status DctTransform::check_count(const char* op,
                                       const volume::VoxelBlockGrid& grid,
                                       const volume::DeviceCount& count) const {
  if (count.buffer == nullptr || !count.buffer->valid() ||
      count.offset % sizeof(std::uint32_t) != 0 ||
      count.buffer->size() < count.offset + sizeof(std::uint32_t)) {
    return fail(op,
                "the count's word is missing, misaligned or past its "
                "buffer");
  }
  if (count.bound > static_cast<std::uint32_t>(grid.grid().num_blocks)) {
    return fail(op, std::to_string(count.bound) +
                        " blocks, more than this grid's block heap (" +
                        std::to_string(grid.grid().num_blocks) + ")");
  }
  return {};
}

core::Status DctTransform::record_observed(core::CommandBatch& batch,
                                           const volume::VoxelBlockGrid& grid,
                                           const core::Buffer& list,
                                           const volume::DeviceCount& count,
                                           bool true_sdf,
                                           core::GpuStageScope* stage) {
  VKC_ASSIGN(GridViews views, check_inputs("observed", grid, CodecParams{}));
  VKC_TRY(check_count("observed", grid, count));
  const std::uint32_t bound = count.bound;
  const VkDeviceSize list_bytes =
      VkDeviceSize(std::max(bound, 1u)) * sizeof(volume::BlockIndex);
  if (bound != 0) {
    VKC_TRY(core::StorageInput(list).check(
        "DctTransform::observed: the block list", list_bytes));
  }
  VKC_TRY(
      ensure_scratch(observed_blocks_, list_bytes, "codec.observed_blocks"));
  observed_bound_ = bound;
  // The count read 0 for a bound of none, which records no pass.
  if (bound == 0) return batch.fill(observed_counts_, 0, sizeof(Counts), 0u);
  // The passes' groups, a block each, from the list's count on the device.
  volumetric_kit::grid::detail::IndirectSlices slices;
  VKC_TRY(volumetric_kit::grid::detail::record_dispatch_args(
      batch, *device_, *allocator_, observed_args_kernel_, observed_slices_,
      "codec.observed_slices",
      volumetric_kit::grid::detail::SlicedCount{count.buffer, count.offset,
                                                bound, 1},
      1, &slices, 0, nullptr, max_workgroup_count_x_, stage));
  if (true_sdf) {
    // Sized to the heap, since a cell's corners are found by slot, and
    // zeroed first: a slot the last grid used may hold another block now.
    const std::int32_t slots = grid.grid().num_blocks;
    const VkDeviceSize keep_bytes = VkDeviceSize(slots) * sizeof(std::uint32_t);
    VKC_TRY(ensure_scratch(cut_, cut_bytes(slots), "codec.cut_set"));
    VKC_TRY(ensure_scratch(keep_, keep_bytes, "codec.keep_flags"));
    VKC_TRY(batch.fill(cut_, 0, cut_bytes(slots), 0u));
    VKC_TRY(batch.fill(keep_, 0, keep_bytes, 0u));
    VKC_TRY(record(batch, surface_kernel_, grid, views, list.handle(), bound,
                   CodecParams{}, VK_NULL_HANDLE, VK_NULL_HANDLE, 0,
                   TrueSdf{true, nullptr, 2}, &slices, observed_counts_,
                   stage));
  }
  return record(batch, observed_kernel_, grid, views, list.handle(), bound,
                CodecParams{}, VK_NULL_HANDLE, observed_blocks_.handle(),
                list_bytes, TrueSdf{true_sdf}, &slices, observed_counts_,
                stage);
}

core::Result<ResidentBlocks> DctTransform::record_forward(
    core::CommandBatch& batch, const volume::VoxelBlockGrid& grid,
    const core::Buffer& list, const volume::DeviceCount& count,
    const CodecParams& params, const core::Buffer& masks,
    const core::Buffer& coefficients, const core::Buffer* cut,
    core::GpuStageScope* stage) {
  VKC_ASSIGN(GridViews views, check_inputs("forward", grid, params));
  VKC_TRY(check_count("forward", grid, count));
  ResidentBlocks out;
  out.coefficient_count = params.coefficient_count;
  if (count.bound == 0) {
    // No entry, so none is rejected.
    VKC_TRY(batch.fill(rejected_, 0, sizeof(Counts), 0u));
    return out;
  }
  // Every entry the bound holds; whether each is a live block is the
  // kernel's to answer (see block_ptr), so the host takes only the O(1) half.
  const std::uint32_t bound = count.bound;
  const VkDeviceSize list_bytes =
      VkDeviceSize(bound) * sizeof(volume::BlockIndex);
  VKC_TRY(core::StorageInput(list).check(
      "DctTransform::forward: the block list", list_bytes));
  VKC_TRY(
      core::check_storage_buffer_range("DctTransform::forward: the block list",
                                       list_bytes, max_storage_buffer_range_));
  const VkDeviceSize coeff_bytes = VkDeviceSize(bound) *
                                   padded_count(params.coefficient_count) *
                                   sizeof(std::int16_t);
  const VkDeviceSize mask_bytes =
      VkDeviceSize(bound) * kMaskWordsPerBlock * sizeof(std::uint32_t);
  if (masks.size() < mask_bytes || coefficients.size() < coeff_bytes) {
    return fail("forward", "the output buffers do not hold " +
                               std::to_string(bound) + " blocks");
  }
  if (cut != nullptr && cut->size() < cut_bytes(grid.grid().num_blocks)) {
    return fail("forward", "the cut set does not cover the grid's " +
                               std::to_string(grid.grid().num_blocks) +
                               " block slots");
  }
  VKC_TRY(core::check_storage_buffer_range(
      "DctTransform::forward: the coefficients", coeff_bytes,
      max_storage_buffer_range_));
  VKC_TRY(core::check_storage_buffer_range("DctTransform::forward: the masks",
                                           mask_bytes,
                                           max_storage_buffer_range_));
  // A group a block, from the count on the device.
  volumetric_kit::grid::detail::IndirectSlices slices;
  VKC_TRY(volumetric_kit::grid::detail::record_dispatch_args(
      batch, *device_, *allocator_, forward_args_kernel_, forward_slices_,
      "codec.forward_slices",
      volumetric_kit::grid::detail::SlicedCount{count.buffer, count.offset,
                                                bound, 1},
      1, &slices, 0, nullptr, max_workgroup_count_x_, stage));
  VKC_TRY(record(batch, forward_kernel_, grid, views, list.handle(), bound,
                 params, coefficients.handle(), masks.handle(), mask_bytes,
                 TrueSdf{cut != nullptr, cut}, &slices, rejected_, stage));
  out.list = &list;
  out.masks = &masks;
  out.coefficients = &coefficients;
  out.count = bound;
  return out;
}

core::Status DctTransform::record_inverse(
    core::CommandBatch& batch, volume::VoxelBlockGrid& grid,
    const ResidentBlocks& in, const CodecParams& params,
    const volumetric_kit::grid::detail::IndirectSlices& slices,
    core::GpuStageScope* stage) {
  VKC_ASSIGN(GridViews views, check_inputs("inverse", grid, params));
  if (in.coefficient_count != params.coefficient_count) {
    return fail("inverse", "the blocks hold " +
                               std::to_string(in.coefficient_count) +
                               " coefficients, and the params " +
                               std::to_string(params.coefficient_count));
  }
  if (in.reference_count != 0) {
    return fail("inverse",
                "the entries are a P-frame's stream positions, not its blocks");
  }
  if (in.count > static_cast<std::uint32_t>(grid.grid().num_blocks)) {
    return fail("inverse", std::to_string(in.count) +
                               " blocks, more than this grid's block heap (" +
                               std::to_string(grid.grid().num_blocks) + ")");
  }
  if (in.count == 0) {
    // No entry, so none is rejected.
    return batch.fill(rejected_, 0, sizeof(Counts), 0u);
  }
  // Bound where they are, so each must hold the entries the kernel reads.
  const VkDeviceSize n = in.count;
  if (in.list == nullptr || in.masks == nullptr || in.coefficients == nullptr ||
      in.list->size() < n * sizeof(volume::BlockIndex) ||
      in.masks->size() < n * kMaskWordsPerBlock * sizeof(std::uint32_t) ||
      in.coefficients->size() <
          n * padded_count(params.coefficient_count) * sizeof(std::int16_t)) {
    return fail("inverse", "the resident buffers do not hold " +
                               std::to_string(in.count) + " blocks");
  }
  // The call is one tick, which every block it changes is stamped with.
  grid.map().advance_tick();
  return record(
      batch, inverse_kernel_, grid, views, in.list->handle(), in.count, params,
      in.coefficients->handle(), in.masks->handle(),
      VkDeviceSize(in.count) * kMaskWordsPerBlock * sizeof(std::uint32_t),
      TrueSdf{}, &slices, rejected_, stage);
}

}  // namespace volumetric_kit::grid::codec::detail
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/dct_transform.hpp
```
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

#pragma once

/// @file dct_transform.hpp
/// @brief The codec's GPU block transform: a grid's blocks to quantized 8^3
///        DCT coefficients plus an observed-voxel mask, and back.
///
/// Internal (under src/, never installed): the `Encoder` and `Decoder` share
/// it, and nothing outside the tier should build a frame from raw coefficients
/// -- that is the transform-only public API the 2026-09-26 decision declined
/// to repeat. It carries `VGRID_CODEC_API` anyway, so the tier's own test links
/// against it in a shared-library build too.

#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>

#include "volumetric_kit/core/base/result.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/core/vulkan/allocator.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/core/vulkan/buffer.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/core/vulkan/compute_kernel.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/core/vulkan/descriptor.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/core/vulkan/fwd.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/core/vulkan/vulkan.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/base/dispatch.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/codec/codec_params.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/codec/export.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/volume/hash_types.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/volume/voxel_block_grid.hpp"

namespace volumetric_kit::grid::codec::detail {

/// The weight the inverse writes on an observed voxel: anything at or above
/// @ref volume::kObservedWeight meshes the same, and a decoded grid is not
/// fused into. Pushed to the kernel, so this is its one definition.
inline constexpr float kDecodedWeight = 1.0f;

/// @brief The words one entry's @p k coefficients take on the device: two
///        int16 a word, each entry starting a word of its own, so an odd K
///        pads each entry by a half-word (`coefficient_words` in
///        dct_common.glsl).
constexpr std::uint32_t coefficient_words(std::uint32_t k) {
  return k / 2 + k % 2;
}

/// @brief Blocks where the device holds them: @ref count entries of masks
///        and coefficients, and their block list, in the layout the kernels
///        write. Borrowed from what produced them -- the transform's
///        @ref DctTransform::record_forward (whose buffers are its caller's),
///        the device frame reader or the reference store -- and valid until
///        that object's next call.
///
/// A P-frame's entries are its stream positions (bitstream.hpp): its
/// @ref reference_count reference entries, each with its mode, then its new
/// blocks, which alone the list holds.
struct ResidentBlocks {
  /// `volume::BlockIndex` entries in frame order, one per block entry:
  /// `count - reference_count`.
  const core::Buffer* list = nullptr;
  const core::Buffer* masks =
      nullptr;  ///< `kMaskWordsPerBlock` words an entry.
  /// Two int16 a word, coefficient 2p low; @ref coefficient_words an entry.
  const core::Buffer* coefficients = nullptr;
  /// A P-frame's mode for each reference entry, a u32 each
  /// (`frame_models.glsl`'s `kMode*`); null without reference entries.
  const core::Buffer* modes = nullptr;
  /// The device frame reader's and the reference store's diff: for each
  /// reference entry e, and at e = M, how many of the entries before it
  /// survive, a u32 each; null elsewhere.
  const core::Buffer* ranks = nullptr;
  std::uint32_t count = 0;
  std::uint32_t coefficient_count = 0;  ///< K.
  /// M, the entries before the blocks: 0 for an intra frame.
  std::uint32_t reference_count = 0;
  /// Set only by @ref ReferenceStore::record_diff: @ref count bounds the
  /// entries at M plus every block of the frame, of which `ranks[M]`
  /// survive and are not new, so the frame's entries are the first
  /// `count - ranks[M]`.
  bool bounded = false;
};

/// @brief The forward and inverse block DCT, as two GLSL compute kernels, a
///        third that finds the blocks to code, and the true SDF passes before
///        it (`EncoderConfig::true_sdf`).
///
/// One workgroup of `kEdge^2` (64) invocations per listed block; each owns one
/// `kEdge`-voxel line per separable pass. The forward kernel reads `weight`,
/// and `tsdf` where the voxel is observed (`weight >=
/// volume::kObservedWeight`), divides that SDF by `trunc_dist` (so its input is
/// in [-1, 1]), and fills each unobserved voxel from the nearest observed one
/// along x, then y, then z (the lower index on a tie), so the transform sees a
/// smooth continuation of the field rather than a step to 0 at the mask edge.
/// It then transforms and keeps the first `coefficient_count` coefficients in
/// 3-D zigzag order, each rounded half-to-even after dividing by its step and
/// clamped to ±@ref kMaxQuantizedMagnitude, and packs the observed bits into
/// the mask.
///
/// The inverse undoes it: dequantizes, zero-fills the dropped coefficients,
/// inverse-transforms, and writes each observed voxel's `tsdf` (clamped back to
/// `±trunc_dist`, the integrator's invariant) with weight
/// @ref kDecodedWeight, and each unobserved voxel as a freshly allocated block
/// holds it -- zero `tsdf`, zero `weight` -- so the mesher uses exactly the
/// voxels the encoder saw observed.
///
/// Output is indexed by **list position**, not by `ptr`: entry `i`'s mask and
/// coefficients are the list's entry `i`'s block. The order the blocks travel
/// in is the caller's (the encoder sorts them on the device, @ref BlockLists).
///
/// Each workgroup first finds its entry's block by its `coord`, through the
/// grid's hash table, and never reads its `ptr`: so no ptr is trusted, and the
/// decoder can list blocks it has just allocated without reading their slots
/// back. A coord the table does not hold is neither read nor written, and the
/// call reports how many there were. That costs one probe per block, where a
/// host scan would be O(count) per call. Like the mesher's probe, it needs the
/// map quiescent: no allocate may run into the grid during a call.
///
/// Every buffer is device-local, and no block list, coefficient or mask
/// leaves the device: the forward reads its list where the caller holds it,
/// is recorded into the caller's batch and writes its output where the
/// caller says (the encoder's reference store, from which the device frame
/// writer codes it), and the inverse reads its input where the reference
/// store's apply wrote it, in the caller's batch too. Nothing is read back:
/// the forward and the inverse leave their reject count on the device for
/// the caller's results (@ref rejected), and the observed filter its count
/// and reject tally (@ref observed_counts), which size the encoder's later
/// passes there.
/// The observed list, the cut set and the keep flags grow when needed and
/// remain allocated for later calls. The coefficients travel two to a word,
/// 16 bits each.
///
/// @warning The `Device` and `Allocator` passed to @ref create must
///          outlive this object; it stores references to them.
class VGRID_CODEC_API DctTransform {
 public:
  /// @brief Build both kernels and upload the basis and zigzag tables.
  /// @param device     The compute device (must outlive this object).
  /// @param allocator  The allocator the scratch buffers come from (must
  ///                   outlive this object).
  /// @return The transform, or a non-OK `Status` if a pipeline, the pool or
  ///         the table upload fails.
  static core::Result<std::unique_ptr<DctTransform>> create(
      core::Device& device, core::Allocator& allocator);

  ~DctTransform() = default;
  DctTransform(const DctTransform&) = delete;
  DctTransform& operator=(const DctTransform&) = delete;

  /// @brief Record the transform and quantization of the first `n` blocks of
  ///        @p list into @p batch, `n` the word @p count names, its output
  ///        into @p masks and @p coefficients by list position.
  ///
  /// The groups are the count's, a block each, sized on the device; every
  /// buffer is bound for the bound. Once @p batch has run, @ref rejected
  /// holds the entries the kernel found no block for, which
  /// @ref check_rejected turns into a refusal.
  /// @param batch         The batch to record into; submitted by the caller.
  ///                      @ref record_steps for @p params must be recorded
  ///                      into it before.
  /// @param grid          The grid the list names; must carry 4-byte `tsdf`
  ///                      and `weight` attributes and have `block_size` 8.
  /// @param list          `volume::BlockIndex` entries on the device, found
  ///                      by `coord` (each `ptr` is ignored); must outlive
  ///                      the output.
  /// @param count         The entries to transform: a word a kernel wrote,
  ///                      at most its bound.
  /// @param params        The coefficient count and steps.
  /// @param masks         Where each entry's `kMaskWordsPerBlock` mask words
  ///                      go; must outlive the output.
  /// @param coefficients  Where each entry's @ref coefficient_words(K)
  ///                      words go, an odd K's pad half 0; must outlive the
  ///                      output.
  /// @param cut           Optional cut set, one bit per voxel of the grid's
  ///                      heap (slot s at bit s % 32 of word s / 32), whose
  ///                      set voxels are coded as unobserved
  ///                      (`EncoderConfig::true_sdf`); must outlive the
  ///                      submit. `nullptr` reads none.
  /// @param stage         Optional scope the caller's stage row is open
  ///                      under; the dispatches record their device spans
  ///                      into it. `nullptr` times nothing.
  /// @return The output, borrowing @p list, @p masks and @p coefficients,
  ///         its count the bound (no entries for a bound of 0, which records
  ///         the reject count's reset alone), or, before anything is
  ///         recorded, `Status::Code::InvalidArgument` for invalid @p params,
  ///         a grid that is moved-from, has another block size, a
  ///         non-positive `trunc_dist`, or lacks a float `tsdf` / `weight`; a
  ///         count word missing, misaligned or past its buffer; a bound past
  ///         the grid's block heap; a @p list `StorageInput::check` refuses
  ///         for it; output buffers smaller than it needs; a @p cut smaller
  ///         than the grid's heap; or a buffer that would exceed
  ///         `maxStorageBufferRange`. Otherwise a buffer failure.
  core::Result<ResidentBlocks> record_forward(
      core::CommandBatch& batch, const volume::VoxelBlockGrid& grid,
      const core::Buffer& list, const volume::DeviceCount& count,
      const CodecParams& params, const core::Buffer& masks,
      const core::Buffer& coefficients, const core::Buffer* cut = nullptr,
      core::GpuStageScope* stage = nullptr);

  /// @return The refusal for @p rejected entries of @p count the kernels
  ///         found no block for, or OK when there are none.
  static core::Status check_rejected(const char* op, std::uint32_t rejected,
                                     std::uint32_t count);

  /// @return OK for a grid the transform takes, as @ref record_observed
  ///         checks it; its refusal otherwise: what a caller checks before
  ///         it records anything else.
  core::Status check_grid(const volume::VoxelBlockGrid& grid) const;

  /// @brief Record the upload of @p params' steps, which the forward and the
  ///        inverse read, into @p batch: inline, so recorded ahead of a
  ///        batch's first dispatch it opens no MoltenVK blit encoder
  ///        mid-batch.
  /// @return OK, or the batch's refusal.
  core::Status record_steps(core::CommandBatch& batch,
                            const CodecParams& params);

  /// @brief Record the reconstruction of every block of @p in from its
  ///        coefficients and mask, overwriting its `tsdf` and `weight`, into
  ///        @p batch after what it already holds -- the reference store's
  ///        apply, which wrote @p in, and @ref record_steps -- over
  ///        @p slices, a workgroup a block, sized and gated on the device.
  ///
  /// Advances the map's tick, which every block the inverse changes is
  /// stamped with. The list must be duplicate-free, and the coefficients
  /// made against the grid's `trunc_dist` (both unchecked: they come from a
  /// frame whose order and header the caller checked). Each entry's coord
  /// must be one @p grid holds, else it is counted in @ref rejected; its ptr
  /// is ignored.
  /// @param batch   The batch to record into; submitted by the caller.
  /// @param grid    As @ref record_forward, written in place.
  /// @param in      The blocks, bound where they are; a count of 0 records
  ///                the reject count's reset alone.
  /// @param params  Their coefficient count and steps.
  /// @param slices  The inverse's slices, a group a block, for @p in's
  ///                count.
  /// @param stage   As @ref record_forward.
  /// @return OK, or, before anything is recorded, @ref record_forward's
  ///         refusals of @p grid and @p params, or
  ///         `Status::Code::InvalidArgument` for blocks holding another K
  ///         than @p params, more blocks than the grid's heap, buffers
  ///         missing or smaller than @p in's count needs, or a P-frame's
  ///         entries, which are not yet its blocks. Otherwise a buffer
  ///         failure.
  core::Status record_inverse(
      core::CommandBatch& batch, volume::VoxelBlockGrid& grid,
      const ResidentBlocks& in, const CodecParams& params,
      const volumetric_kit::grid::detail::IndirectSlices& slices,
      core::GpuStageScope* stage = nullptr);

  /// @return The entries the last forward or inverse found no block for --
  ///         which it neither read nor wrote -- a u32, once its batch ran,
  ///         for @ref check_rejected.
  const core::Buffer& rejected() const noexcept { return rejected_; }

  /// @brief Record the gathering of the first `n` entries of @p list whose
  ///        block holds an observed voxel (`weight >= volume::kObservedWeight`)
  ///        into @ref observed_list, `n` the word @p count names, in
  ///        unspecified order -- or, with @p true_sdf, those
  ///        `EncoderConfig::true_sdf` codes, its cut set left in
  ///        @ref cut_set.
  ///
  /// What the encoder keeps, found before the forward transform rather than
  /// after it. This reads each block's weights alone and appends only observed
  /// entries to a device list, a group an entry, sized on the device; their
  /// count and the reject tally stay there (@ref observed_counts). With
  /// @p true_sdf, two passes over the list come first in the same batch: the
  /// cut, then the flags of the blocks holding a corner of a cell kept, which
  /// the append then takes instead. The encoder sorts the entries by
  /// coordinate on the device before transforming them, so append order
  /// cannot affect bytes.
  /// @param batch     The batch to record into; submitted by the caller.
  /// @param grid      As @ref record_forward.
  /// @param list      The map's own active list, bound where it is: one
  ///                  `record_compaction` wrote into @p batch, or one
  ///                  @ref volume::VoxelHashMap::held_device_list holds.
  /// @param count     Its entries: a word a kernel wrote or the caller set, at
  ///                  most its bound, at most the grid's heap.
  /// @param true_sdf  Whether to keep the blocks `EncoderConfig::true_sdf`
  ///                  codes.
  /// @param stage     As @ref record_forward.
  /// @return OK, recording the counts' reset alone for a bound of 0; or,
  ///         before anything is recorded, `Status::Code::InvalidArgument` for
  ///         a grid @ref record_forward refuses, a count word missing,
  ///         misaligned or past its buffer, a bound past the grid's heap, a
  ///         @p list `StorageInput::check` refuses for it, or a buffer past
  ///         `maxStorageBufferRange`; otherwise a buffer failure.
  core::Status record_observed(core::CommandBatch& batch,
                               const volume::VoxelBlockGrid& grid,
                               const core::Buffer& list,
                               const volume::DeviceCount& count, bool true_sdf,
                               core::GpuStageScope* stage = nullptr);

  /// @return The last @ref record_observed's two words, once its batch ran:
  ///         the entries it found no block for, then how many entries
  ///         @ref observed_list holds.
  const core::Buffer& observed_counts() const noexcept {
    return observed_counts_;
  }

  /// @return How many entries @ref observed_list holds, once the last
  ///         @ref record_observed's batch has run: its word in
  ///         @ref observed_counts, bound by that call's list.
  volume::DeviceCount observed_count() const noexcept {
    return volume::DeviceCount{&observed_counts_, sizeof(std::uint32_t),
                               observed_bound_};
  }

  /// @return The last @ref record_observed's entries, `volume::BlockIndex`
  ///         each, valid until its next call; at least its bound's.
  const core::Buffer& observed_list() const noexcept {
    return observed_blocks_;
  }

  /// @return The cut set of the last @ref record_observed with `true_sdf`
  ///         and a non-empty list, laid out as @ref record_forward takes it,
  ///         valid until the next such call.
  const core::Buffer& cut_set() const noexcept { return cut_; }

 private:
  DctTransform() = default;

  /// The attributes both kernels bind, found by @ref check_inputs.
  struct GridViews {
    volume::AttributeView tsdf;
    volume::AttributeView weight;
  };

  /// What `EncoderConfig::true_sdf` adds to a call: the switch, the cut set
  /// bound, the transform's own unless the caller's, and the passes: the
  /// surface kernel's two (cut, then keep), each kernel's one otherwise.
  struct TrueSdf {
    bool on = false;
    const core::Buffer* cut = nullptr;
    std::uint32_t passes = 1;
  };

  /// The grid / params checks both directions share, all taken before
  /// anything is allocated, and for an empty list too.
  core::Result<GridViews> check_inputs(const char* op,
                                       const volume::VoxelBlockGrid& grid,
                                       const CodecParams& params) const;

  /// Bind the call's buffers and record @p kernel over the @p count entries
  /// of @p list into @p batch, a workgroup an entry, once per pass of
  /// @p true_sdf (a batch takes no set rewritten after a dispatch), its
  /// @p counts zeroed first; over @p slices when given, which the device
  /// sized. @p coefficients and @p masks may be null for a kernel that reads
  /// none.
  core::Status record(
      core::CommandBatch& batch, core::ComputeKernel& kernel,
      const volume::VoxelBlockGrid& grid, const GridViews& views, VkBuffer list,
      std::uint32_t count, const CodecParams& params, VkBuffer coefficients,
      VkBuffer masks, VkDeviceSize masks_bytes, const TrueSdf& true_sdf,
      const volumetric_kit::grid::detail::IndirectSlices* slices,
      const core::Buffer& counts, core::GpuStageScope* stage);
  /// A count word's checks, and its bound against the grid's heap.
  core::Status check_count(const char* op, const volume::VoxelBlockGrid& grid,
                           const volume::DeviceCount& count) const;
  /// Grow @p buffer if needed, retaining it for later calls
  /// (`ensure_device_scratch`).
  core::Status ensure_scratch(core::Buffer& buffer, VkDeviceSize bytes,
                              const char* name);

  // Borrowed (must outlive this).
  core::Device* device_ = nullptr;
  core::Allocator* allocator_ = nullptr;

  // The device's maxComputeWorkGroupCount[0], cached at create().
  std::uint32_t max_workgroup_count_x_ = 0;
  // Cached maxStorageBufferRange; every per-call buffer is checked against it.
  VkDeviceSize max_storage_buffer_range_ = 0;

  // The kernels share one layout shape (twelve storage buffers + the push
  // range) and one pool. Declared before pool_ and tables_, so those are
  // destroyed first -- the kernels' sets are freed with the pool.
  core::ComputeKernel forward_kernel_;
  core::ComputeKernel inverse_kernel_;
  core::ComputeKernel observed_kernel_;
  core::ComputeKernel surface_kernel_;
  // The count-to-slices kernels (vgrid::detail::add_dispatch_args) of the
  // observed pass and the forward, one each, so both size in one batch.
  core::ComputeKernel observed_args_kernel_;
  core::ComputeKernel forward_args_kernel_;
  core::DescriptorPool pool_;
  // The slices those write.
  core::Buffer observed_slices_;
  core::Buffer forward_slices_;
  // The basis + zigzag tables (binding 3), uploaded once.
  core::Buffer tables_;
  // Canonical per-basis effective steps (binding 9), computed on the host
  // and uploaded in each transform batch.
  core::Buffer quantization_steps_;
  // The forward's and the inverse's rejected entries (binding 7, the first
  // word), and the observed pass's rejected entries and count (its binding
  // 7), each zeroed in its call's batch.
  core::Buffer rejected_;
  core::Buffer observed_counts_;
  // The last record_observed's bound.
  std::uint32_t observed_bound_ = 0;
  // Scratch stays alive between calls; each binding uses its logical range,
  // not the retained capacity. No allocation when a call fits it.
  core::Buffer observed_blocks_;
  // The true SDF passes' cut set (binding 10, a bit a voxel slot) and keep
  // flags (binding 11, a word a block slot), sized to the grid's heap and
  // zeroed in each record_observed batch that uses them.
  core::Buffer cut_;
  core::Buffer keep_;
};

}  // namespace volumetric_kit::grid::codec::detail
```
