        !refusal_warned || now - *refusal_warned >= kRefusalWarningEvery;
    if (warn) refusal_warned = now;
    log_at(warn ? core::LogLevel::Warning : core::LogLevel::Debug,
           std::string(kServer) + ": refused viewer " + name + ": " +
               std::to_string(serving) + " viewers already");
    return;
  }
  // Nothing from here to its thread's start throws but that start, which is
  // undone: a viewer counted with no thread would keep its slot and its
  // connection for the server's life.
  Viewer& viewer = viewers.emplace_back();
  viewer.fd = std::move(fd);
  viewer.name = std::move(name);
  serving = ++live;
  try {
    log_at(core::LogLevel::Info, std::string(kServer) + ": viewer " +
                                     viewer.name + " joined, " +
                                     std::to_string(serving) + " of " +
                                     std::to_string(options.max_viewers));
  } catch (...) {
  }
  try {
    viewer.thread = std::thread([this, &viewer] { serve(viewer); });
  } catch (...) {
    --live;
    viewers.pop_back();
    throw;
  }
}

void StreamServer::Impl::reap() {
  for (auto it = viewers.begin(); it != viewers.end();) {
    bool done = false;
    {
      const std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
      done = it->done;
    }
    if (done) {
      it->thread.join();
      it = viewers.erase(it);
    } else {
      ++it;
    }
  }
}

void StreamServer::Impl::serve(Viewer& viewer) noexcept {
  std::string why;
  try {
    {
      // Counted before its first byte, so a live sender's key is on its way
      // while the session chunk goes.
      const std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
      log.join(&viewer.cursor);
      count_key_wanted();
    }
    why = send_all(viewer);
  } catch (...) {
    try {
      why = "failed: " +
            core::exception_status("sending", core::Status::Code::IoError)
                .message();
    } catch (...) {
    }
  }
  viewer.fd.reset();
  {
    const std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
    log.leave(&viewer.cursor);
    viewer.done = true;
    --live;
  }
  try {
    log_at(core::LogLevel::Info,
           std::string(kServer) + ": viewer " + viewer.name + " " + why);
  } catch (...) {
  }
}

std::string StreamServer::Impl::send_all(Viewer& viewer) {
  const std::string api = std::string(kServer) + ": viewer " + viewer.name;
  const int fd = viewer.fd.get();
  detail::Chunk chunk = session_chunk;  // the chunk under way; null between
  std::size_t sent = 0;                 // its bytes sent
  // Its place in the log, which it enters after the session chunk at the
  // GOP's key, or at the next key, waited for as it joined: the log keeps
  // every record since that it still needs.
  detail::GopLog::Cursor& cursor = viewer.cursor;
  // When the viewer last took a byte, or its socket could take one.
  Clock::time_point taking = Clock::now();
  std::uint64_t written = 0;  // the bytes sent on the socket
  std::uint64_t taken = 0;    // of them, the ones the viewer acknowledged
  std::uint8_t drain[kDrainBytes];
  for (;;) {
    if (stop) return "closed: the server stopped";
    const core::Result<short> ready =
        detail::wait_for(api, fd, POLLIN | POLLOUT, detail::kPollSlice);
    if (!ready.ok()) return "failed: " + ready.status().message();
    if ((*ready & (POLLIN | POLLHUP | POLLERR)) != 0) {
      // What a viewer sends is dropped; its end ends it.
      const core::Result<detail::Received> got =
          detail::receive_some(api, fd, drain, sizeof drain);
      if (!got.ok()) return "failed: " + got.status().message();
      if (got->closed) return "left";
    }
    if ((*ready & POLLOUT) == 0) {
      // Under the low-water mark the socket polls writable, so this one
      // holds at least that much; the viewer takes what it acknowledges,
      // which a slow one does above the mark.
      const core::Result<std::size_t> held = detail::unacknowledged(api, fd);
      if (!held.ok()) return "failed: " + held.status().message();
      if (*held < written - taken) {
        taken = written - *held;
        taking = Clock::now();
      } else if (Clock::now() >= detail::after(taking, options.stall_limit)) {
        return "closed: took no byte for " +
               std::to_string(options.stall_limit.count()) + " ms";
      }
      continue;
    }
    taking = Clock::now();
    if (!chunk) {
      // A chunk boundary: the next chunk, from a newer key if one has come
      // (replaying), or from the next key while it waits (keys on demand).
      std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
      chunk = log.next(&cursor);
      if (!chunk) {
        wake.wait_for(lock, detail::kPollSlice);
        continue;
      }
      sent = 0;
    }
    const core::Result<std::size_t> n =
        detail::send_some(api, fd, chunk->data() + sent, chunk->size() - sent);
    if (!n.ok()) return "failed: " + n.status().message();
    sent += *n;
    written += *n;
    if (sent == chunk->size()) chunk = nullptr;
  }
}

StreamServer::StreamServer(std::unique_ptr<Impl> impl) noexcept
    : impl_(std::move(impl)) {}

StreamServer::~StreamServer() {
  Impl& s = *impl_;
  {
    const std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(s.mutex);
    s.stop = true;
  }
  s.wake.notify_all();
  if (s.acceptor.joinable()) s.acceptor.join();
  for (Impl::Viewer& viewer : s.viewers) {
    if (viewer.thread.joinable()) viewer.thread.join();
  }
}

core::Result<std::unique_ptr<StreamServer>> StreamServer::start(
    const stream::Session& session, const ServerOptions& options) {
  constexpr std::string_view kApi = "StreamServer::start";
  try {
    core::Result<stream::ChunkEncoder> encoder =
        stream::ChunkEncoder::create(session);
    if (!encoder.ok()) return std::move(encoder).status().with_context(kApi);
    if (session.tracks.size() > 1) {
      return core::Status::unsupported(std::string(kApi) + ": a session of " +
                                       std::to_string(session.tracks.size()) +
                                       " tracks; one is served");
    }
    if (options.max_viewers == 0) {
      return core::Status::invalid_argument(std::string(kApi) +
                                            ": a max_viewers of 0");
    }
    if (options.stall_limit <= std::chrono::milliseconds{0}) {
      return core::Status::invalid_argument(
          std::string(kApi) + ": a stall_limit of " +
          std::to_string(options.stall_limit.count()) + " ms");
    }
    detail::Address address;
    if (!detail::parse_ipv4(options.host.empty() ? "0.0.0.0" : options.host,
                            options.port, &address)) {
      return core::Status::invalid_argument(std::string(kApi) + ": host \"" +
                                            options.host +
                                            "\" is not a numeric IPv4 address");
    }
    VKC_ASSIGN(core::UniqueFd listener, detail::listen_on(kApi, address));
    VKC_ASSIGN(const std::uint16_t port,
               detail::bound_port(kApi, listener.get()));
    auto session_chunk = std::make_shared<const std::vector<std::uint8_t>>(
        encoder->session_chunk());
    std::unique_ptr<StreamServer> server(
        new StreamServer(std::make_unique<Impl>(
            std::move(encoder).value(), options, std::move(session_chunk),
            std::move(listener), port)));
    Impl* const s = server->impl_.get();
    s->acceptor = std::thread([s] { s->accept_loop(); });
    return server;
  } catch (...) {
    return core::exception_status(kApi, core::Status::Code::IoError);
  }
}

core::Status StreamServer::publish(const stream::RecordInfo& info,
                                   const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size) {
  constexpr std::string_view kApi = "StreamServer::publish";
  try {
    if (data == nullptr && size != 0) {
      return core::Status::invalid_argument(std::string(kApi) +
                                            ": a null payload of " +
                                            std::to_string(size) + " bytes");
    }
    return publish(info, stream::RecordPayload::of(data, size));
  } catch (...) {
    return core::exception_status(kApi, core::Status::Code::OutOfMemory);
  }
}

core::Status StreamServer::publish(const stream::RecordInfo& info,
                                   const stream::RecordPayload& payload) {
  constexpr std::string_view kApi = "StreamServer::publish";
  Impl& s = *impl_;
  try {
    const std::size_t size = payload.size();
    if (size > stream::ChunkParser::kMaxBodyBytes) {
      return core::Status::invalid_argument(
          std::string(kApi) + ": a payload of " + std::to_string(size) +
          " bytes, above the " +
          std::to_string(stream::ChunkParser::kMaxBodyBytes) +
          " a viewer reads");
    }
    core::Result<stream::ChunkEncoder::RecordFraming> framed =
        s.encoder.frame(info, payload);
    if (!framed.ok()) return std::move(framed).status().with_context(kApi);
    const stream::ChunkEncoder::RecordFraming& framing = *framed;
    const std::size_t bytes = framing.header.size() + size + framing.padding;
    bool kept = false;
    bool overflow = false;
    std::uint64_t fell_back = 0;  // viewers that now wait for a key
    try {
      // The one copy, made before the lock, of both runs.
      auto chunk = std::make_shared<std::vector<std::uint8_t>>();
      chunk->reserve(bytes);
      chunk->insert(chunk->end(), framing.header.begin(), framing.header.end());
      if (payload.first_size() != 0) {
        chunk->insert(chunk->end(), payload.first(),
                      payload.first() + payload.first_size());
      }
      if (payload.second_size() != 0) {
        chunk->insert(chunk->end(), payload.second(),
                      payload.second() + payload.second_size());
      }
      chunk->insert(chunk->end(), kZeros, kZeros + framing.padding);
      const std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(s.mutex);
      // Whether a viewer would take it: replaying, a key or a record of an
      // open GOP; on demand, a key while a viewer has joined, or a record
      // while one is in.
      const bool joins =
          info.key ? s.options.replay_gop || s.log.joined() : s.log.open();
      const std::uint64_t wanted = s.log.key_wanted();
      kept = s.log.append(std::move(chunk), info.key);
      // Replaying, the GOP went past max_gop_bytes; on demand, the record
      // alone is past it, so no viewer can take it.
      overflow =
          joins &&
          (s.options.replay_gop ? !kept : bytes > s.options.max_gop_bytes);
      fell_back = s.log.key_wanted() - wanted;
      s.count_key_wanted();
    } catch (...) {
      // Lost, so the records after it until the next key are too.
      try {
        const std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(s.mutex);
        s.log.break_gop(info.key);
        s.count_key_wanted();
      } catch (...) {
      }
      return core::exception_status(kApi, core::Status::Code::OutOfMemory);
    }
    if (kept) s.wake.notify_all();
    if (overflow) {
      log_at(core::LogLevel::Warning,
             std::string(kApi) + ": a " +
                 (s.options.replay_gop
                      ? std::string("GOP")
                      : "record of " + std::to_string(bytes) + " bytes,") +
                 " past max_gop_bytes (" +
                 std::to_string(s.options.max_gop_bytes) +
                 "): the viewers wait for the next key");
    } else if (fell_back != 0) {
      // At Info, as viewers come and go: the sender's next key brings it
      // back.
      log_at(core::LogLevel::Info,
             std::string(kApi) + ": " + std::to_string(fell_back) +
                 (fell_back == 1 ? " viewer" : " viewers") +
                 " past max_gop_bytes (" +
                 std::to_string(s.options.max_gop_bytes) +
                 ") behind: waiting for the next key");
    }
    return {};
  } catch (...) {
    return core::exception_status(kApi, core::Status::Code::OutOfMemory);
  }
}

std::uint16_t StreamServer::port() const noexcept { return impl_->port; }

std::uint64_t StreamServer::key_wanted() const noexcept {
  return impl_->key_wanted.load();
}

std::size_t StreamServer::viewers() const noexcept {
  return impl_->live.load();
}

}  // namespace volumetric_kit::grid::networking
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/stream/chunk.cpp
```
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

#include "chunk.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <string>

#include "file.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/core/base/exception_status.hpp"

namespace volumetric_kit::grid::stream::detail {
namespace {

// --- CRC-32, sliced by 8. ----------------------------------------------------
//
// Table s holds the CRC of a byte followed by s zero bytes, so eight bytes
// fold into the CRC with eight lookups rather than eight dependent steps.

using CrcTables = std::array<std::array<std::uint32_t, 256>, 8>;

constexpr CrcTables make_crc_tables() {
  CrcTables t{};
  for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < 256; ++i) {
    std::uint32_t c = i;
    for (int k = 0; k < 8; ++k) {
      c = (c & 1u) != 0 ? (c >> 1) ^ 0xEDB88320u : c >> 1;
    }
    t[0][i] = c;
  }
  for (std::size_t s = 1; s < 8; ++s) {
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 256; ++i) {
      t[s][i] = (t[s - 1][i] >> 8) ^ t[0][t[s - 1][i] & 0xFFu];
    }
  }
  return t;
}

constexpr CrcTables kCrcTables = make_crc_tables();

// --- Framing. ----------------------------------------------------------------

constexpr std::size_t kHeaderSizeAt = 4;
constexpr std::size_t kBodySizeAt = 8;
constexpr std::size_t kBodyCrcAt = 16;
// The session header's fields.
constexpr std::size_t kVersionAt = 20;
constexpr std::size_t kSessionIdAt = 24;
constexpr std::size_t kCreatedAt = 40;
constexpr std::size_t kTrackCountAt = 48;
constexpr std::size_t kSessionFlagsAt = 50;
// A record's.
constexpr std::size_t kTrackAt = 20;
constexpr std::size_t kRecordFlagsAt = 22;
constexpr std::size_t kPtsAt = 24;
constexpr std::size_t kSeqAt = 32;
constexpr std::size_t kSetAt = 40;
// The index's and the tail's.
constexpr std::size_t kIndexTracksAt = 20;
constexpr std::size_t kIndexKeysAt = 24;
constexpr std::size_t kIndexOffsetAt = 24;
// A key entry's, in the index body; its offset is at 0.
constexpr std::size_t kEntryPtsAt = 8;
constexpr std::size_t kEntrySetAt = 16;
constexpr std::size_t kEntryTrackAt = 24;

// How much a scan reads first of a chunk header: all of a record's.
constexpr std::size_t kFirstRead = 64;
// What a resync reads first, doubling to kResyncBlock: damage that is one
// small record's header costs one small read.
constexpr std::size_t kResyncFirstBlock = std::size_t{4} << 10;
constexpr std::size_t kResyncBlock = std::size_t{1} << 20;

// Fill the framing of a header of `header_bytes` whose own fields are in
// place, then its CRC.
void seal_header(std::uint8_t* header, std::uint32_t tag,
                 std::uint32_t header_bytes, std::uint64_t body_bytes,
                 std::uint32_t body_crc) {
  store_le32(header, tag);
  store_le32(header + kHeaderSizeAt, header_bytes);
  store_le64(header + kBodySizeAt, body_bytes);
  store_le32(header + kBodyCrcAt, body_crc);
  store_le32(header + header_bytes - 4, crc32(header, header_bytes - 4));
}

// "<api>: <path><rest>", how each session header refusal starts.
std::string session_message(std::string_view api, std::string_view path,
                            const std::string& rest) {
  std::string message(api);
  message += ": ";
  message += path;
  message += rest;
  return message;
}

core::Status refuse_session(std::string_view api, std::string_view path,
                            const std::string& why) {
  return core::Status::invalid_argument(session_message(api, path, " " + why));
}

core::Status bad_session(std::string_view api, std::string_view path,
                         const std::string& why) {
  return core::Status::invalid_argument(
      session_message(api, path, ": the session header " + why));
}

// Bounds-checked reads through the session body; a read past its end sets
// `failed` and returns 0.
struct BodyReader {
  const std::uint8_t* data;
  std::uint64_t size;
  std::uint64_t pos = 0;
  bool failed = false;

  const std::uint8_t* take(std::uint64_t n) {
    if (failed || n > size - pos) {
      failed = true;
      return nullptr;
    }
    const std::uint8_t* at = data + pos;
    pos += n;
    return at;
  }
  std::uint16_t u16() {
    const std::uint8_t* p = take(2);
    return p != nullptr ? load_le16(p) : 0;
  }
  std::uint32_t u32() {
    const std::uint8_t* p = take(4);
    return p != nullptr ? load_le32(p) : 0;
  }
  std::string string() {
    const std::uint32_t n = u32();
    const std::uint8_t* p = take(n);
    return p != nullptr ? std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(p), n)
                        : std::string();
  }
};

// The session header's body, `size` bytes holding `tracks` tracks, into
// `session`: InvalidArgument unless it parses exactly.
core::Status parse_session_body(std::string_view api, std::string_view path,
                                const std::uint8_t* body, std::uint64_t size,
                                std::uint32_t tracks, Session* session) {
  if (tracks == 0) return bad_session(api, path, "has no tracks");
  BodyReader in{body, size};
  session->tracks.resize(tracks);
  for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < tracks; ++i) {
    Track& track = session->tracks[i];
    track.kind = static_cast<TrackKind>(in.u16());
    track.clock = in.u16();
    track.rate.num = in.u32();
    track.rate.den = in.u32();
    track.width = in.u32();
    track.height = in.u32();
    (void)in.u32();  // reserved
    if (in.failed) break;
    if (static_cast<std::uint16_t>(track.kind) == 0) {
      return bad_session(api, path,
                         "gives track " + std::to_string(i) + " kind 0");
    }
    if (track.rate.den == 0) {
      return bad_session(
          api, path, "gives track " + std::to_string(i) + " a rate_den of 0");
    }
  }
  session->writer = in.string();
  session->calibration = in.string();
  for (Track& track : session->tracks) {
    track.sensor = in.string();
    track.params = in.string();
  }
  if (in.failed) return bad_session(api, path, "body ends inside a field");
  if (in.pos != size) {
    return bad_session(api, path,
                       "body has " + std::to_string(size - in.pos) +
                           " bytes after its last string");
  }
  return {};
}

void put_string(std::uint8_t*& at, const std::string& s) {
  store_le32(at, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(s.size()));
  if (!s.empty()) std::memcpy(at + 4, s.data(), s.size());
  at += 4 + s.size();
}

}  // namespace

std::uint32_t crc32(const void* data, std::size_t size,
                    std::uint32_t crc) noexcept {
  const auto* p = static_cast<const std::uint8_t*>(data);
  const CrcTables& t = kCrcTables;
  std::uint32_t c = ~crc;
  for (; size >= 8; size -= 8, p += 8) {
    const std::uint32_t lo = load_le32(p) ^ c;
    const std::uint32_t hi = load_le32(p + 4);
    c = t[7][lo & 0xFFu] ^ t[6][(lo >> 8) & 0xFFu] ^ t[5][(lo >> 16) & 0xFFu] ^
        t[4][lo >> 24] ^ t[3][hi & 0xFFu] ^ t[2][(hi >> 8) & 0xFFu] ^
        t[1][(hi >> 16) & 0xFFu] ^ t[0][hi >> 24];
  }
  for (; size > 0; --size, ++p) c = t[0][(c ^ *p) & 0xFFu] ^ (c >> 8);
  return ~c;
}

core::Status null_payload(std::size_t size) {
  try {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(
        "ChunkEncoder::frame: a null payload of " + std::to_string(size) +
        " bytes");
  } catch (...) {
    return core::exception_status("ChunkEncoder::frame",
                                  core::Status::Code::InvalidArgument);
  }
}

core::Status encode_session(std::string_view api, const Session& session,
                            std::vector<std::uint8_t>* chunk) {
  const auto refuse = [&](const std::string& why) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(std::string(api) + ": " + why);
  };
  const std::size_t tracks = session.tracks.size();
  if (tracks == 0 || tracks > std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max()) {
    return refuse("a session holds 1 to 65535 tracks, not " +
                  std::to_string(tracks));
  }
  std::uint64_t body = kTrackEntryBytes * tracks + 8 + session.writer.size() +
                       session.calibration.size();
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < tracks; ++i) {
    const Track& track = session.tracks[i];
    if (static_cast<std::uint16_t>(track.kind) == 0) {
      return refuse("track " + std::to_string(i) + " has kind 0");
    }
    if (track.rate.den == 0) {
      return refuse("track " + std::to_string(i) + " has a rate_den of 0");
    }
    body += 8 + std::uint64_t{track.sensor.size()} + track.params.size();
  }
  if (body > kMaxSessionBytes) {
    return refuse("the session header's body would hold " +
                  std::to_string(body) + " bytes, above " +
                  std::to_string(kMaxSessionBytes));
  }
  chunk->assign(
      static_cast<std::size_t>(kSessionHeaderBytes + body + padding(body)), 0);
  std::uint8_t* header = chunk->data();
  store_le32(header + kVersionAt, kSessionVersion);
  std::memcpy(header + kSessionIdAt, session.id.data(), session.id.size());
  store_le64(header + kCreatedAt, session.created_ns);
  store_le16(header + kTrackCountAt, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(tracks));
  store_le16(header + kSessionFlagsAt, 0);
  std::uint8_t* const start = header + kSessionHeaderBytes;
  std::uint8_t* at = start;
  for (const Track& track : session.tracks) {
    store_le16(at, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(track.kind));
    store_le16(at + 2, track.clock);
    store_le32(at + 4, track.rate.num);
    store_le32(at + 8, track.rate.den);
    store_le32(at + 12, track.width);
    store_le32(at + 16, track.height);
    at += kTrackEntryBytes;
  }
  put_string(at, session.writer);
  put_string(at, session.calibration);
  for (const Track& track : session.tracks) {
    put_string(at, track.sensor);
    put_string(at, track.params);
  }
  seal_header(header, kSessionTag, kSessionHeaderBytes, body,
              crc32(start, static_cast<std::size_t>(body)));
  return {};
}

void encode_record_header(
    const RecordInfo& info, std::uint64_t size, std::uint32_t body_crc,
    std::array<std::uint8_t, kRecordHeaderBytes>& header) {
  header.fill(0);
  std::uint8_t* const p = header.data();
  store_le16(p + kTrackAt, info.track);
  store_le16(p + kRecordFlagsAt, info.key ? kKeyFlag : 0);
  store_le64(p + kPtsAt, info.pts_ns);
  store_le64(p + kSeqAt, info.seq);
  store_le64(p + kSetAt, info.set);
  seal_header(p, kRecordTag, kRecordHeaderBytes, size, body_crc);
}

void append_key_entry(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& entries, std::uint64_t offset,
                      const RecordInfo& info) {
  const std::size_t at = entries.size();
  entries.resize(at + kKeyEntryBytes, 0);
  std::uint8_t* p = entries.data() + at;
  store_le64(p, offset);
  store_le64(p + kEntryPtsAt, info.pts_ns);
  store_le64(p + kEntrySetAt, info.set);
  store_le16(p + kEntryTrackAt, info.track);
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> encode_footer(
    const std::vector<TrackStats>& stats,
    const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& key_entries, std::uint64_t index_offset) {
  const std::uint64_t body = kSummaryBytes * stats.size() + key_entries.size();
  std::vector<std::uint8_t> out(
      static_cast<std::size_t>(kIndexHeaderBytes + body + kTailBytes), 0);
  std::uint8_t* index = out.data();
  store_le32(index + kIndexTracksAt, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(stats.size()));
  store_le64(index + kIndexKeysAt, key_entries.size() / kKeyEntryBytes);
  std::uint8_t* at = index + kIndexHeaderBytes;
  for (const TrackStats& s : stats) {
    store_le64(at, s.records);
    store_le64(at + 8, s.keys);
    store_le64(at + 16, s.payload_bytes);
    store_le64(at + 24, s.min_pts_ns);
    store_le64(at + 32, s.max_pts_ns);
    at += kSummaryBytes;
  }
  if (!key_entries.empty()) {
    std::memcpy(at, key_entries.data(), key_entries.size());
  }
  seal_header(index, kIndexTag, kIndexHeaderBytes, body,
              crc32(index + kIndexHeaderBytes, static_cast<std::size_t>(body)));
  std::uint8_t* tail = index + kIndexHeaderBytes + body;
  store_le64(tail + kIndexOffsetAt, index_offset);
  seal_header(tail, kTailTag, kTailBytes, 0, 0);
  return out;
}

void count_record(TrackStats& stats, const RecordInfo& info,
                  std::uint64_t size) {
  if (stats.records == 0) {
    stats.min_pts_ns = stats.max_pts_ns = info.pts_ns;
  } else {
    stats.min_pts_ns = std::min(stats.min_pts_ns, info.pts_ns);
    stats.max_pts_ns = std::max(stats.max_pts_ns, info.pts_ns);
  }
  ++stats.records;
  if (info.key) ++stats.keys;
  stats.payload_bytes += size;
}

TrackStats load_summary(const std::uint8_t* p) {
  TrackStats s;
  s.records = load_le64(p);
  s.keys = load_le64(p + 8);
  s.payload_bytes = load_le64(p + 16);
  s.min_pts_ns = load_le64(p + 24);
  s.max_pts_ns = load_le64(p + 32);
  return s;
}

KeyEntry load_key_entry(const std::uint8_t* p) {
  KeyEntry e;
  e.offset = load_le64(p);
  e.pts_ns = load_le64(p + kEntryPtsAt);
  e.set = load_le64(p + kEntrySetAt);
  e.track = load_le16(p + kEntryTrackAt);
  return e;
}

std::uint32_t least_header_bytes(std::uint32_t tag) {
  if (tag == kRecordTag) return kRecordHeaderBytes;
  if (tag == kIndexTag) return kIndexHeaderBytes;
  if (tag == kTailTag) return kTailBytes;
  return kMinHeaderBytes;
}

bool header_fits(std::uint32_t h, std::uint32_t least,
                 std::uint64_t available) {
  return h % 8 == 0 && h >= least && h <= kMaxHeaderBytes && h <= available;
}

bool header_crc_ok(const std::uint8_t* header, std::uint32_t h) {
  return crc32(header, h - 4) == load_le32(header + h - 4);
}

bool decode_chunk(const std::uint8_t* header, std::uint32_t h,
                  std::uint32_t tracks, Chunk* out) {
  Chunk c;
  c.tag = load_le32(header);
  c.header_bytes = h;
  c.body_bytes = load_le64(header + kBodySizeAt);
  c.body_crc = load_le32(header + kBodyCrcAt);
  if (c.tag == kRecordTag) {
    c.record.track = load_le16(header + kTrackAt);
    c.flags = load_le16(header + kRecordFlagsAt);
    c.record.key = (c.flags & kKeyFlag) != 0;
    c.record.pts_ns = load_le64(header + kPtsAt);
    c.record.seq = load_le64(header + kSeqAt);
    c.record.set = load_le64(header + kSetAt);
  } else if (c.tag == kIndexTag) {
    c.tracks = load_le32(header + kIndexTracksAt);
    c.keys = load_le64(header + kIndexKeysAt);
  } else if (c.tag == kTailTag) {
    c.index_offset = load_le64(header + kIndexOffsetAt);
  }
  *out = c;
  return c.tag != kRecordTag || c.record.track < tracks;
}

core::Result<std::uint32_t> session_header_bytes(std::string_view api,
                                                 std::string_view path,
                                                 const std::uint8_t* header,
                                                 std::uint64_t available) {
  if (load_le32(header) != kSessionTag) {
    return refuse_session(api, path,
                          "is not a .vrst file: it does not start with VRST");
  }
  const std::uint32_t h = load_le32(header + kHeaderSizeAt);
  if (!header_fits(h, kSessionHeaderBytes, available)) {
    return refuse_session(api, path,
                          "has a session header of " + std::to_string(h) +
                              " bytes, out of range");
  }
  return h;
}

core::Result<std::uint64_t> session_body_bytes(std::string_view api,
                                               std::string_view path,
                                               const std::uint8_t* header,
                                               std::uint32_t h) {
  if (!header_crc_ok(header, h)) {
    return refuse_session(api, path, "has a session header that fails its CRC");
  }
  const std::uint32_t version = load_le32(header + kVersionAt);
  if (version != kSessionVersion) {
    return core::Status::unsupported(
        session_message(api, path,
                        " is version " + std::to_string(version) +
                            "; this library reads version 0"));
  }
  const std::uint16_t flags = load_le16(header + kSessionFlagsAt);
  if (flags != 0) {
    return core::Status::unsupported(
        session_message(api, path,
                        " sets session flags " + std::to_string(flags) +
                            ", which version 0 does not define"));
  }
  const std::uint64_t size = load_le64(header + kBodySizeAt);
  if (size > kMaxSessionBytes) {
    return refuse_session(api, path,
                          "has a session header body of " +
                              std::to_string(size) + " bytes, above " +
                              std::to_string(kMaxSessionBytes));
  }
  return size;
}

core::Status parse_session(std::string_view api, std::string_view path,
                           const std::uint8_t* header, const std::uint8_t* body,
                           std::uint64_t size, Session* session) {
  if (crc32(body, static_cast<std::size_t>(size)) !=
      load_le32(header + kBodyCrcAt)) {
    return refuse_session(api, path,
                          "has a session header body that fails its CRC");
  }
  std::memcpy(session->id.data(), header + kSessionIdAt, session->id.size());
  session->created_ns = load_le64(header + kCreatedAt);
  return parse_session_body(api, path, body, size,
                            load_le16(header + kTrackCountAt), session);
}

core::Result<bool> read_chunk(std::string_view api, const FileView& file,
                              std::uint64_t offset, Chunk* out) {
  if (offset >= file.size || file.size - offset < kMinHeaderBytes) {
    return false;
  }
  const std::uint64_t available = file.size - offset;
  std::uint8_t header[kMaxHeaderBytes];
  const auto first =
      static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min<std::uint64_t>(kFirstRead, available));
  VKC_TRY(read_at(api, *file.path, file.fd, offset, header, first));
  const std::uint32_t h = load_le32(header + kHeaderSizeAt);
  if (!header_fits(h, least_header_bytes(load_le32(header)), available)) {
    return false;
  }
  if (h > first) {
    VKC_TRY(read_at(api, *file.path, file.fd, offset + first, header + first,
                    h - first));
  }
  if (!header_crc_ok(header, h)) return false;
  return decode_chunk(header, h, file.tracks, out);
}

core::Result<std::uint64_t> resync(std::string_view api, const FileView& file,
                                   std::uint64_t from, std::uint64_t end) {
  std::vector<std::uint8_t> block;
  std::uint64_t at = from + 8;
  for (std::size_t want = kResyncFirstBlock; at < end;
       want = std::min(2 * want, kResyncBlock)) {
    block.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(
        std::min<std::uint64_t>(want, file.size - at)));
    const std::size_t n = block.size();
    VKC_TRY(read_at(api, *file.path, file.fd, at, block.data(), n));
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 4 <= n && at + i < end; i += 8) {
      const std::uint32_t tag = load_le32(block.data() + i);
      if (tag != kRecordTag && tag != kIndexTag && tag != kTailTag) continue;
      Chunk c;
      VKC_ASSIGN(const bool valid, read_chunk(api, file, at + i, &c));
      if (valid) return at + i;
    }
    at += want;
  }
  return end;
}

core::Result<std::uint64_t> read_session(std::string_view api,
                                         const FileView& file,
                                         Session* session) {
  const std::string& path = *file.path;
  if (file.size < kSessionHeaderBytes) {
    return refuse_session(api, path,
                          "holds " + std::to_string(file.size) +
                              " bytes, fewer than a session header's 56");
  }
  std::uint8_t header[kMaxHeaderBytes];
  VKC_TRY(read_at(api, path, file.fd, 0, header, kSessionHeaderBytes));
  VKC_ASSIGN(const std::uint32_t h,
             session_header_bytes(api, path, header, file.size));
  if (h > kSessionHeaderBytes) {
    VKC_TRY(read_at(api, path, file.fd, kSessionHeaderBytes,
                    header + kSessionHeaderBytes, h - kSessionHeaderBytes));
  }
  VKC_ASSIGN(const std::uint64_t size,
             session_body_bytes(api, path, header, h));
  if (size > file.size - h) {
    return refuse_session(api, path, "ends inside its session header");
  }
  std::vector<std::uint8_t> body(static_cast<std::size_t>(size));
  VKC_TRY(read_at(api, path, file.fd, h, body.data(), body.size()));
  VKC_TRY(parse_session(api, path, header, body.data(), size, session));
  return h + size + padding(size);
}

}  // namespace volumetric_kit::grid::stream::detail
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/stream/chunk.hpp
```
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

#pragma once

// The .vrst chunks in code (stream/session.hpp holds the layout): the tags
// and sizes, CRC-32, little-endian words, each chunk's encoding and decoding,
// the checks a chunk passes, on bytes in memory, and reading a chunk header
// from the file, with the search past damage for the next one.

#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

#include "volumetric_kit/core/base/result.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/stream/session.hpp"

namespace volumetric_kit::grid::stream::detail {

// --- Little-endian words. ----------------------------------------------------

inline std::uint16_t load_le16(const std::uint8_t* p) {
  return static_cast<std::uint16_t>(p[0] | (p[1] << 8));
}
inline std::uint32_t load_le32(const std::uint8_t* p) {
  return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p[0]) |
         (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p[1]) << 8) |
         (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p[2]) << 16) |
         (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p[3]) << 24);
}
inline std::uint64_t load_le64(const std::uint8_t* p) {
  return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(load_le32(p)) |
         (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(load_le32(p + 4)) << 32);
}
inline void store_le16(std::uint8_t* p, std::uint16_t v) {
  p[0] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v);
  p[1] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v >> 8);
}
inline void store_le32(std::uint8_t* p, std::uint32_t v) {
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) p[i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v >> (8 * i));
}
inline void store_le64(std::uint8_t* p, std::uint64_t v) {
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) p[i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v >> (8 * i));
}

// --- CRC-32. -----------------------------------------------------------------

// zlib's crc32: `crc` is the value of the bytes before, so a CRC can be
// computed in pieces (0 to start).
std::uint32_t crc32(const void* data, std::size_t size,
                    std::uint32_t crc = 0) noexcept;

// The refusal of a null payload of `size` bytes, nonzero, which the
// encoder's frame words and the writer's append wraps (InvalidArgument).
core::Status null_payload(std::size_t size);

// --- Tags and sizes. ---------------------------------------------------------

// A tag as the little-endian word its four bytes make.
constexpr std::uint32_t make_tag(const char (&name)[5]) {
  return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(name[0])) |
         static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(name[1])) << 8 |
         static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(name[2])) << 16 |
         static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(name[3])) << 24;
}
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kSessionTag = make_tag("VRST");
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kRecordTag = make_tag("RECD");
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kIndexTag = make_tag("INDX");
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kTailTag = make_tag("TAIL");

inline constexpr std::uint32_t kSessionVersion = 0;

// H's range, and each tag's H as this version writes it (a reader takes a
// larger one).
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kMinHeaderBytes = 24;
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kMaxHeaderBytes = 4096;
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kSessionHeaderBytes = 56;
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kRecordHeaderBytes = 56;
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kIndexHeaderBytes = 40;
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kTailBytes = 40;

inline constexpr std::uint64_t kTrackEntryBytes = 24;
inline constexpr std::uint64_t kSummaryBytes = 40;
inline constexpr std::uint64_t kKeyEntryBytes = 32;

// The record flags this version knows.
inline constexpr std::uint16_t kKeyFlag = 1;

// The zero bytes after `n` that bring it to a multiple of 8.
constexpr std::uint64_t padding(std::uint64_t n) { return (8 - n % 8) % 8; }

// --- Encoding. ---------------------------------------------------------------

// The whole `VRST` chunk for `session`, padding included; InvalidArgument,
// naming `api`, for a session it cannot hold (no tracks or more than 65535,
// a kind of 0, a rate_den of 0, a body over kMaxSessionBytes).
core::Status encode_session(std::string_view api, const Session& session,
                            std::vector<std::uint8_t>* chunk);

// A `RECD` header for a payload of `size` bytes whose CRC is `body_crc`.
void encode_record_header(const RecordInfo& info, std::uint64_t size,
                          std::uint32_t body_crc,
                          std::array<std::uint8_t, kRecordHeaderBytes>& header);

// One key entry of the `INDX` body, appended to `entries`.
void append_key_entry(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& entries, std::uint64_t offset,
                      const RecordInfo& info);

// The footer: the `INDX` chunk over `stats` and `key_entries` (as
// append_key_entry made them) at `index_offset`, then the `TAIL` naming it.
std::vector<std::uint8_t> encode_footer(
    const std::vector<TrackStats>& stats,
    const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& key_entries, std::uint64_t index_offset);

// Count a record of `size` payload bytes in its track's stats.
void count_record(TrackStats& stats, const RecordInfo& info,
                  std::uint64_t size);

// --- Decoding. ---------------------------------------------------------------

// One key entry of the `INDX` body, as append_key_entry wrote it.
struct KeyEntry {
  std::uint64_t offset = 0;  // its `RECD` chunk's
  std::uint64_t pts_ns = 0;
  std::uint64_t set = kNoSet;
  std::uint16_t track = 0;
};

// The track summary, of kSummaryBytes, at `p`.
TrackStats load_summary(const std::uint8_t* p);

// The key entry, of kKeyEntryBytes, at `p`.
KeyEntry load_key_entry(const std::uint8_t* p);

// The file a reader reads: its descriptor, its path for messages, its size
// at open and its session's track count.
struct FileView {
  int fd = -1;
  const std::string* path = nullptr;
  std::uint64_t size = 0;
  std::uint32_t tracks = 0;
};

// A chunk header that passed its checks, and what its tag's fields say.
struct Chunk {
  std::uint32_t tag = 0;
  std::uint32_t header_bytes = 0;  // H
  std::uint64_t body_bytes = 0;    // B
  std::uint32_t body_crc = 0;
  RecordInfo record;               // RECD
  std::uint16_t flags = 0;         // RECD: every flag bit, kKeyFlag included
  std::uint32_t tracks = 0;        // INDX: T
  std::uint64_t keys = 0;          // INDX: K
  std::uint64_t index_offset = 0;  // TAIL
};

// --- Checks, on bytes in memory. ---------------------------------------------
//
// The file reader and ChunkParser (stream/chunks.hpp) both check a chunk with
// these, each check on the bytes it needs: header_fits on its first 8, then
// header_crc_ok and decode_chunk on its H. The session header, the first
// chunk, has its own three, each naming `api` and `path` (the bytes' name: a
// file's path) in its refusal.

// The least H of a chunk tagged `tag` after the session header: its tag's
// own, or 24 for a tag this version does not read (a `VRST` there too).
std::uint32_t least_header_bytes(std::uint32_t tag);

// Whether H = `h` is a header size, at least `least`, that fits in the
// `available` bytes left.
bool header_fits(std::uint32_t h, std::uint32_t least, std::uint64_t available);

// Whether the `h` bytes of `header` pass their CRC, the last 4.
bool header_crc_ok(const std::uint8_t* header, std::uint32_t h);

// What the `h` header bytes at `header`, which passed the checks above, say,
// into `out`: false, with `out` filled all the same, for a `RECD` of a track
// not below `tracks`.
bool decode_chunk(const std::uint8_t* header, std::uint32_t h,
                  std::uint32_t tracks, Chunk* out);

// Whether `c` is a `RECD` setting only the flags this version knows; one
// setting another is skipped (stream/session.hpp).
inline bool known_record(const Chunk& c) {
  return c.tag == kRecordTag && (c.flags & ~kKeyFlag) == 0;
}

// The session header's H, from its first 8 bytes at `header`:
// InvalidArgument unless they start with `VRST` and H is a header size of at
// least 56 within `available`.
core::Result<std::uint32_t> session_header_bytes(std::string_view api,
                                                 std::string_view path,
                                                 const std::uint8_t* header,
                                                 std::uint64_t available);

// The session header's B, from its `h` bytes at `header`: InvalidArgument
// when they fail their CRC or B is above kMaxSessionBytes; Unsupported for a
// version or flag this version does not know.
core::Result<std::uint64_t> session_body_bytes(std::string_view api,
                                               std::string_view path,
                                               const std::uint8_t* header,
                                               std::uint32_t h);

// The session the header at `header` and its body, `size` bytes at `body`,
// hold, into `session`: InvalidArgument when the body fails its CRC or does
// not parse exactly.
core::Status parse_session(std::string_view api, std::string_view path,
                           const std::uint8_t* header, const std::uint8_t* body,
                           std::uint64_t size, Session* session);

// --- The file. ---------------------------------------------------------------

// Read the chunk header at `offset`: `true`, with `out` filled, when it lies
// inside the file and passes its range and CRC checks, and a known tag's
// fields are in range (a `RECD` of a track the session has); `false` when
// not; IoError when the read fails. Its body is not checked.
core::Result<bool> read_chunk(std::string_view api, const FileView& file,
                              std::uint64_t offset, Chunk* out);

// The first chunk after damage at `from`: the least `from + 8 k` (k >= 1)
// below `end` where read_chunk finds a `RECD`, `INDX` or `TAIL`, searched in
// blocks of 4 KiB doubling to 1 MiB; `end` when there is none.
core::Result<std::uint64_t> resync(std::string_view api, const FileView& file,
                                   std::uint64_t from, std::uint64_t end);

// Read the session header, the file's first chunk, into `session`: where the
// chunk after it starts. InvalidArgument for a file shorter than a session
// header or without its magic, and for a header out of range, failing a CRC
// or not parsing exactly; Unsupported for a version or flag this version
// does not know; IoError when a read fails. `file.tracks` is not read.
core::Result<std::uint64_t> read_session(std::string_view api,
                                         const FileView& file,
                                         Session* session);

}  // namespace volumetric_kit::grid::stream::detail
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/stream/chunks.cpp
```
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

#include "volumetric_kit/grid/stream/chunks.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <utility>

#include "chunk.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/core/base/check.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/core/base/exception_status.hpp"

namespace volumetric_kit::grid::stream {
namespace {

static_assert(sizeof(ChunkEncoder::RecordFraming::header) ==
                  detail::kRecordHeaderBytes,
              "a record's framing holds its RECD header");

// The parser's messages name it and the bytes, as a reader's name the call
// and the file.
constexpr std::string_view kParser = "ChunkParser";
constexpr std::string_view kStream = "the stream";

// No bound on the bytes still to come, for header_fits.
constexpr std::uint64_t kUnbounded = ~std::uint64_t{0};

}  // namespace

RecordPayload RecordPayload::of(const std::uint8_t* first,
                                std::size_t first_size,
                                const std::uint8_t* second,
                                std::size_t second_size) noexcept {
  VKC_CHECK((first != nullptr || first_size == 0) &&
                (second != nullptr || second_size == 0),
            "RecordPayload::of takes bytes for every run with a size");
  RecordPayload payload;
  payload.first_ = first;
  payload.first_size_ = first_size;
  payload.second_ = second;
  payload.second_size_ = second_size;
  // The second run's CRC continues the first's, as zlib's does.
  payload.crc_ =
      detail::crc32(second, second_size, detail::crc32(first, first_size));
  return payload;
}

ChunkEncoder::ChunkEncoder(std::vector<std::uint8_t> session_chunk,
                           std::size_t tracks)
    : session_chunk_(std::move(session_chunk)), state_(tracks) {}

core::Result<ChunkEncoder> ChunkEncoder::create(const Session& session) {
  constexpr std::string_view kApi = "ChunkEncoder::create";
  try {
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> chunk;
    VKC_TRY(detail::encode_session(kApi, session, &chunk));
    return ChunkEncoder(std::move(chunk), session.tracks.size());
  } catch (...) {
    return core::exception_status(kApi, core::Status::Code::InvalidArgument);
  }
}

const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& ChunkEncoder::session_chunk() const noexcept {
  return session_chunk_;
}

core::Result<ChunkEncoder::RecordFraming> ChunkEncoder::frame(
    const RecordInfo& info, const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size) {
  if (data == nullptr && size != 0) return detail::null_payload(size);
  return frame(info, RecordPayload::of(data, size));
}

core::Result<ChunkEncoder::RecordFraming> ChunkEncoder::frame(
    const RecordInfo& info, const RecordPayload& payload) {
  constexpr std::string_view kApi = "ChunkEncoder::frame";
  try {
    const auto refuse = [&](const std::string& why) {
      return core::Status::invalid_argument(std::string(kApi) + ": " + why);
    };
    if (info.track >= state_.size()) {
      return refuse("track " + std::to_string(info.track) +
                    ", but the session has " + std::to_string(state_.size()));
    }
    const std::size_t size = payload.size();
    TrackState& state = state_[info.track];
    if (state.any && info.seq <= state.last_seq) {
      return refuse("track " + std::to_string(info.track) + "'s seq " +
                    std::to_string(info.seq) + " does not follow its last, " +
                    std::to_string(state.last_seq));
    }
    if (info.key && state.any_key && info.pts_ns < state.last_key_pts_ns) {
      return refuse("track " + std::to_string(info.track) + "'s key pts " +
                    std::to_string(info.pts_ns) +
                    " is before its last key's, " +
                    std::to_string(state.last_key_pts_ns));
    }
    RecordFraming framing;
    detail::encode_record_header(info, size, payload.crc(), framing.header);
    framing.padding = static_cast<std::size_t>(detail::padding(size));
    state.any = true;
    state.last_seq = info.seq;
    if (info.key) {
      state.any_key = true;
      state.last_key_pts_ns = info.pts_ns;
    }
    return framing;
  } catch (...) {
    return core::exception_status(kApi, core::Status::Code::InvalidArgument);
  }
}

core::Status ChunkParser::feed(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size) {
  VKC_CHECK(data != nullptr || size == 0, "ChunkParser::feed takes bytes");
  try {
    if (!failure_.ok()) return failure_;
    // What was passed goes.
    const auto passed = static_cast<std::size_t>(
        std::min<std::uint64_t>(next_ - base_, buffer_.size()));
    buffer_.erase(buffer_.begin(),
                  buffer_.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(passed));
    base_ += passed;
    buffer_.insert(buffer_.end(), data, data + size);
    VKC_ASSIGN(ready_, advance());
    return {};
  } catch (...) {
    return fail_on_exception();
  }
}

const Session* ChunkParser::session() const noexcept {
  return session_ ? &*session_ : nullptr;
}

core::Result<bool> ChunkParser::next(Record* record,
                                     std::vector<std::uint8_t>* payload) {
  VKC_CHECK(record != nullptr, "ChunkParser::next takes a record");
  try {
    if (!failure_.ok()) return failure_;
    // A record returned with no payload and never read is dropped.
    if (held_ != 0) {
      next_ += held_;
      held_ = 0;
      ready_ = false;
    }
    VKC_ASSIGN(ready_, advance());
    if (!ready_) return false;
    const std::uint8_t* const at =
        buffer_.data() + static_cast<std::size_t>(next_ - base_);
    detail::Chunk c;
    (void)detail::decode_chunk(
        at, detail::load_le32(at + 4),
        static_cast<std::uint32_t>(session_->tracks.size()), &c);
    record->info = c.record;
    record->offset = next_;
    record->size = c.body_bytes;
    held_ = c.header_bytes + c.body_bytes + detail::padding(c.body_bytes);
    if (payload == nullptr) return true;
    payload->resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(c.body_bytes));
    VKC_TRY(read(*record, payload->data(), payload->size()));
    return true;
  } catch (...) {
    return fail_on_exception();
  }
}

core::Status ChunkParser::read(const Record& record, std::uint8_t* dst,
                               std::size_t capacity) {
  try {
    if (!failure_.ok()) return failure_;
    if (held_ == 0 || record.offset != next_) {
      return core::Status::invalid_argument(
          "ChunkParser::read: the record is not the one next returned last");
    }
    const std::uint8_t* const at =
        buffer_.data() + static_cast<std::size_t>(next_ - base_);
    detail::Chunk c;
    (void)detail::decode_chunk(
        at, detail::load_le32(at + 4),
        static_cast<std::uint32_t>(session_->tracks.size()), &c);
    const RecordInfo& info = record.info;
    if (c.body_bytes != record.size || c.record.track != info.track ||
        c.record.key != info.key || c.record.pts_ns != info.pts_ns ||
        c.record.seq != info.seq || c.record.set != info.set) {
      return core::Status::invalid_argument(
          "ChunkParser::read: the record does not match its held header");
    }
    if (capacity < record.size || (dst == nullptr && record.size != 0)) {
      return core::Status::invalid_argument(
          "ChunkParser::read: the record holds " + std::to_string(record.size) +
          " bytes, more than the " + std::to_string(capacity) +
          " bytes given (or none)");
    }
    if (record.size != 0) {
      std::memcpy(dst, at + c.header_bytes,
                  static_cast<std::size_t>(c.body_bytes));
    }
    next_ += held_;
    held_ = 0;
    ready_ = false;
    return {};
  } catch (...) {
    // Only a refusal's message allocates; the record stays held.
    return core::exception_status(kParser, core::Status::Code::InvalidArgument);
  }
}

core::Result<bool> ChunkParser::advance() {
  if (ready_) return true;
  for (;;) {
    if (next_ - base_ > buffer_.size()) return false;  // padding to come
    const auto skip = static_cast<std::size_t>(next_ - base_);
    const std::uint8_t* const at = buffer_.data() + skip;
    const std::size_t available = buffer_.size() - skip;
    if (available < 8) return false;
    if (!session_) {
      core::Result<std::uint32_t> h =
          detail::session_header_bytes(kParser, kStream, at, kUnbounded);
      if (!h.ok()) return fail(std::move(h).status());
      if (available < *h) return false;
      core::Result<std::uint64_t> size =
          detail::session_body_bytes(kParser, kStream, at, *h);
      if (!size.ok()) return fail(std::move(size).status());
      if (available - *h < *size) return false;
      Session session;
      core::Status parsed =
          detail::parse_session(kParser, kStream, at, at + *h, *size, &session);
      if (!parsed.ok()) return fail(std::move(parsed));
      session_ = std::move(session);
      next_ += *h + *size + detail::padding(*size);
      continue;
    }
    const auto where = [&] {
      return std::string(kParser) + ": " + std::string(kStream) +
             ": the chunk at " + std::to_string(next_);
    };
    const std::uint32_t h = detail::load_le32(at + 4);
    if (!detail::header_fits(
            h, detail::least_header_bytes(detail::load_le32(at)), kUnbounded)) {
      return fail(core::Status::invalid_argument(where() + " has a header of " +
                                                 std::to_string(h) +
                                                 " bytes, out of range"));
    }
    if (available < h) return false;
    if (!detail::header_crc_ok(at, h)) {
      return fail(core::Status::invalid_argument(
          where() + " has a header that fails its CRC"));
    }
    detail::Chunk c;
    const auto tracks = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(session_->tracks.size());
    if (!detail::decode_chunk(at, h, tracks, &c)) {
      return fail(core::Status::invalid_argument(
          where() + " is a record of track " + std::to_string(c.record.track) +
          ", but the session has " + std::to_string(tracks)));
    }
    if (c.body_bytes > kMaxBodyBytes) {
      return fail(core::Status::out_of_memory(
          where() + " holds " + std::to_string(c.body_bytes) +
          " bytes, above the limit of " + std::to_string(kMaxBodyBytes)));
    }
    if (available - h < c.body_bytes) return false;
    if (detail::crc32(at + h, static_cast<std::size_t>(c.body_bytes)) !=
        c.body_crc) {
      return fail(
          core::Status::invalid_argument(where() + ": its body fails its CRC"));
    }
    if (detail::known_record(c)) return true;
    // Another tag, or a record setting a flag this version does not know.
    next_ += h + c.body_bytes + detail::padding(c.body_bytes);
  }
}

core::Status ChunkParser::fail(core::Status failure) {
  failure_ = std::move(failure);
  return failure_;
}

core::Status ChunkParser::fail_on_exception() noexcept {
  // Saved and returned, each by its own call: a copy may find no memory.
  if (failure_.ok()) {
    failure_ =
        core::exception_status(kParser, core::Status::Code::InvalidArgument);
  }
  return core::exception_status(kParser, core::Status::Code::InvalidArgument);
}

}  // namespace volumetric_kit::grid::stream
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/stream/file.cpp
```
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

// TODO(stream): this file's calls, chunk.hpp's CRC-32 and its little-endian
// words move to the family core's base tier when a second sibling needs them
// (core's rule for what it holds). Until then they are the stream's own; the
// core's file_io.cpp keeps a private errno mapping and flush of its own.

#include "file.hpp"

#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/types.h>  // IWYU pragma: keep (ssize_t on Linux)
#include <sys/uio.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cerrno>
#include <limits>
#include <system_error>
#include <utility>

#include "volumetric_kit/core/base/check.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/core/base/exception_status.hpp"

namespace volumetric_kit::grid::stream::detail {
namespace {

static_assert(sizeof(off_t) == 8, "offsets past 2 GiB need a 64-bit off_t");

// One read() or write() moves at most this much: macOS refuses a count above
// INT_MAX.
constexpr std::size_t kMaxIo = std::size_t{1} << 30;
// The most runs one write_all takes: a record's header, its payload's two
// runs and its padding.
constexpr int kMaxParts = 4;

constexpr mode_t kNewFileMode =
    S_IRUSR | S_IWUSR | S_IRGRP | S_IWGRP | S_IROTH | S_IWOTH;

}  // namespace

core::Status system_failure(std::string_view api, std::string_view what,
                            const std::string& path, int error) noexcept {
  try {
    std::string message(api);
    message += ": ";
    message += what;
    message += ' ';
    message += path;
    message += ": ";
    message += std::generic_category().message(error);
    switch (error) {
      case ENOENT:
      case ENOTDIR:  // a component of the path is not a directory
        return core::Status::not_found(std::move(message));
      case EEXIST:
      case EISDIR:
        return core::Status::invalid_argument(std::move(message));
      case ENOMEM:
        return core::Status::out_of_memory(std::move(message));
      default:
        return core::Status::io_error(std::move(message));
    }
  } catch (...) {
    return core::exception_status(api, core::Status::Code::IoError);
  }
}

core::Result<core::UniqueFd> create_new_file(std::string_view api,
                                             const std::string& path) {
  for (;;) {
    const int fd = ::open(path.c_str(), O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_CLOEXEC,
                          kNewFileMode);
    if (fd >= 0) return core::UniqueFd(fd);
    if (errno != EINTR)
      return system_failure(api, "cannot create", path, errno);
  }
}

core::Result<core::UniqueFd> open_file(std::string_view api,
                                       const std::string& path) {
  // O_NONBLOCK so a FIFO at the path is refused rather than waited on; it
  // changes nothing for a regular file.
  for (;;) {
    const int fd = ::open(path.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_NONBLOCK | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (fd >= 0) return core::UniqueFd(fd);
    if (errno != EINTR) return system_failure(api, "cannot open", path, errno);
  }
}

core::Result<std::uint64_t> regular_file_size(std::string_view api,
                                              const std::string& path, int fd) {
  struct stat info{};
  if (::fstat(fd, &info) != 0) {
    return system_failure(api, "cannot inspect", path, errno);
  }
  if (!S_ISREG(info.st_mode)) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(std::string(api) + ": " + path +
                                          " is not a regular file");
  }
  return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(info.st_size);
}

core::Status write_all(std::string_view api, const std::string& path, int fd,
                       const Bytes* parts, int count) {
  VKC_CHECK(count >= 0 && count <= kMaxParts, "write_all takes 0 to 4 runs");
  int first = 0;         // the first part with bytes left
  std::size_t done = 0;  // its bytes written
  iovec iov[kMaxParts];
  for (;;) {
    while (first < count && done == parts[first].size) {
      ++first;
      done = 0;
    }
    if (first == count) return {};
    int n = 0;
    std::size_t total = 0;
    for (int i = first; i < count && total < kMaxIo; ++i) {
      const std::size_t skip = i == first ? done : 0;
      const std::size_t len = std::min(parts[i].size - skip, kMaxIo - total);
      if (len == 0) continue;
      iov[n].iov_base =
          const_cast<char*>(static_cast<const char*>(parts[i].data) + skip);
      iov[n].iov_len = len;
      ++n;
      total += len;
    }
    const ssize_t written = ::writev(fd, iov, n);
    if (written <= 0) {
      const int error = written == 0 ? EIO : errno;
      if (error == EINTR) continue;
      return system_failure(api, "cannot write", path, error);
    }
    for (std::size_t left = static_cast<std::size_t>(written); left > 0;) {
      const std::size_t room = parts[first].size - done;
      if (left < room) {
        done += left;
        left = 0;
      } else {
        left -= room;
        ++first;
        done = 0;
      }
    }
  }
}

core::Status flush_file(std::string_view api, const std::string& path, int fd) {
  // Apple's fsync stops at the drive's cache, so there F_FULLFSYNC flushes
  // that too; a filesystem that refuses it gets fsync.
#ifdef F_FULLFSYNC
  if (::fcntl(fd, F_FULLFSYNC) == 0) return {};
#endif
  if (::fsync(fd) != 0) return system_failure(api, "cannot flush", path, errno);
  return {};
}

void flush_directory_of(const std::string& path) {
  const std::size_t slash = path.rfind('/');
  const std::string directory = slash == std::string::npos ? "."
                                : slash == 0 ? "/"
                                             : path.substr(0, slash);
  const core::UniqueFd dir(
      ::open(directory.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY | O_CLOEXEC));
  if (!dir.valid()) return;
#ifdef F_FULLFSYNC
  if (::fcntl(dir.get(), F_FULLFSYNC) == 0) return;
#endif
  (void)::fsync(dir.get());
}

core::Status close_file(std::string_view api, const std::string& path,
                        core::UniqueFd& fd) {
  if (::close(fd.release()) != 0 && errno != EINTR) {
    return system_failure(api, "cannot close", path, errno);
  }
  return {};
}

core::Status read_at(std::string_view api, const std::string& path, int fd,
                     std::uint64_t offset, void* out, std::size_t size) {
  constexpr auto kMaxOffset =
      static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::numeric_limits<off_t>::max());
  if (offset > kMaxOffset || size > kMaxOffset - offset) {
    return system_failure(api, "cannot read", path, EOVERFLOW);
  }
  auto* at = static_cast<unsigned char*>(out);
  while (size > 0) {
    const ssize_t n =
        ::pread(fd, at, std::min(size, kMaxIo), static_cast<off_t>(offset));
    if (n < 0) {
      if (errno == EINTR) continue;
      return system_failure(api, "cannot read", path, errno);
    }
    if (n == 0) {
      return core::Status::io_error(
          std::string(api) + ": " + path + " ends before byte " +
          std::to_string(offset + 1) + ", shorter than when it was opened");
    }
    at += n;
    offset += static_cast<std::uint64_t>(n);
    size -= static_cast<std::size_t>(n);
  }
  return {};
}

}  // namespace volumetric_kit::grid::stream::detail
```

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

#pragma once

// The POSIX file calls the stream writes and reads with, each failure a
// Status naming the caller, the path and the system's reason: a new file
// created exclusively, writes that loop until every byte is written, a flush
// to storage, and reads at an offset, which several threads may make at once.

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

#include "volumetric_kit/core/base/result.hpp"
#include "volumetric_kit/core/base/unique_fd.hpp"

namespace volumetric_kit::grid::stream::detail {

// "<api>: <what> <path>: <the system's reason>", in the domain `error` says:
// NotFound for a missing file or directory, InvalidArgument for something
// already there or a directory, OutOfMemory, and IoError for the rest.
// Diagnostic allocation failures must still return a Status so a writer can
// latch the failed I/O, including after a partial write.
core::Status system_failure(std::string_view api, std::string_view what,
                            const std::string& path, int error) noexcept;

// A new file at `path`, opened for writing, created only if nothing is there
// (O_EXCL: not even a symbolic link), with 0666 less the umask.
core::Result<core::UniqueFd> create_new_file(std::string_view api,
                                             const std::string& path);

// The file at `path`, opened for reading.
core::Result<core::UniqueFd> open_file(std::string_view api,
                                       const std::string& path);

// The size of `fd`, which must be a regular file (InvalidArgument otherwise).
core::Result<std::uint64_t> regular_file_size(std::string_view api,
                                              const std::string& path, int fd);

// One run of bytes to write.
struct Bytes {
  const void* data = nullptr;
  std::size_t size = 0;
};

// Write every byte of `parts`, in order, at the file's end: one writev, and
// more while a write comes up short or is interrupted.
core::Status write_all(std::string_view api, const std::string& path, int fd,
                       const Bytes* parts, int count);

// Flush `fd` to the storage device.
core::Status flush_file(std::string_view api, const std::string& path, int fd);

// Flush the entries of the directory `path` is in, where the filesystem
// allows it. Best effort: what it follows has already happened.
void flush_directory_of(const std::string& path);

// Close `fd`, reporting a failure.
core::Status close_file(std::string_view api, const std::string& path,
                        core::UniqueFd& fd);

// Read exactly `size` bytes at `offset`; a file that ends first is IoError
// (it is shorter than when it was opened).
core::Status read_at(std::string_view api, const std::string& path, int fd,
                     std::uint64_t offset, void* out, std::size_t size);

}  // namespace volumetric_kit::grid::stream::detail
