#include "hash.hpp"
#include "table_sizes.hpp"

// Embedded SPIR-V (generated by vgrid_embed_shaders onto a PRIVATE include
// path).
#include "hash_allocate_coords_comp.spv.hpp"
#include "hash_allocate_depth_comp.spv.hpp"
#include "hash_allocate_triangles_comp.spv.hpp"
#include "hash_compact_comp.spv.hpp"
#include "hash_compact_frustum_comp.spv.hpp"
#include "hash_delete_coords_comp.spv.hpp"
#include "hash_init_comp.spv.hpp"
#include "hash_rehash_comp.spv.hpp"
#include "hash_rounds_comp.spv.hpp"

namespace volumetric_kit::grid::volume {
namespace {

// Local group size, matching `layout(local_size_x = 256)` in every kernel.
constexpr std::uint32_t kLocalSize = 256;

// Bounded passes for the resize rehash. insert_block is idempotent (an
// already-present coord is a no-op), so re-driving the whole snapshot absorbs
// transient bucket-lock contention; the cap keeps a genuine chain overflow --
// a bucket the changed modulus concentrates past max_chain, still possible even
// though the set fit the old table -- from looping forever.
constexpr int kReinsertPasses = 3;

// The bound on rounds of dispatch_with_retry and of the blocking allocate and
// remove; see there.
constexpr std::uint32_t kMaxRounds = 10;

// hash_rounds.comp's push block.
struct RoundsPush {
  std::uint32_t count_word;
  std::uint32_t gate_word;
  std::uint32_t bound;
  std::uint32_t state_word;
  std::uint32_t round;
  std::uint32_t rounds;
  std::uint32_t per_dispatch;
  std::uint32_t dispatches;
};
static_assert(sizeof(RoundsPush) == 32, "RoundsPush must be 32 bytes");

// hash_rounds.comp's word index that names no word, and each kind's state:
// four words, the removal's first, then the allocation's and a depth
// round's.
constexpr std::uint32_t kNoWord = ~0u;
constexpr std::uint32_t kStateWords = 4;
constexpr std::uint32_t kDepthStateWord = 2 * kStateWords;

// What a recording runs ahead of its rounds (VoxelHashMap::record_remove).
using FirstRound = std::function<core::Status(core::CommandBatch&)>;

// The push-constant block every kernel shares: the grid shape plus one
// kernel-specific argument (mirrors `PushConstants` in hash_common.glsl).
struct PushConstants {
  VoxelGridParams grid;
  std::uint32_t arg;
  std::uint32_t tick;  // what allocation stamps a block with
  // The triangle kernel's first work item a dispatch covers
  // (vgrid::detail::dispatch_items); the other kernels ignore it.
  std::uint32_t item_base = 0;
};
static_assert(sizeof(PushConstants) == 44, "PushConstants layout drift");

// This tier's local_size, bound once so every call site reads group_count(n).
std::uint32_t group_count(std::uint32_t items) {
  return core::group_count(items, kLocalSize);
}

// The depth kernel's tile side: a workgroup is a kDepthTile x kDepthTile tile
// of pixels (mirrored by hash_allocate_depth.comp's kTile), so it dispatches a
// group a tile.
constexpr std::uint32_t kDepthTile = 16;
static_assert(kDepthTile * kDepthTile == kLocalSize,
              "a depth tile is one workgroup");

// A frame's tiles along x, which the kernel reads to place each group, and in
// all. Rounded up in 64 bits, since a width near 2^32 would wrap; the total
// fits 32, as allocate_from_depth refuses a frame past 2^32 pixels.
struct DepthTiles {
  std::uint32_t x;
  std::uint32_t total;
};
DepthTiles depth_tiles(const DepthPinhole& camera) {
  const std::uint64_t x =
      (std::uint64_t{camera.width} + kDepthTile - 1) / kDepthTile;
  const std::uint64_t y =
      (std::uint64_t{camera.height} + kDepthTile - 1) / kDepthTile;
  return {static_cast<std::uint32_t>(x), static_cast<std::uint32_t>(x * y)};
}

// All the persistent device buffers, sized for one grid. Returned as a bundle
// so a caller commits them only once every allocation has succeeded: create()
// into a fresh map, resize() as an all-or-nothing swap over the live one (a
// partial in-place swap would strand descriptors on a freed buffer). Keeps the
// buffer sizing in one place -- the counterpart to write_persistent_bindings().
struct PersistentBuffers {
  core::Buffer entries;
  core::Buffer heap;
  core::Buffer heap_counter;
  core::Buffer bucket_mutex;
  core::Buffer fail_counts;
  core::Buffer compacted;
  core::Buffer frustum_compacted;
  core::Buffer active_count;
  core::Buffer stamps;
};

// A count or gate word a recording reads, checked as `what` for `op`: a whole
// aligned word of a known device-local storage buffer that one binding
// covers, which also bounds its index below the shaders' no-word sentinel.
core::Status check_word(const std::string& op, const DeviceCount& word,
                        const char* what, VkDeviceSize max_range) {
  if (word.buffer == nullptr || !word.buffer->valid()) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(op + ": the " + what +
                                          " has no buffer");
  }
  constexpr VkDeviceSize word_bytes = sizeof(std::uint32_t);
  if (word.offset % word_bytes != 0 || word.buffer->size() < word_bytes ||
      word.offset > word.buffer->size() - word_bytes) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(
        op + ": the " + what + "'s word is misaligned or past its buffer");
  }
  const std::string named = op + ": the " + what;
  VKC_TRY(core::StorageInput(*word.buffer)
              .check(named.c_str(), word.offset + word_bytes));
  // The descriptors bind the whole buffer.
  return core::check_storage_buffer_range(named.c_str(), word.buffer->size(),
                                          max_range);
}

core::Result<PersistentBuffers> make_persistent_buffers(
    core::Allocator& allocator, const VoxelGridParams& grid) {
  const TableSizes sizes = table_sizes(std::uint64_t(grid.num_buckets),
                                       std::uint64_t(grid.bucket_size));
  // All device-local: only the kernels read and write them, and the host
  // reaches the counters through a CommandBatch (the 2026-09-28 residency
  // decision). The bucket locks were the first measured case: a spin lock in
  // host-visible memory is an atomic across PCIe per attempt, which took
  // 1.97 s to allocate a 5 000-triangle sheet on an RTX 5090 (3.4 ms
  // device-local).
  PersistentBuffers bufs;
  VKC_ASSIGN(bufs.entries,
             core::device_storage_buffer(allocator, sizes.entries));
  VKC_ASSIGN(bufs.heap, core::device_storage_buffer(allocator, sizes.heap));
  VKC_ASSIGN(bufs.heap_counter,
             core::device_storage_buffer(allocator, sizeof(std::uint32_t)));
  VKC_ASSIGN(bufs.bucket_mutex,
             core::device_storage_buffer(allocator, sizes.bucket_mutex));
  VKC_ASSIGN(bufs.fail_counts,
             core::device_storage_buffer(allocator,
                                         kFailSlots * sizeof(std::uint32_t)));
  VKC_ASSIGN(bufs.compacted,
             core::device_storage_buffer(allocator, sizes.compacted));
  VKC_ASSIGN(bufs.frustum_compacted,
             core::device_storage_buffer(allocator, sizes.frustum_compacted));
  VKC_ASSIGN(bufs.active_count,
             core::device_storage_buffer(allocator, sizeof(std::uint32_t)));
  VKC_ASSIGN(bufs.stamps, core::device_storage_buffer(allocator, sizes.stamps));
  return bufs;
}

}  // namespace

core::Result<VoxelHashMap> VoxelHashMap::create(core::Device& device,
                                                core::Allocator& allocator,
                                                const VoxelGridParams& grid) {
  VKC_TRY(check_device_requirements(device, "VoxelHashMap::create"));
  // Validate the full grid contract -- positivity AND the product invariants
  // (num_blocks == bucket_size*num_buckets, voxels_per_block == block_size^3)
  // that the buffer sizing and the block-pointer math below rely on.
  // VoxelGridParams::validate is the single source of truth for a usable grid.
  VKC_TRY(grid.validate());

  VoxelHashMap map;
  map.device_ = &device;
  map.allocator_ = &allocator;
  map.grid_ = grid;
  // Drawn here and not left at 0, so this table's very first topology is
  // already distinct from every other table's -- including one that lived at
  // this address and has since been destroyed. A per-map count starting at 0
  // would make a fresh map indistinguishable from a dead one whose cache is
  // still anchored (see topology_epoch()).
  map.topology_epoch_ = next_topology_epoch();

  // Persistent buffers + scratch, all device-local. Built as a bundle and
  // moved in together so the sizing lives in one place (make_persistent_-
  // buffers), shared with resize().
  VKC_ASSIGN(PersistentBuffers bufs, make_persistent_buffers(allocator, grid));
  map.entries_ = std::move(bufs.entries);
  map.heap_ = std::move(bufs.heap);
  map.heap_counter_ = std::move(bufs.heap_counter);
  map.bucket_mutex_ = std::move(bufs.bucket_mutex);
  map.fail_counts_ = std::move(bufs.fail_counts);
  map.compacted_ = std::move(bufs.compacted);
  map.frustum_compacted_ = std::move(bufs.frustum_compacted);
  map.active_count_ = std::move(bufs.active_count);
  map.stamps_ = std::move(bufs.stamps);

  // Camera params for the depth rounds: a frame's (96 B) every
  // minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment, written inline once a round ahead of
  // its first dispatch and bound at binding 6 of each frame's set; one
  // frame's to start with, grown for more. Grid-independent, so it is not
  // part of the resized bundle.
  VkPhysicalDeviceProperties limits{};
  vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(device.physical_device(), &limits);
  const VkDeviceSize alignment =
      std::max<VkDeviceSize>(limits.limits.minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment, 4);
  map.camera_stride_ =
      (sizeof(DepthPinhole) + alignment - 1) / alignment * alignment;
  VKC_ASSIGN(map.camera_params_,
             core::device_storage_buffer(allocator, map.camera_stride_));
  // Frusta for the frustum compactions: likewise small -- one frustum's count
  // and planes to start with, grown by upload_frusta for more -- and persisted
  // at binding 3 of compact_frustum_.set.
  VKC_ASSIGN(map.frustum_planes_,
             core::device_storage_buffer(
                 allocator, sizeof(std::uint32_t) + sizeof(FrustumPlanes)));
  // The recorded rounds' state, every kind's, and the blocking calls' count:
  // grid-independent words.
  VKC_ASSIGN(map.rounds_state_,
             core::device_storage_buffer(
                 allocator, 3 * kStateWords * sizeof(std::uint32_t)));
  VKC_ASSIGN(map.host_count_,
             core::device_storage_buffer(allocator, sizeof(std::uint32_t)));

  // A 1-D dispatch's groupCountX is capped by maxComputeWorkGroupCount[0] (>=
  // 65535 guaranteed); cache it for the dispatches that split or refuse past
  // it (see max_workgroup_count_x_).
  VkPhysicalDeviceProperties props{};
  vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(device.physical_device(), &props);
  map.max_workgroup_count_x_ = props.limits.maxComputeWorkGroupCount[0];
  // The device-span collector, created once rather than per call: a query pool
  // of a few timestamps costs nothing and a diagnostic that can fail on first
  // use is worse. A pool that will not allocate degrades to unavailable inside
  // create() rather than failing here -- see GpuTimer.
  VKC_ASSIGN(map.gpu_timer_, core::GpuTimer::create(device));
  map.max_storage_buffer_range_ = props.limits.maxStorageBufferRange;

  // Build every kernel's layout + pipeline and size the shared pool_ to them
  // via KernelSetBuilder (core/vulkan/compute_kernel.hpp) -- one add() per
  // shader, its storage-buffer binding count matching that shader's set 0.
  // Every kernel pushes the shared PushConstants block. allocate-from-coords
  // has 8 bindings, the rounds' state last; depth adds the camera-params
  // buffer at binding 6 (8 bindings), delete its done flags there and the
  // rounds' state at 8 (9); frustum compaction adds the planes buffer at
  // binding 3 (4 bindings). The stamps go last in every kernel that writes
  // them but the two the rounds drive: init's 4, the allocators' and delete's
  // after their own inputs. Each kind's rounds kernel has 7 bindings and its
  // own push block.
  VkPushConstantRange push{};
  push.stageFlags = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT;
  push.offset = 0;
  push.size = sizeof(PushConstants);
  VkPushConstantRange rounds_push = push;
  rounds_push.size = sizeof(RoundsPush);

  core::KernelSetBuilder kb(device);
  VKC_TRY(kb.add(map.init_, "hash_init", vgrid_hash_init_comp_spv,
                 vgrid_hash_init_comp_spv_size, 5, &push));
  VKC_TRY(kb.add(map.allocate_, "hash_allocate_coords",
                 vgrid_hash_allocate_coords_comp_spv,
                 vgrid_hash_allocate_coords_comp_spv_size, 8, &push));
  VKC_TRY(kb.add(map.compact_, "hash_compact", vgrid_hash_compact_comp_spv,
                 vgrid_hash_compact_comp_spv_size, 3, &push));
  VKC_TRY(kb.add(map.delete_, "hash_delete_coords",
                 vgrid_hash_delete_coords_comp_spv,
                 vgrid_hash_delete_coords_comp_spv_size, 9, &push));
  VKC_TRY(kb.add(map.remove_rounds_, "hash_remove_rounds",
                 vgrid_hash_rounds_comp_spv, vgrid_hash_rounds_comp_spv_size, 7,
                 &rounds_push));
  VKC_TRY(kb.add(map.allocate_rounds_, "hash_allocate_rounds",
                 vgrid_hash_rounds_comp_spv, vgrid_hash_rounds_comp_spv_size, 7,
                 &rounds_push));
  VKC_TRY(kb.add(map.depth_rounds_, "hash_depth_rounds",
                 vgrid_hash_rounds_comp_spv, vgrid_hash_rounds_comp_spv_size, 7,
                 &rounds_push));
  VKC_TRY(kb.add(map.depth_, "hash_allocate_depth",
                 vgrid_hash_allocate_depth_comp_spv,
                 vgrid_hash_allocate_depth_comp_spv_size, 8, &push));
  VKC_TRY(kb.add(map.triangles_, "hash_allocate_triangles",
                 vgrid_hash_allocate_triangles_comp_spv,
                 vgrid_hash_allocate_triangles_comp_spv_size, 9, &push));
  VKC_TRY(kb.add(map.compact_frustum_, "hash_compact_frustum",
                 vgrid_hash_compact_frustum_comp_spv,
                 vgrid_hash_compact_frustum_comp_spv_size, 4, &push));
  VKC_TRY(kb.add(map.rehash_, "hash_rehash", vgrid_hash_rehash_comp_spv,
                 vgrid_hash_rehash_comp_spv_size, 6, &push));
  VKC_ASSIGN(map.pool_, kb.build());

  // Point every set at the persistent buffers (the per-call coords buffer is
  // written before each allocate/delete dispatch). Shared with resize().
  map.write_persistent_bindings();

  VKC_TRY(map.init_table());
  return map;
}

void VoxelHashMap::write_persistent_bindings() {
  // Bindings 0-3 (the table) are identical across the init, allocate, delete,
  // points, and triangles sets. The allocate-family sets (allocate / delete /
  // points / triangles) additionally share the fail-counts buffer at binding
  // 5 -- they never run in the same dispatch, and each re-zeroes it before
  // use. Their per-call input (coords / points at binding 4, delete's done
  // flags at 6, vertices+indices+offsets at 4+6+7) is written before each
  // dispatch. The depth kernel's sets (depth_sets_) are written whole by each
  // allocate_from_depth. Compact uses entries + the compaction output + its
  // counter.
  const VkBuffer entries = entries_.handle();
  const VkBuffer heap = heap_.handle();
  const VkBuffer counter = heap_counter_.handle();
  const VkBuffer mutex = bucket_mutex_.handle();
  for (const core::DescriptorSet* set :
       {&init_.set, &allocate_.set, &delete_.set, &triangles_.set,
        &rehash_.set}) {
    set->write_storage_buffer(0, entries, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    set->write_storage_buffer(1, heap, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    set->write_storage_buffer(2, counter, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    set->write_storage_buffer(3, mutex, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  }
  const VkBuffer fail = fail_counts_.handle();
  for (const core::DescriptorSet* set :
       {&allocate_.set, &delete_.set, &triangles_.set, &rehash_.set}) {
    set->write_storage_buffer(5, fail, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  }
  const VkBuffer stamps = stamps_.handle();
  init_.set.write_storage_buffer(4, stamps, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  allocate_.set.write_storage_buffer(6, stamps, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  delete_.set.write_storage_buffer(7, stamps, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  // The rounds: their state, which the two kernels they drive read their
  // count from, and the tally and heap counter they judge.
  const VkBuffer rounds = rounds_state_.handle();
  allocate_.set.write_storage_buffer(7, rounds, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  delete_.set.write_storage_buffer(8, rounds, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  for (const core::DescriptorSet* set :
       {&remove_rounds_.set, &allocate_rounds_.set, &depth_rounds_.set}) {
    set->write_storage_buffer(2, fail, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    set->write_storage_buffer(3, rounds, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    set->write_storage_buffer(4, counter, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  }
  // A depth round's judge reads no count and sizes no slices: its count and
  // slices bindings name buffers it never touches.
  depth_rounds_.set.write_storage_buffer(0, rounds, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  depth_rounds_.set.write_storage_buffer(5, host_count_.handle(), 0,
                                         VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  triangles_.set.write_storage_buffer(8, stamps, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  compact_.set.write_storage_buffer(0, entries, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  compact_.set.write_storage_buffer(1, compacted_.handle(), 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  compact_.set.write_storage_buffer(2, active_count_.handle(), 0,
                                    VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  // Frustum compaction shares the counter with plain compact but writes an
  // output of its own; its frusta buffer (binding 3) is persistent, rewritten
  // per call.
  compact_frustum_.set.write_storage_buffer(0, entries, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  compact_frustum_.set.write_storage_buffer(1, frustum_compacted_.handle(), 0,
                                            VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  compact_frustum_.set.write_storage_buffer(2, active_count_.handle(), 0,
                                            VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  compact_frustum_.set.write_storage_buffer(3, frustum_planes_.handle(), 0,
                                            VK_WHOLE_SIZE);

  // Name each buffer for a GPU capture, here rather than at create: this runs
  // on every path that swaps a buffer in -- create AND each resize commit --
  // so a name cannot drift from the handle it describes. (A grown table is a
  // fresh handle, and a name lives on the handle.)
  if (device_ != nullptr) {
    const struct {
      VkBuffer handle;
      const char* name;
    } named[] = {
        {entries, "hash.entries"},
        {heap, "hash.heap"},
        {counter, "hash.heap_counter"},
        {mutex, "hash.bucket_mutex"},
        {fail, "hash.fail_counts"},
        {compacted_.handle(), "hash.compacted"},
        {frustum_compacted_.handle(), "hash.frustum_compacted"},
        {active_count_.handle(), "hash.active_count"},
        {stamps, "hash.stamps"},
        {camera_params_.handle(), "hash.camera_params"},
        {frustum_planes_.handle(), "hash.frustum_planes"},
        {rounds, "hash.rounds_state"},
        {host_count_.handle(), "hash.host_count"},
    };
    for (const auto& entry : named) {
      device_->set_object_name(VK_OBJECT_TYPE_BUFFER,
                               core::debug_object_handle(entry.handle),
                               entry.name);
    }
  }
}

std::uint32_t VoxelHashMap::total_entries() const noexcept {
  return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(grid_.num_buckets) *
         static_cast<std::uint32_t>(grid_.bucket_size);
}

core::Status VoxelHashMap::init_table() {
  const std::uint32_t widest =
      std::max({total_entries(), static_cast<std::uint32_t>(grid_.num_blocks),
                static_cast<std::uint32_t>(grid_.num_buckets)});
  const PushConstants push{grid_, 0, tick_};
  VKC_TRY(core::dispatch(*device_, init_, &push, sizeof(push),
                         group_count(widest), max_workgroup_count_x_));
  // The init kernel hands every block back to the heap, after every
  // recording so far.
  heap_free_ = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(grid_.num_blocks);
  settled_serial_ = record_serial_;
  return {};
}

core::Status VoxelHashMap::rebuild_heap_excluding(
    const std::vector<BlockIndex>& active) {
  const auto num_blocks = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(grid_.num_blocks);
  const auto vpb = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(grid_.voxels_per_block);

  // Mark the block indices the snapshot preserves (ptr = block_idx * vpb, so
  // block_idx = ptr / vpb; the old capacity <= the new, so every index is in
  // range). init_table left the heap holding all indices; overwrite it to hold
  // only the free ones so a future allocation never hands out a live block.
  std::vector<std::uint8_t> used(num_blocks, 0);
  for (const BlockIndex& b : active) {
    used[static_cast<std::uint32_t>(b.ptr) / vpb] = 1;
  }
  std::vector<std::uint32_t> heap;
  heap.reserve(num_blocks);
  for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < num_blocks; ++i) {
    if (used[i] == 0) {
      heap.push_back(i);
    }
  }
  const auto free_count = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(heap.size());
  // TODO(volume): rebuild the heap on the device from the compacted list, so
  // a resize needs no host pass over num_blocks.
  core::CommandBatch batch(*device_, *allocator_);
  VKC_TRY(batch.upload(heap_, 0, heap.data(),
                       VkDeviceSize(free_count) * sizeof(std::uint32_t)));
  VKC_TRY(batch.upload(heap_counter_, 0, &free_count, sizeof(free_count)));
  VKC_TRY(batch.submit());
  heap_free_ = free_count;
  settled_serial_ = record_serial_;
  return {};
}

// Record what `dispatches` records each round, re-dispatching while failures
// remain, up to kMaxRounds.
// Allocations spuriously fail under heavy same-bucket contention (a GPU
// spin-lock livelock within a SIMD group) -- worst where one dispatch makes
// many new blocks, as depth's first frame does. Already-processed elements
// take the lock-free fast path on the next round (allocate / depth / points)
// or are skipped by their done flag (remove), so contention falls and the set
// converges. A round that hit a capacity limit (chain full / heap low / table
// full) ends the loop, contention or not: the caller's answer is to grow and
// dispatch again, and at the limit the contention is mostly threads queued
// behind the inserts that failed, which another round only repeats.
// Contention alone never ends it, since another round is what resolves it.
// Mirrors the prior engine's launchWithRetry.
//
// fail_counts_[kFailTotal] is the shared *retryable* tally, split by reason
// into [1]=lock/[2]=chain/[3]=heap/[5]=table (remove reports only lock);
// re-zeroed each round, since re-dispatching is what is supposed to drive it
// down.
//
// fail_counts_[kFailTerminal] is the failure the loop above cannot resolve, and
// it is accumulated across rounds rather than read from the last one. Only the
// delete kernel reports it: its heap append runs *after* the entry is cleared,
// so a coord whose block could not be returned to the free heap is absent on
// the next round and counts nothing. Reading only the final round would then
// report zero failures over a permanently leaked block index -- the convergence
// heuristic erasing the report instead of resolving it -- so the two are summed
// and the caller sees a non-zero count exactly when something did not complete.
core::Result<std::uint32_t> VoxelHashMap::dispatch_with_retry(
    const std::function<core::Status(core::CommandBatch&)>& dispatches,
    AllocFailures* out_failures,
    const std::function<core::Status(core::CommandBatch&)>& prepare) {
  std::uint32_t failures = 0;
  std::uint32_t terminal = 0;
  for (std::uint32_t round = 0; round < kMaxRounds; ++round) {
    // One submit a round: the call's parameters (the first round only -- they
    // persist), the cleared tally, the dispatch, and the two small results
    // the host decides on -- the tally, and the heap counter behind
    // load_factor().
    std::uint32_t slots[kFailSlots] = {};
    std::uint32_t heap_free = 0;
    core::CommandBatch batch(*device_, *allocator_);
    if (round == 0 && prepare) {
      VKC_TRY(prepare(batch));
    }
    VKC_TRY(batch.fill(fail_counts_, 0, sizeof(slots), 0u));
    VKC_TRY(dispatches(batch));
    VKC_TRY(batch.readback(fail_counts_, 0, sizeof(slots), slots));
    VKC_TRY(batch.readback(heap_counter_, 0, sizeof(heap_free), &heap_free));
    VKC_TRY(batch.submit());
    heap_free_ = heap_free;
    settled_serial_ = record_serial_;
    failures = slots[kFailTotal];
    terminal += slots[kFailTerminal];
    // The retryable reasons describe this round; terminal accumulates, since
    // no later round can restate it.
    const AllocFailures reported{failures,          slots[kFailLock],
                                 slots[kFailChain], slots[kFailHeap],
                                 slots[kFailTable], terminal,
                                 round + 1};
    if (out_failures != nullptr) {
      *out_failures = reported;
    }
    // Only contention is worth another round: nothing frees a block or a slot
    // between rounds, so a capacity limit would fail again.
    if (reported.lock == 0 || reported.capacity_limited()) {
      break;
    }
  }
  return failures + terminal;
}

core::Result<core::Buffer> VoxelHashMap::upload_to_binding(
    core::CommandBatch& batch, const core::DescriptorSet& set,
    std::uint32_t binding, const void* data, VkDeviceSize bytes) {
  VKC_ASSIGN(core::Buffer buf, core::device_storage_buffer(*allocator_, bytes));
  VKC_TRY(batch.upload(buf, 0, data, bytes));
  set.write_storage_buffer(binding, buf.handle(), 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  return buf;  // caller keeps it alive until the batch has run
}

core::Result<RecordedRounds> VoxelHashMap::record_rounds(
    bool removes, core::CommandBatch& batch, const core::Buffer& coords,
    const DeviceCount& count, const DeviceCount* gate,
    core::GpuStageScope* stage,
    const std::function<core::Status(core::CommandBatch&)>& first_round,
    std::uint32_t rounds, bool stale_lists) {
  const std::string op =
      removes ? "VoxelHashMap::record_remove" : "VoxelHashMap::record_allocate";
  if (!valid()) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(op + ": moved-from map");
  }
  if (count.bound == 0) return RecordedRounds{};
  VKC_TRY(check_word(op, count, "count", max_storage_buffer_range_));
  if (gate != nullptr) {
    VKC_TRY(check_word(op, *gate, "gate", max_storage_buffer_range_));
  }
  // The input stays where its producer wrote it, bound for the count's bound,
  // which one storage binding must cover.
  const VkDeviceSize input_bytes =
      VkDeviceSize(count.bound) * sizeof(BlockIndex);
  VKC_TRY(core::StorageInput(coords).check(op.c_str(), input_bytes));
  VKC_TRY(core::check_storage_buffer_range(op.c_str(), input_bytes,
                                           max_storage_buffer_range_));
  VKC_ASSIGN(core::HostSlot slot, claim_result());
  // Each round's slices, for the bound's groups.
  const std::uint32_t per_dispatch =
      volumetric_kit::grid::detail::groups_per_dispatch(max_workgroup_count_x_);
  const std::uint32_t dispatches = volumetric_kit::grid::detail::slice_count(
      count.bound, kLocalSize, per_dispatch);
  core::Buffer& slices = removes ? remove_slices_ : allocate_slices_;
  const VkDeviceSize slice_bytes = VkDeviceSize(kRecordedRounds) * dispatches *
                                   sizeof(VkDispatchIndirectCommand);
  if (slices.size() < slice_bytes) {
    // Every batch this map recorded into before has resolved (the @pre).
    VKC_ASSIGN(slices, core::device_storage_buffer(
                           *allocator_, slice_bytes,
                           VK_BUFFER_USAGE_INDIRECT_BUFFER_BIT));
    device_->set_object_name(
        VK_OBJECT_TYPE_BUFFER, core::debug_object_handle(slices.handle()),
        removes ? "hash.remove_slices" : "hash.allocate_slices");
  }
  const VkDeviceSize done_bytes =
      VkDeviceSize(count.bound) * sizeof(std::uint32_t);
  if (removes) {
    VKC_TRY(core::ensure_device_scratch(*device_, *allocator_, remove_done_,
                                        done_bytes, max_storage_buffer_range_,
                                        "hash.remove_done"));
  }

  // Nothing but the batch refuses from here. A removal moves the topology
  // epoch now, before any index goes back to the heap, so a slot-keyed cache
  // is stale the moment the rounds may run -- whatever they free. A caller's
  // recording of either kind makes every list compacted before it stale too,
  // since the heap's host copy, which holds() compares, moves only at
  // settle. The blocking calls settle before anything can ask, so an
  // allocation of blocks already there leaves a list holding.
  if (removes) topology_epoch_ = next_topology_epoch();
  if (stale_lists) {
    ++compaction_serial_;
    ++frustum_serial_;
  }
  if (removes) VKC_TRY(batch.fill(remove_done_, 0, done_bytes, 0u));
  if (first_round) VKC_TRY(first_round(batch));
  VKC_ASSIGN(const VkBuffer result,
             batch.output(slot, 0, sizeof(RoundsResult)));
  core::ComputeKernel& judge = removes ? remove_rounds_ : allocate_rounds_;
  core::ComputeKernel& kernel = removes ? delete_ : allocate_;
  judge.set.write_storage_buffer(0, count.buffer->handle(), 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  judge.set.write_storage_buffer(
      1, gate != nullptr ? gate->buffer->handle() : rounds_state_.handle(), 0,
      VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  judge.set.write_storage_buffer(5, slices.handle(), 0, slice_bytes);
  judge.set.write_storage_buffer(6, result, 0, sizeof(RoundsResult));
  kernel.set.write_storage_buffer(4, coords.handle(), 0, input_bytes);
  if (removes) {
    kernel.set.write_storage_buffer(6, remove_done_.handle(), 0, done_bytes);
  }
  RoundsPush sizing{
      static_cast<std::uint32_t>(count.offset / 4),
      gate != nullptr ? static_cast<std::uint32_t>(gate->offset / 4) : kNoWord,
      count.bound,
      removes ? 0 : kStateWords,
      0,
      rounds,
      per_dispatch,
      dispatches};
  const PushConstants push{grid_, sizing.state_word, tick_};
  for (std::uint32_t r = 0; r <= rounds; ++r) {
    sizing.round = r;
    VKC_TRY(batch.dispatch(judge, &sizing, sizeof(sizing), 1,
                           max_workgroup_count_x_, stage));
    if (r == rounds) break;  // that was the gather
    const volumetric_kit::grid::detail::IndirectSlices round{
        &slices,
        VkDeviceSize(r) * dispatches * sizeof(VkDispatchIndirectCommand),
        dispatches, per_dispatch, kLocalSize};
    VKC_TRY(volumetric_kit::grid::detail::dispatch_slices(batch, kernel, push,
                                                          round, stage));
  }
  return RecordedRounds{std::move(slot), ++record_serial_};
}

core::Result<core::HostSlot> VoxelHashMap::claim_result() {
  if (results_ == nullptr) {
    core::HostRingDesc desc;
    desc.slot_bytes = sizeof(RoundsResult);
    desc.slots = kResultSlots;
    desc.name = "hash.rounds_result";
    VKC_ASSIGN(results_, core::HostRing::create(*device_, *allocator_, desc));
  }
  return results_->claim(sizeof(RoundsResult));
}

core::Result<std::uint32_t> VoxelHashMap::run_rounds(
    bool removes, const core::Buffer& coords, std::uint32_t count,
    AllocFailures* out_failures,
    const std::function<core::Status(core::CommandBatch&)>& first_round,
    core::GpuStageScope* stage) {
  if (!valid()) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(
        std::string(removes ? "VoxelHashMap::remove"
                            : "VoxelHashMap::allocate") +
        ": moved-from map");
  }
  if (count == 0) return std::uint32_t{0};
  // Only contention is worth another recording: nothing frees a block or a
  // slot between them, so a capacity limit would fail again. The retryable
  // reasons are the last round's; terminal failures and rounds add up.
  AllocFailures last;
  std::uint32_t terminal = 0;
  std::uint32_t rounds = 0;
  while (rounds < kMaxRounds) {
    core::CommandBatch batch(*device_, *allocator_);
    VKC_TRY(batch.upload(host_count_, 0, &count, sizeof(count)));
    VKC_ASSIGN(const RecordedRounds recorded,
               record_rounds(
                   removes, batch, coords, DeviceCount{&host_count_, 0, count},
                   nullptr, stage, rounds == 0 ? first_round : FirstRound(),
                   std::min(kRecordedRounds, kMaxRounds - rounds), false));
    VKC_TRY(batch.submit());
    VKC_ASSIGN(last, settle(recorded));
    terminal += last.terminal;
    rounds += last.rounds;
    if (last.rounds == 0 || last.lock == 0 || last.capacity_limited()) break;
  }
  last.terminal = terminal;
  last.rounds = rounds;
  if (out_failures != nullptr) *out_failures = last;
  return last.total + terminal;
}

core::Result<RecordedRounds> VoxelHashMap::record_allocate(
    core::CommandBatch& batch, const core::Buffer& coords,
    const DeviceCount& count, const DeviceCount* gate,
    core::GpuStageScope* stage) {
  return record_rounds(false, batch, coords, count, gate, stage, nullptr,
                       kRecordedRounds, true);
}

core::Result<RecordedRounds> VoxelHashMap::record_remove(
    core::CommandBatch& batch, const core::Buffer& coords,
    const DeviceCount& count, const DeviceCount* gate,
    core::GpuStageScope* stage,
    const std::function<core::Status(core::CommandBatch&)>& first_round) {
  return record_rounds(true, batch, coords, count, gate, stage, first_round,
                       kRecordedRounds, true);
}

core::Result<AllocFailures> VoxelHashMap::settle(const RecordedRounds& rounds) {
  if (!valid()) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(
        "VoxelHashMap::settle: moved-from map");
  }
  if (!rounds.result.valid()) return AllocFailures{};
  RoundsResult r;
  std::memcpy(&r, rounds.result.data(), sizeof(r));
  // The counter as the latest recording left it: an older one, or one a
  // blocking call has overtaken since, leaves the copy as it is.
  if (rounds.serial > settled_serial_) {
    heap_free_ = r.heap_free;
    settled_serial_ = rounds.serial;
  }
  return AllocFailures{r.total, r.lock,     r.chain, r.heap,
                       r.table, r.terminal, r.rounds};
}

core::Result<std::uint32_t> VoxelHashMap::allocate(const core::Buffer& coords,
                                                   std::uint32_t count,
                                                   AllocFailures* out_failures,
                                                   core::GpuStageScope* stage) {
  return run_rounds(false, coords, count, out_failures, nullptr, stage);
}

core::Result<std::uint32_t> VoxelHashMap::allocate_from_depth(
    const float* depth, const DepthPinhole& camera, AllocFailures* out_failures,
    core::StageMetrics* metrics) {
  return allocate_from_depth({DepthInput{core::StorageInput(depth), camera}},
                             out_failures, metrics);
}

core::Result<std::uint32_t> VoxelHashMap::allocate_from_depth(
    const core::Buffer& depth, const DepthPinhole& camera,
    AllocFailures* out_failures, core::StageMetrics* metrics) {
  return allocate_from_depth({DepthInput{core::StorageInput(depth), camera}},
                             out_failures, metrics);
}

core::Result<std::uint32_t> VoxelHashMap::allocate_from_depth(
    const std::vector<DepthInput>& frames, AllocFailures* out_failures,
    core::StageMetrics* metrics) {
  // Before the validity check, so a refused call still costs its row -- a stage
  // silent on failure reads as one that did not run. Inert when null, and it
  // publishes both halves on every return below, including the failing ones.
  core::GpuStageScope stage(metrics, gpu_timer_, "allocate");
  // A host array's device copy, made by the first round's batch and bound by
  // every round after.
  std::vector<core::Buffer> uploads(frames.size());
  // Only contention is worth another round: nothing frees a block or a slot
  // between rounds, so a capacity limit would fail again. The retryable
  // reasons are the last round's; terminal failures and rounds add up.
  AllocFailures last;
  std::uint32_t rounds = 0;
  while (rounds < kMaxRounds) {
    core::CommandBatch batch(*device_, *allocator_);
    VKC_ASSIGN(const RecordedRounds recorded,
               record_depth(batch, frames, uploads, nullptr, &stage));
    if (!recorded.result.valid()) break;  // no frame has pixels
    VKC_TRY(batch.submit());
    VKC_ASSIGN(last, settle(recorded));
    rounds += last.rounds;
    if (last.lock == 0 || last.capacity_limited()) break;
  }
  last.rounds = rounds;
  if (out_failures != nullptr) *out_failures = last;
  return last.total + last.terminal;
}

core::Result<RecordedRounds> VoxelHashMap::record_allocate_from_depth(
    core::CommandBatch& batch, const std::vector<DepthInput>& frames,
    const DeviceCount* gate, core::GpuStageScope* stage) {
  std::vector<core::Buffer> uploads(frames.size());
  VKC_ASSIGN(RecordedRounds recorded,
             record_depth(batch, frames, uploads, gate, stage));
  // A host array's copy, which the batch's commands read, goes with it.
  for (core::Buffer& upload : uploads) batch.retain(std::move(upload));
  return recorded;
}

core::Result<RecordedRounds> VoxelHashMap::record_depth(
    core::CommandBatch& batch, const std::vector<DepthInput>& frames,
    std::vector<core::Buffer>& uploads, const DeviceCount* gate,
    core::GpuStageScope* stage) {
  const std::string op = "VoxelHashMap::allocate_from_depth";
  if (!valid()) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(op + ": moved-from map");
  }
  // Every frame checked before any work. The shader indexes a pixel as
  // v*width + u in 32 bits, so an image past 2^32 pixels is refused here
  // rather than wrapped. A frame with no pixels dispatches nothing.
  std::vector<std::size_t> live;  // the frames that dispatch, in order
  std::vector<std::uint32_t> pixels(frames.size(), 0);
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < frames.size(); ++i) {
    const DepthPinhole& camera = frames[i].camera;
    const std::uint64_t count =
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(camera.width) * camera.height;
    if (count > std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()) {
      return core::Status::invalid_argument(op + ": width*height exceeds 2^32");
    }
    const VkDeviceSize bytes = VkDeviceSize(count) * sizeof(float);
    VKC_TRY(frames[i].depth.check("VoxelHashMap::allocate_from_depth: depth",
                                  bytes));
    if (count == 0) continue;
    VKC_TRY(core::check_storage_buffer_range(
        "VoxelHashMap::allocate_from_depth: the depth buffer", bytes,
        max_storage_buffer_range_));
    pixels[i] = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(count);
    live.push_back(i);
  }
  if (gate != nullptr) {
    VKC_TRY(check_word(op, *gate, "gate", max_storage_buffer_range_));
  }
  if (live.empty()) return RecordedRounds{};
  const auto count = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(live.size());
  const VkDeviceSize camera_bytes = VkDeviceSize(count) * camera_stride_;
  VKC_TRY(core::check_storage_buffer_range(
      "VoxelHashMap::allocate_from_depth: the cameras", camera_bytes,
      max_storage_buffer_range_));
  // A set a frame, every camera a stride apart in one buffer (every batch
  // this map recorded into before has resolved, the @pre, so a grown one
  // replaces it), and a result slot.
  VKC_TRY(depth_sets_.reserve(*device_, depth_, count));
  if (camera_params_.size() < camera_bytes) {
    VKC_ASSIGN(camera_params_,
               core::device_storage_buffer(*allocator_, camera_bytes));
    device_->set_object_name(VK_OBJECT_TYPE_BUFFER,
                             core::debug_object_handle(camera_params_.handle()),
                             "hash.camera_params");
  }
  VKC_ASSIGN(core::HostSlot slot, claim_result());

  // Nothing but the batch refuses from here. Every list compacted before is
  // stale now, as record_allocate makes it.
  ++compaction_serial_;
  ++frustum_serial_;
  // Every camera first, in one inline write, ahead of the round's first
  // dispatch, so MoltenVK opens no blit encoder between the frames. It is
  // not the batch's first: a sender's set prep comes before it.
  std::vector<std::uint8_t> cameras(static_cast<std::size_t>(camera_bytes), 0);
  for (std::size_t k = 0; k < live.size(); ++k) {
    std::memcpy(cameras.data() + k * camera_stride_, &frames[live[k]].camera,
                sizeof(DepthPinhole));
  }
  VKC_TRY(batch.upload(camera_params_, 0, cameras.data(), camera_bytes));
  // Every binding of every set, so a set another call wrote, or one a resize
  // left naming freed buffers, is whole again. Each frame's depth is the
  // caller's buffer, or a host array's device copy in `uploads`, staged by
  // the first round that needs it and bound as it is by the rounds after.
  for (std::size_t k = 0; k < live.size(); ++k) {
    const std::size_t i = live[k];
    const VkDeviceSize bytes = VkDeviceSize(pixels[i]) * sizeof(float);
    VkBuffer depth = uploads[i].handle();
    if (!uploads[i].valid()) {
      VKC_ASSIGN(depth,
                 frames[i].depth.buffer(batch, *allocator_, bytes, uploads[i]));
    }
    const core::DescriptorSet& set = depth_sets_[k];
    set.write_storage_buffer(0, entries_.handle(), 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    set.write_storage_buffer(1, heap_.handle(), 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    set.write_storage_buffer(2, heap_counter_.handle(), 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    set.write_storage_buffer(3, bucket_mutex_.handle(), 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    set.write_storage_buffer(4, depth, 0, bytes);
    set.write_storage_buffer(5, fail_counts_.handle(), 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    set.write_storage_buffer(6, camera_params_.handle(), k * camera_stride_,
                             sizeof(DepthPinhole));
    set.write_storage_buffer(7, stamps_.handle(), 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  }
  // The round between the judge's two passes: the first clears the tally,
  // the second gathers it with the heap counter and closes the gate on any
  // failure. Its count is a bound of 1 with no word: one round, sizing
  // nothing, since every frame's dispatch is direct. The first reads no
  // gate, so the round is judged whatever the gate held before it.
  VKC_ASSIGN(const VkBuffer result,
             batch.output(slot, 0, sizeof(RoundsResult)));
  depth_rounds_.set.write_storage_buffer(
      1, gate != nullptr ? gate->buffer->handle() : rounds_state_.handle(), 0,
      VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
  depth_rounds_.set.write_storage_buffer(6, result, 0, sizeof(RoundsResult));
  RoundsPush judge{
      kNoWord,
      kNoWord,
      1,
      kDepthStateWord,
      0,
      1,
      volumetric_kit::grid::detail::groups_per_dispatch(max_workgroup_count_x_),
      0};
  VKC_TRY(batch.dispatch(depth_rounds_, &judge, sizeof(judge), 1,
                         max_workgroup_count_x_, stage));
  // TODO(volume): re-dispatch only the frames that failed, from a tally of
  // each frame's own, if retries stay common after PERF.md's P3
  // (DECISIONS.md, 2026-09-30).
  for (std::size_t k = 0; k < live.size(); ++k) {
    const DepthTiles tiles = depth_tiles(frames[live[k]].camera);
    const PushConstants push{grid_, tiles.x, tick_};
    VKC_TRY(batch.dispatch(depth_, depth_sets_[k], &push, sizeof(push),
                           tiles.total, max_workgroup_count_x_, stage));
  }
  judge.round = 1;
  if (gate != nullptr) {
    judge.gate_word = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(gate->offset / 4);
  }
  VKC_TRY(batch.dispatch(depth_rounds_, &judge, sizeof(judge), 1,
                         max_workgroup_count_x_, stage));
  return RecordedRounds{std::move(slot), ++record_serial_};
}

core::Result<std::uint32_t> VoxelHashMap::allocate_from_triangles(
    const Vec3f* vertices, std::uint32_t vertex_count,
    const std::uint32_t* indices, std::uint32_t triangle_count,
    AllocFailures* out_failures, core::StageMetrics* metrics) {
  // Before the validity check, as allocate_from_depth: a refused call still
  // costs its row, and here the row's CPU half is the point -- the host pass
  // below is the one part of this call a GPU capture cannot see.
  core::GpuStageScope stage(metrics, gpu_timer_, "allocate");
  if (!valid()) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(
        "VoxelHashMap::allocate_from_triangles: moved-from map");
  }
  if (triangle_count == 0) {
    return std::uint32_t{0};
  }

  // The host pass: one candidate-block count per triangle, as an exclusive
  // prefix sum (see triangle_candidate_offsets). It buys the kernel a uniform
  // work item, and it is where every index is bounds-checked and a degenerate
  // or non-finite triangle is dropped.
  VKC_ASSIGN(std::vector<std::uint32_t> offsets,
             triangle_candidate_offsets(
                 grid_, vertices, vertex_count, indices, triangle_count,
                 "VoxelHashMap::allocate_from_triangles"));
  const std::uint32_t total = offsets[triangle_count];
  if (total == 0) {
    return std::uint32_t{0};  // every triangle degenerate or non-finite
  }

  // Three transient inputs (the mesh is per-call and variable), each bound
  // whole, so each is checked against what one binding may cover.
  const VkDeviceSize vertex_bytes = VkDeviceSize(vertex_count) * sizeof(Vec3f);
  const VkDeviceSize index_bytes =
      VkDeviceSize(triangle_count) * 3 * sizeof(std::uint32_t);
  const VkDeviceSize offset_bytes =
      VkDeviceSize(offsets.size()) * sizeof(std::uint32_t);
  VKC_TRY(core::check_storage_buffer_range(
      "VoxelHashMap::allocate_from_triangles: the vertex buffer", vertex_bytes,
      max_storage_buffer_range_));
  VKC_TRY(core::check_storage_buffer_range(
      "VoxelHashMap::allocate_from_triangles: the index buffer", index_bytes,
      max_storage_buffer_range_));
  VKC_TRY(core::check_storage_buffer_range(
      "VoxelHashMap::allocate_from_triangles: the offset buffer", offset_bytes,
      max_storage_buffer_range_));
  core::Buffer vertex_buf, index_buf, offset_buf;  // alive across every round

  // pc.arg is the TRIANGLE count (the kernel's binary-search bound), not the
  // dispatch width -- the kernel reads that from offsets[pc.arg]. A mesh's
  // candidates can pass 16.7 M, 65535 groups of 256, so they may take several
  // dispatches.
  const PushConstants push{grid_, triangle_count, tick_};
  return dispatch_with_retry(
      [&](core::CommandBatch& batch) {
        return volumetric_kit::grid::detail::dispatch_items(
            batch, triangles_, push, total, kLocalSize, max_workgroup_count_x_,
            &stage);
      },
      out_failures,
      [&](core::CommandBatch& batch) -> core::Status {
        VKC_ASSIGN(vertex_buf, upload_to_binding(batch, triangles_.set, 4,
                                                 vertices, vertex_bytes));
        VKC_ASSIGN(index_buf, upload_to_binding(batch, triangles_.set, 6,
                                                indices, index_bytes));
        VKC_ASSIGN(offset_buf, upload_to_binding(batch, triangles_.set, 7,
                                                 offsets.data(), offset_bytes));
        return {};
      });
}

core::Result<std::uint32_t> VoxelHashMap::remove(
    const core::Buffer& coords, std::uint32_t count,
    AllocFailures* out_failures,
    const std::function<core::Status(core::CommandBatch&)>& first_round,
    core::GpuStageScope* stage) {
  return run_rounds(true, coords, count, out_failures, first_round, stage);
}

core::Result<RecordedBlockList> VoxelHashMap::record_compaction(
    core::CommandBatch& batch, const std::vector<FrustumPlanes>* frusta,
    core::GpuStageScope* stage) const {
  if (!valid()) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(
        "VoxelHashMap::record_compaction: moved-from map");
  }
  if (frusta != nullptr) {
    VKC_TRY(core::check_storage_buffer_range(
        "VoxelHashMap::record_compaction: the frusta",
        sizeof(std::uint32_t) +
            VkDeviceSize(frusta->size()) * sizeof(FrustumPlanes),
        max_storage_buffer_range_));
    VKC_TRY(upload_frusta(batch, frusta->data(),
                          static_cast<std::uint32_t>(frusta->size())));
  }
  const bool culled = frusta != nullptr;
  const core::Buffer& out = culled ? frustum_compacted_ : compacted_;
  // The active set is at most num_blocks entries; the persistent output buffer
  // is sized to that upper bound, so no grow/retry is needed for this slice.
  const auto capacity = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(grid_.num_blocks);
  const PushConstants push{grid_, capacity, tick_};
  // Before the submit, which may have run in part.
  ++(culled ? frustum_serial_ : compaction_serial_);
  VKC_TRY(batch.fill(active_count_, 0, sizeof(std::uint32_t), 0u));
  VKC_TRY(batch.dispatch(culled ? compact_frustum_ : compact_, &push,
                         sizeof(push), group_count(total_entries()),
                         max_workgroup_count_x_, stage));
  return RecordedBlockList{&out, &active_count_};
}

core::Result<std::uint32_t> VoxelHashMap::compact_into_device_list(
    const std::vector<FrustumPlanes>* frusta, core::GpuStageScope* stage,
    BlockIndex* head, std::uint32_t head_count) {
  std::uint32_t count = 0;
  core::CommandBatch batch(*device_, *allocator_);
  VKC_ASSIGN(const RecordedBlockList list,
             record_compaction(batch, frusta, stage));
  VKC_TRY(batch.readback(active_count_, 0, sizeof(count), &count));
  VKC_TRY(batch.readback(*list.buffer, 0,
                         VkDeviceSize(head_count) * sizeof(BlockIndex), head));
  VKC_TRY(batch.submit());
  return std::min(count, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(grid_.num_blocks));
}

core::Result<std::vector<BlockIndex>> VoxelHashMap::collect_compacted(
    core::GpuStageScope* stage) {
  // The list comes back beside its count, as far as a guess a quarter past
  // this kernel's last count, so a set that has not outgrown it costs one
  // submit rather than two (0.38 ms each on an RTX 5090).
  // TODO(volume): size the extract's dispatch on the device, as the fuse's is
  // (record_compaction), so no count reaches the host either.
  const std::uint32_t guess =
      static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::min<std::uint64_t>(
          grid_.num_blocks,
          std::uint64_t(last_active_count_) + last_active_count_ / 4));
  std::vector<BlockIndex> active(guess);
  VKC_ASSIGN(const std::uint32_t count,
             compact_into_device_list(nullptr, stage, active.data(), guess));
  last_active_count_ = count;
  active.resize(count);
  if (count > guess) {
    // It outgrew the guess: the rest in a second submit.
    core::CommandBatch batch(*device_, *allocator_);
    VKC_TRY(batch.readback(compacted_, VkDeviceSize(guess) * sizeof(BlockIndex),
                           VkDeviceSize(count - guess) * sizeof(BlockIndex),
                           active.data() + guess));
    VKC_TRY(batch.submit());
  }
  return active;
}

// "active set" rather than "compact": rows merge by content, and the mesh tier
// names its own compaction "  ..compact" (the `row` its extract passes). Two
// stages' compactions summed under one row is the collision kBreakdownPrefix
// exists to avoid, not to cause.
//
// Which of the two names applies is the caller's nesting, not this call's:
// under a fusion tier's open stage the host span is already counted by that
// stage's row, so the sub-row must carry the prefix to stay out of
// total_cpu_ms; at top level the same row would then be counted by no total at
// all, so it is named as the stage it is.
const char* VoxelHashMap::active_set_row(
    const core::StageMetrics* metrics) noexcept {
  return metrics != nullptr && metrics->in_stage() ? "  ..active set"
                                                   : "active set";
}

core::Result<std::vector<BlockIndex>> VoxelHashMap::compact_active_blocks(
    core::StageMetrics* metrics) {
  core::GpuStageScope stage(metrics, gpu_timer_, active_set_row(metrics));
  if (!valid()) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(
        "VoxelHashMap::compact_active_blocks: moved-from map");
  }
  return collect_compacted(&stage);
}

core::Result<DeviceBlockList> VoxelHashMap::compact_active_blocks_on_device(
    core::StageMetrics* metrics, const char* row) {
  // Above the row: a list that still holds is no compaction, so none is
  // reported.
  if (const std::optional<DeviceBlockList> held = held_device_list()) {
    return *held;
  }
  core::GpuStageScope stage(metrics, gpu_timer_,
                            row != nullptr ? row : active_set_row(metrics));
  if (!valid()) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(
        "VoxelHashMap::compact_active_blocks_on_device: moved-from map");
  }
  VKC_ASSIGN(const std::uint32_t count,
             compact_into_device_list(nullptr, &stage));
  last_device_list_ = DeviceBlockList{&compacted_, count, topology_epoch_,
                                      compaction_serial_, heap_free_};
  return last_device_list_;
}

std::optional<DeviceBlockList> VoxelHashMap::held_device_list() const noexcept {
  if (!valid() || !holds(last_device_list_)) return std::nullopt;
  return last_device_list_;
}

// The epoch moves on a remove or clear, the serial on any compaction into the
// list's buffer or a resize, and the heap's free count on an allocation: within
// one epoch it only falls.
bool VoxelHashMap::holds(const DeviceBlockList& list) const noexcept {
  const bool active = list.buffer == &compacted_;
  if (!active && list.buffer != &frustum_compacted_) return false;
  return list.epoch == topology_epoch_ &&
         list.serial == (active ? compaction_serial_ : frustum_serial_) &&
         list.heap_free == heap_free_;
}

core::Status VoxelHashMap::check_device_block_list(const DeviceBlockList& list,
                                                   const char* who) const {
  if (list.count != 0 && valid() && list.buffer == &frustum_compacted_) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(
        std::string(who) +
        ": the device block list is frustum-culled, not the map's active set");
  }
  return check_device_block_subset(list, who);
}

core::Status VoxelHashMap::check_device_block_subset(
    const DeviceBlockList& list, const char* who) const {
  if (list.count == 0) return {};
  if (!valid()) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(std::string(who) +
                                          ": moved-from map");
  }
  if (list.buffer != &compacted_ && list.buffer != &frustum_compacted_) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(
        std::string(who) +
        ": the device block list is not this map's, or the map has moved "
        "since it was compacted");
  }
  if (!holds(list)) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(
        std::string(who) +
        ": the device block list is stale: the map has compacted, allocated, "
        "resized, removed or cleared since");
  }
  return {};
}

core::Result<DeviceBlockList>
VoxelHashMap::compact_active_blocks_in_frusta_on_device(
    const std::vector<FrustumPlanes>& frusta, core::StageMetrics* metrics) {
  core::GpuStageScope stage(metrics, gpu_timer_, active_set_row(metrics));
  if (!valid()) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(
        "VoxelHashMap::compact_active_blocks_in_frusta_on_device: moved-from "
        "map");
  }
  VKC_ASSIGN(const std::uint32_t kept,
             compact_into_device_list(&frusta, &stage));
  return DeviceBlockList{&frustum_compacted_, kept, topology_epoch_,
                         frustum_serial_, heap_free_};
}

core::Status VoxelHashMap::upload_frusta(core::CommandBatch& batch,
                                         const FrustumPlanes* frusta,
                                         std::uint32_t count) const {
  const VkDeviceSize bytes = VkDeviceSize(count) * sizeof(FrustumPlanes);
  if (frustum_planes_.size() < sizeof(count) + bytes) {
    // record_compaction's precondition: no batch that bound the old buffer is
    // still pending, so nothing reads it, and this batch has not yet recorded
    // the dispatch that binds the new one. Nothing here can check it: a grow
    // under a batch still running rewrites its set and frees its buffer.
    VKC_ASSIGN(frustum_planes_,
               core::device_storage_buffer(*allocator_, sizeof(count) + bytes));
    compact_frustum_.set.write_storage_buffer(3, frustum_planes_.handle(), 0,
                                              VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    device_->set_object_name(
        VK_OBJECT_TYPE_BUFFER,
        core::debug_object_handle(frustum_planes_.handle()),
        "hash.frustum_planes");
  }
  VKC_TRY(batch.upload(frustum_planes_, 0, &count, sizeof(count)));
  if (count == 0) return {};
  return batch.upload(frustum_planes_, sizeof(count), frusta, bytes);
}

core::Status VoxelHashMap::clear() {
  if (!valid()) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(
        "VoxelHashMap::clear: moved-from map");
  }
  // Every index is about to go back to the heap, so every slot-keyed cache is
  // stale. Drawn before init_table for the same reason remove draws before its
  // dispatch. init_table itself must NOT draw: resize calls it too, and a
  // resize preserves block indices (see topology_epoch()).
  topology_epoch_ = next_topology_epoch();
  return init_table();
}

std::uint64_t VoxelHashMap::next_topology_epoch() noexcept {
  // Process-wide, so a token identifies a table's topology across the whole
  // program rather than within one object -- which is what makes an anchor
  // holding a stale token unrevivable by any later map. Atomic because nothing
  // stops two threads from building or mutating two different grids at once;
  // relaxed because the only thing required of it is that the values differ,
  // not that they order anything.
  //
  // Pre-incremented from 0, so the first token is 1 and a default-initialized
  // (moved-from, or never-created) member never equals a live one.
  static std::atomic<std::uint64_t> counter{0};
  return counter.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed) + 1;
}

core::Status VoxelHashMap::resize(std::int32_t new_num_buckets) {
  if (!valid()) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(
        "VoxelHashMap::resize: moved-from map");
  }
  if (new_num_buckets <= grid_.num_buckets) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(
        "VoxelHashMap::resize: new_num_buckets must exceed the current count");
  }

  // Snapshot the active blocks before growing (compact reads the old table).
  VKC_ASSIGN(std::vector<BlockIndex> active, compact_active_blocks());

  // The grown grid: num_blocks == bucket_size * num_buckets (one block per
  // slot). validate() re-checks that invariant AND that num_blocks *
  // voxels_per_block still fits a signed 32-bit block pointer -- before any
  // mutation, so an over-large grow fails here with the live map untouched.
  VoxelGridParams new_grid = grid_;
  new_grid.num_buckets = new_num_buckets;
  // Widened before the cast. A uint32 product silently wraps, and it used to
  // wrap into a num_blocks that validate() -- which computed the same narrow
  // product -- then agreed with, so an over-large grow passed both checks and
  // sized the entries buffer from the wrapped value while the kernels indexed
  // it by the unwrapped bucket count.
  const std::int64_t new_num_blocks =
      static_cast<std::int64_t>(new_num_buckets) * grid_.bucket_size;
  if (new_num_blocks > std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max()) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(
        "VoxelHashMap::resize: new_num_buckets * bucket_size overflows a "
        "signed 32-bit num_blocks");
  }
  new_grid.num_blocks = static_cast<std::int32_t>(new_num_blocks);
  VKC_TRY(new_grid.validate());

  // Build the larger buffers off to the side; a failure here leaves the live
  // map untouched (nothing swapped yet). compacted_ tracks num_blocks, so it
  // grows too.
  VKC_ASSIGN(PersistentBuffers bufs,
             make_persistent_buffers(*allocator_, new_grid));

  // Swap the new buffers in, holding the old ones (and old grid) aside so ANY
  // failure past this point rolls the live map back to exactly its prior state.
  // resize is all-or-nothing across init_table / rehash too, not only the
  // allocation above: a half-swapped map (a grown grid_ over a partial or
  // uninitialised table, or a heap still listing the preserved live indices)
  // would corrupt later allocations while valid() reported true.
  PersistentBuffers old{std::move(entries_),
                        std::move(heap_),
                        std::move(heap_counter_),
                        std::move(bucket_mutex_),
                        std::move(fail_counts_),
                        std::move(compacted_),
                        std::move(frustum_compacted_),
                        std::move(active_count_),
                        std::move(stamps_)};
  const VoxelGridParams old_grid = grid_;
  const std::uint32_t old_heap_free = heap_free_;
  const std::uint64_t old_settled_serial = settled_serial_;
  auto commit = [this](PersistentBuffers& b, const VoxelGridParams& g) {
    entries_ = std::move(b.entries);
    heap_ = std::move(b.heap);
    heap_counter_ = std::move(b.heap_counter);
    bucket_mutex_ = std::move(b.bucket_mutex);
    fail_counts_ = std::move(b.fail_counts);
    compacted_ = std::move(b.compacted);
    ++compaction_serial_;
    frustum_compacted_ = std::move(b.frustum_compacted);
    ++frustum_serial_;
    active_count_ = std::move(b.active_count);
    stamps_ = std::move(b.stamps);
    grid_ = g;
    write_persistent_bindings();  // point the sets at the committed buffers
  };
  commit(bufs, new_grid);

  // Init the larger table, then rehash the snapshot into it; on any failure,
  // roll back to the old buffers so a failed grow is a no-op.
  auto grow = [&]() -> core::Status {
    VKC_TRY(
        init_table());  // entries free, heap holds every index, mutexes clear
    // Each slot keeps its stamps, as it keeps its index; the new slots stay
    // zeroed.
    {
      core::CommandBatch batch(*device_, *allocator_);
      VKC_TRY(batch.copy(old.stamps, 0, stamps_, 0, old.stamps.size()));
      VKC_TRY(batch.submit());
    }
    if (active.empty()) {
      return {};  // fresh table + full heap is complete; nothing to rehash
    }
    // Rehash: re-insert each block with its ORIGINAL pointer (rehash_'s preset
    // path, not a fresh heap draw), so per-voxel data keyed by that pointer
    // survives the grow. The snapshot is loop-invariant, so upload it once;
    // insert_block is idempotent, so re-driving the dispatch absorbs transient
    // bucket-lock contention. A residual failure is a genuine chain overflow.
    const auto count = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(active.size());
    core::Buffer snapshot;
    const auto upload_snapshot =
        [&](core::CommandBatch& batch) -> core::Status {
      if (snapshot.valid()) return {};  // the first pass uploaded it
      VKC_ASSIGN(snapshot,
                 upload_to_binding(batch, rehash_.set, 4, active.data(),
                                   VkDeviceSize(count) * sizeof(BlockIndex)));
      return {};
    };
    // Keep the per-reason split rather than passing nullptr: this is the one
    // failure a caller cannot answer by growing (it *is* the grow), so the
    // reason is the only thing that makes it diagnosable -- chain overflow in
    // the new table reads very differently from residual lock contention.
    std::uint32_t failed = 0;
    AllocFailures rehash_failures{};
    const PushConstants push{grid_, count, tick_};
    const auto rehash = [&](core::CommandBatch& batch) {
      return batch.dispatch(rehash_, &push, sizeof(push), group_count(count),
                            max_workgroup_count_x_);
    };
    for (int pass = 0; pass < kReinsertPasses; ++pass) {
      VKC_ASSIGN(failed, dispatch_with_retry(rehash, &rehash_failures,
                                             upload_snapshot));
      if (failed == 0) {
        break;
      }
    }
    if (failed != 0) {
      return core::Status::out_of_memory(
          "VoxelHashMap::resize: rehash failed after growing (" +
          std::to_string(failed) + " of " + std::to_string(count) +
          " blocks; lock=" + std::to_string(rehash_failures.lock) +
          " chain=" + std::to_string(rehash_failures.chain) +
          " table=" + std::to_string(rehash_failures.table) + ")");
    }
    // The rehash drew nothing from the heap, so init_table's "all free" heap
    // still lists the preserved indices; rebuild it to hold only the genuinely
    // free ones so a future allocation never hands out a live block.
    return rebuild_heap_excluding(active);
  };
  core::Status st;
  try {
    st = grow();
  } catch (const std::bad_alloc&) {
    // Host scratch can fail after the grown table was installed. Use the
    // same rollback as a GPU failure before the caller can resume fusion.
    st = core::Status::out_of_memory(
        "VoxelHashMap::resize: host allocation failed");
  }
  if (!st.ok()) {
    commit(old, old_grid);  // roll back to the untouched live map
    heap_free_ = old_heap_free;
    // A completed allocation may still need to settle into the old counter.
    settled_serial_ = old_settled_serial;
    return st;
  }
  return {};
}

core::Result<std::vector<BlockStamp>> VoxelHashMap::read_block_stamps() const {
  if (!valid()) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(
        "VoxelHashMap::read_block_stamps: moved-from map");
  }
  std::vector<BlockStamp> out(stamps_.size() / sizeof(BlockStamp));
  core::CommandBatch batch(*device_, *allocator_);
  VKC_TRY(batch.readback(stamps_, 0, stamps_.size(), out.data()));
  VKC_TRY(batch.submit());
  return out;
}

core::Result<float> VoxelHashMap::load_factor() const {
  if (!valid()) {
    return core::Status::invalid_argument(
        "VoxelHashMap::load_factor: moved-from map");
  }
  // num_blocks > 0 by VoxelGridParams::validate (bucket_size >= 2,
  // num_buckets > 0, and their product is num_blocks).
  return 1.0f -
         static_cast<float>(heap_free_) / static_cast<float>(grid_.num_blocks);
}

std::uint32_t VoxelHashMap::allocated_blocks() const noexcept {
  return valid() ? static_cast<std::uint32_t>(grid_.num_blocks) - heap_free_
                 : 0;
}

}  // namespace volumetric_kit::grid::volume
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/voxelize/mesh_integrator.cpp
