### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/shaders/block_sort_merge.comp
```
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

// One level of the block sort past the tiles (block_lists.hpp): pairs of
// sorted runs of pc.run_length entries merged into the other buffer, an entry
// an invocation, by the same ranks as block_sort_tile.comp's, so the merge is
// stable. A run with no sibling, the last of an odd count, is copied as it
// is, as every entry is at a level of runs past the count word's entries:
// the host records the levels for pc.count, the bound.

#version 450
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#extension GL_EXT_scalar_block_layout : require

#define VGRID_HASH_COMMON_NO_PUSH_CONSTANTS
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/volume/shaders/hash_common.glsl"
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/volume/shaders/coord_order.glsl"

#include "block_lists_push.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = 256) in;

layout(set = 0, binding = 0, scalar) readonly buffer In {
  BlockIndex runs_in[];
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 1, scalar) writeonly buffer Out {
  BlockIndex runs_out[];
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 2, std430) readonly buffer Count {
  uint count_words[];
};

VGRID_COORD_SEARCH(runs, runs_in)

void main() {
  const uint i = pc.item_base + gl_GlobalInvocationID.x;
  const uint n = min(count_words[pc.count_word], pc.count);
  if (i >= n) return;
  const uint run = pc.run_length;  // a power of two
  const BlockIndex b = runs_in[i];
  const uint base = i & ~(2u * run - 1u);
  uint at;
  if (i - base < run) {
    const uint right = base + run;
    const uint right_count = right < n ? min(run, n - right) : 0u;
    at = i + runs_lower(b.coord, right, right_count);
  } else {
    at = i - run + runs_upper(b.coord, base, run);
  }
  runs_out[at] = b;
}
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/shaders/block_sort_tile.comp
```
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

// The block sort's first levels (block_lists.hpp): each workgroup copies a
// tile of kSortTile entries into shared memory, sorts it by rank-merging runs
// of 1, 2, ..., kSortTile / 2 entries, and writes it out. A run's entry lands
// at its index in its run plus the entries of the sibling run that go before
// it -- for the left run those that sort before it, for the right run those
// that do not sort after it -- so ties keep their order and the sort is
// stable. The last tile may be partial. The entries are the count word's, at
// most pc.count, the bound the host recorded for.

#version 450
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#extension GL_EXT_scalar_block_layout : require

#define VGRID_HASH_COMMON_NO_PUSH_CONSTANTS
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/volume/shaders/hash_common.glsl"
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/volume/shaders/coord_order.glsl"

#include "block_lists_push.glsl"

// Mirrors kSortTile in block_lists.cpp.
const uint kSortTile = 256u;

layout(local_size_x = kSortTile) in;

layout(set = 0, binding = 0, scalar) readonly buffer In {
  BlockIndex blocks_in[];
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 1, scalar) writeonly buffer Out {
  BlockIndex blocks_out[];
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 2, std430) readonly buffer Count {
  uint count_words[];
};

// Two halves of a tile, which the levels ping-pong between: 8 KB.
shared BlockIndex s_tile[2u * kSortTile];

VGRID_COORD_SEARCH(tile, s_tile)

void main() {
  const uint lane = gl_LocalInvocationID.x;
  const uint first = pc.item_base + gl_WorkGroupID.x * kSortTile;
  const uint n = min(count_words[pc.count_word], pc.count);
  // A tile the dispatch's bound holds and the count does not: nothing.
  if (first >= n) return;
  // Uniform across the workgroup, as every barrier below needs.
  const uint count = min(kSortTile, n - first);
  if (lane < count) s_tile[lane] = blocks_in[first + lane];
  barrier();
  uint src = 0u;
  for (uint run = 1u; run < kSortTile; run <<= 1u) {
    if (lane < count) {
      const BlockIndex b = s_tile[src + lane];
      const uint base = lane & ~(2u * run - 1u);
      uint at;
      if (lane - base < run) {
        const uint right = base + run;
        const uint right_count = right < count ? min(run, count - right) : 0u;
        at = lane + tile_lower(b.coord, src + right, right_count);
      } else {
        at = lane - run + tile_upper(b.coord, src + base, run);
      }
      s_tile[kSortTile - src + at] = b;
    }
    barrier();
    src = kSortTile - src;
  }
  if (lane < count) blocks_out[first + lane] = s_tile[src + lane];
}
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/shaders/dct_common.glsl
```
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

// Shared by dct_forward.comp, dct_inverse.comp, dct_observed.comp and
// dct_surface.comp: the push-constant block, the block list, the basis +
// zigzag table buffer, the block lookup, the shared-memory work cube, the one
// separable 8-point line transform both directions are made of, and the
// packing of two quantized coefficients to a word.
//
// ONE WORKGROUP OF kLanes (64) INVOCATIONS PER BLOCK, each owning one kEdge-voxel
// line per pass. A separable 8^3 transform is three passes of 64 independent
// 8-point transforms (along x, then y, then z), so 64 is the natural width --
// and it stays under Vulkan's guaranteed 128 invocations per workgroup, which
// the prior engine's 512 threads per block (one per voxel) does not.
//
// The block's values live in `s_work`, two halves of kBlockVoxels floats that
// the passes ping-pong between (4 KB of shared memory, against a guaranteed
// 16 KB).

#ifndef VGRID_DCT_COMMON_GLSL
#define VGRID_DCT_COMMON_GLSL

#extension GL_EXT_scalar_block_layout : require

// The block geometry, mirroring kBlockSize / kVoxelsPerBlock / kMaskWordBits
// (codec_params.hpp) and kStrideY / kStrideZ / kBasisSize (dct_tables.hpp).
// Fixed rather than tunable: the lane-to-line mapping below is built on it, and
// the host refuses a grid with any other block size.
const uint kEdge = 8u;                   // voxels along one block edge
const uint kStrideX = 1u;                // voxel v = x + kStrideY y + kStrideZ z
const uint kStrideY = kEdge;
const uint kStrideZ = kEdge * kEdge;
const uint kBlockVoxels = kStrideZ * kEdge;
const uint kBasisSize = kEdge * kEdge;   // the kEdge x kEdge 1-D DCT matrix
const uint kLanes = kEdge * kEdge;       // lines per pass: one per invocation
const uint kMaskWordBits = 32u;
const uint kMaskWords = kBlockVoxels / kMaskWordBits;
const uint kLinesPerMaskWord = kMaskWordBits / kEdge;
const uint kLineBits = (1u << kEdge) - 1u;  // one line's bits of a mask word
const uint kHalf = kBlockVoxels;         // offset of s_work's second half

// The set-0 bindings, mirroring `Binding` in dct_transform.cpp -- the compute
// core is explicit, not reflected (2026-07-05).
#define VGRID_DCT_BINDING_BLOCKS 0
#define VGRID_DCT_BINDING_TSDF 1
#define VGRID_DCT_BINDING_WEIGHT 2
#define VGRID_DCT_BINDING_TABLES 3
#define VGRID_DCT_BINDING_COEFFICIENTS 4
#define VGRID_DCT_BINDING_MASKS 5
#define VGRID_DCT_BINDING_ENTRIES 6
#define VGRID_DCT_BINDING_REJECTED 7
#define VGRID_DCT_BINDING_STAMPS 8
#define VGRID_DCT_BINDING_QUANTIZATION 9
// EncoderConfig::true_sdf's scratch (dct_surface.comp): the cut set, one bit
// per voxel of the grid's heap (slot s at bit s % 32 of word s / 32), and the
// keep flags, one word per block slot.
#define VGRID_DCT_BINDING_CUT 10
#define VGRID_DCT_BINDING_KEEP 11
// Whether slot s's bit is set in a bit-per-slot set such as the cut set.
#define VGRID_SLOT_BIT(set, s) \
  ((((set)[(s) / kMaskWordBits] >> ((s) % kMaskWordBits)) & 1u) != 0u)

// BlockIndex and the read-only hash lookup from the volume tier (one
// definition, not a mirror -- see hash_lookup.glsl), which brings hash_common
// without its push constants: this kernel has its own, below.
#define VGRID_HASH_ENTRIES_BINDING VGRID_DCT_BINDING_ENTRIES
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/volume/shaders/hash_lookup.glsl"

// Mirrors PushConstants in dct_transform.cpp; all 4-byte scalars, so scalar
// layout places each at its host offset (60 bytes).
layout(push_constant, scalar) uniform PushConstants {
  uint item_base;          // first list entry this dispatch covers
  uint num_blocks;         // entries in the whole list
  uint coefficient_count;  // K, in [1, kBlockVoxels]
  float trunc_dist;        // metres; the SDF is divided by it (forward) and
                           // multiplied back (inverse)
  float observed_weight;   // weight >= this marks a voxel observed
  float decoded_weight;    // what the inverse writes on an observed voxel
  int num_buckets;         // the hash table's shape, for the live-block probe
  int bucket_size;
  int max_chain;
  int max_quantized;       // the clamp on a quantized coefficient
  uint tick;               // the map's tick, which the inverse stamps with
  uint true_sdf;           // EncoderConfig::true_sdf: the forward reads the
                           // cut set, the observed filter the keep flags
  uint surface_pass;       // dct_surface.comp's: 0 cuts, 1 keeps
  float cut_distance;      // metres; a far corner of a sign-change cell is cut
  float near_distance;     // metres; a corner this near keeps its cell
}
pc;

layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_BLOCKS, scalar) readonly buffer
    Blocks {
  BlockIndex blocks[];
};

// Built on the host (dct_tables.hpp) and uploaded once, so every device
// transforms against the same bits rather than its own cos().
//   basis[k * kEdge + n]  orthonormal 1-D DCT-II: X[k] = sum_n basis[k][n] x[n]
//   zigzag[j]             voxel index of kept coefficient j
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_TABLES, scalar) readonly buffer
    Tables {
  float basis[kBasisSize];
  uint zigzag[kBlockVoxels];
};

// One effective step per canonical frequency x + 8*y + 64*z, staged for
// this call after the host multiplies the scale and weights.
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_QUANTIZATION, scalar) readonly buffer
    Quantization {
  float quantization_steps[kBlockVoxels];
};

// Mirrors Counts in dct_transform.cpp: rejected entries and the observed
// kernel's append count, summed over every dispatch in the call.
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_REJECTED, scalar) buffer Rejected {
  uint rejected;
  uint observed_count;
};

shared float s_work[2u * kBlockVoxels];
shared float s_basis[kBasisSize];
shared int s_ptr;

// The block list entry `entry` names: its coord, found through the hash table,
// whatever ptr the entry carries -- so a ptr is never trusted, and the decoder
// can hand over blocks it has just allocated without reading their slots
// back. -1 when the table holds no such block, which the call reports and
// neither kernel reads or writes. Lane 0 probes and the answer is shared, so
// every lane returns on it or none does. Sound only while nothing allocates
// into the map, the same quiescence hash_lookup.glsl states.
int block_ptr(uint entry, uint lane) {
  if (lane == 0u) {
    s_ptr = vgridFindBlockPtr(blocks[entry].coord, pc.num_buckets,
                           pc.bucket_size, pc.max_chain);
    if (s_ptr < 0) {
      atomicAdd(rejected, 1u);
    }
  }
  barrier();
  return s_ptr;
}

// Transform one kEdge-point line of the cube held in s_work from `src`,
// writing it to the same line of the cube at `dst`. The line is voxels base,
// base + stride, ..., base + (kEdge - 1) * stride. Forward multiplies by the basis,
// inverse by its transpose -- the basis is orthonormal, so that is its inverse.
void transform_line(uint src, uint dst, uint base, uint stride, bool inverse) {
  float line[kEdge];
  for (uint i = 0u; i < kEdge; ++i) {
    line[i] = s_work[src + base + i * stride];
  }
  for (uint o = 0u; o < kEdge; ++o) {
    float acc = 0.0;
    for (uint i = 0u; i < kEdge; ++i) {
      acc += (inverse ? s_basis[i * kEdge + o] : s_basis[o * kEdge + i]) *
             line[i];
    }
    s_work[dst + base + o * stride] = acc;
  }
}

// Lane r's line in each pass, by its first voxel: the x-line of r = y + kEdge z,
// the y-line of r = x + kEdge z, and the z-line of r = x + kEdge y. Every
// separable pass -- the fill's and the transform's -- runs on this mapping, so
// each pass covers the cube once.
uint x_line_base(uint lane) { return lane * kEdge; }
uint y_line_base(uint lane) {
  return lane % kEdge + (lane / kEdge) * kStrideZ;
}
uint z_line_base(uint lane) {
  return lane % kEdge + (lane / kEdge) * kStrideY;
}

// The three separable passes, s_work[0..] -> [kHalf..] -> [0..] -> [kHalf..].
// Every pass reads lines other lanes wrote, hence a barrier after each. The
// caller must have filled the first half of s_work and s_basis, and passed a
// barrier. The result is left in the second half, from kHalf.
void transform_cube(uint lane, bool inverse) {
  transform_line(0u, kHalf, x_line_base(lane), kStrideX, inverse);
  barrier();
  transform_line(kHalf, 0u, y_line_base(lane), kStrideY, inverse);
  barrier();
  transform_line(0u, kHalf, z_line_base(lane), kStrideZ, inverse);
  barrier();
}

// The step coefficient j (zigzag index) was quantized with.
float step_for(uint j) {
  return quantization_steps[zigzag[j]];
}

// The quantized coefficients travel two to a 32-bit word, coefficient 2p in
// the low half of word p and 2p + 1 in the high, each entry starting a word of
// its own: K = 64 is 32 words an entry, and an odd K pads the last high half
// with 0. Each fits 16 bits, being within +-max_quantized.
uint coefficient_words() { return (pc.coefficient_count + 1u) / 2u; }

#endif  // VGRID_DCT_COMMON_GLSL
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/shaders/dct_forward.comp
```
#version 450

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

// Forward block DCT: for each listed block, divide its observed SDF by
// trunc_dist, fill its unobserved voxels from the observed ones, take the
// orthonormal 8^3 DCT-II, and write the first K coefficients in zigzag order,
// each rounded half-to-even after dividing by its step and clamped to +-32767
// (CodecParams::validate keeps the step coarse enough that the clamp never
// engages on in-range input), two to a word (see coefficient_words). Also
// pack the observed mask: bit v % 32 of word v / 32 is set where voxel v's
// weight >= observed_weight -- and, with pc.true_sdf, its bit in the cut set
// is clear: a cut voxel is coded as unobserved.
//
// Re-implements the prior engine's computeDCTKernel (compute_dct.cu) with one
// lane per line instead of one thread per voxel -- see dct_common.glsl. Output
// is indexed by list position, not by block ptr.

#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "dct_common.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = kLanes) in;

layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_TSDF, scalar) readonly buffer Tsdf {
  float tsdf[];
};
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_WEIGHT, scalar) readonly buffer
    Weight {
  float weight[];
};
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_COEFFICIENTS, scalar) writeonly buffer
    Coefficients {
  uint coefficients[];
};
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_MASKS, scalar) writeonly buffer
    Masks {
  uint masks[];
};
// Read only with pc.true_sdf (see dct_common.glsl).
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_CUT, scalar) readonly buffer Cut {
  uint cut[];
};

shared uint s_mask[kMaskWords];
// Per voxel, whether s_work holds a value for it yet: observed, or filled.
shared uint s_known[kBlockVoxels];

// Give each unknown voxel of one line the value of the nearest voxel that was
// known when the pass began, the lower index on a tie. A line with nothing
// known is left for a later pass. Only this lane's line is read or written.
void fill_line(uint base, uint stride) {
  float val[kEdge];
  uint known = 0u;
  for (uint i = 0u; i < kEdge; ++i) {
    val[i] = s_work[base + i * stride];
    if (s_known[base + i * stride] != 0u) {
      known |= 1u << i;
    }
  }
  if (known == 0u || known == kLineBits) {
    return;
  }
  for (uint i = 0u; i < kEdge; ++i) {
    if (((known >> i) & 1u) != 0u) {
      continue;
    }
    for (uint d = 1u; d < kEdge; ++d) {
      if (i >= d && ((known >> (i - d)) & 1u) != 0u) {
        s_work[base + i * stride] = val[i - d];
        break;
      }
      if (i + d < kEdge && ((known >> (i + d)) & 1u) != 0u) {
        s_work[base + i * stride] = val[i + d];
        break;
      }
    }
    s_known[base + i * stride] = 1u;
  }
}

// Fill the unobserved voxels along x, then y, then z, on the lane-to-line
// mapping the transform uses. After the three passes every voxel is known
// unless the block has no observed voxel at all, and those stay at the 0 they
// were loaded as. The decoder masks these voxels out whatever they hold, so the
// fill is free to choose them, and a smooth continuation of the observed field
// is what a truncated DCT keeps best: a fused block's unobserved voxels read 0,
// the iso level, and the step from there to the observed band is what K = 32
// could not represent -- that leaked 2-5x the error into the observed voxels
// beside the mask edge. The rule is in DECISIONS.md (2026-09-26).
void fill_unobserved(uint lane) {
  fill_line(x_line_base(lane), kStrideX);
  barrier();
  fill_line(y_line_base(lane), kStrideY);
  barrier();
  fill_line(z_line_base(lane), kStrideZ);
  barrier();
}

// Coefficient j, quantized: rounded half-to-even and clamped.
int quantized(uint j) {
  float q = roundEven(s_work[kHalf + zigzag[j]] / step_for(j));
  float bound = float(pc.max_quantized);
  return int(clamp(q, -bound, bound));
}

void main() {
  uint lane = gl_LocalInvocationIndex;
  uint entry = pc.item_base + gl_WorkGroupID.x;
  // Uniform across the workgroup (it depends only on the group id), so every
  // barrier below is still reached by all of this group's lanes or none.
  if (entry >= pc.num_blocks) {
    return;
  }
  int ptr = block_ptr(entry, lane);
  if (ptr < 0) {
    return;
  }
  uint voxel_base = uint(ptr);

  s_basis[lane] = basis[lane];
  if (lane < kMaskWords) {
    s_mask[lane] = 0u;
  }

  // Load this lane's x-line and note which of its voxels were observed. An
  // unobserved voxel's tsdf is never read, so the coefficients depend on the
  // observed voxels alone.
  float inv_trunc = 1.0 / pc.trunc_dist;
  uint line_bits = 0u;
  for (uint x = 0u; x < kEdge; ++x) {
    uint v = x_line_base(lane) + x;
    uint slot = voxel_base + v;
    bool obs = weight[slot] >= pc.observed_weight &&
               (pc.true_sdf == 0u || !VGRID_SLOT_BIT(cut, slot));
    s_work[v] = obs ? tsdf[slot] * inv_trunc : 0.0;
    s_known[v] = obs ? 1u : 0u;
    if (obs) {
      line_bits |= 1u << x;
    }
  }
  barrier();

  // A line is kEdge bits and a word holds kLinesPerMaskWord lines: lane r's
  // bits land at bit (r % kLinesPerMaskWord) * kEdge of word
  // r / kLinesPerMaskWord, which is bit v % kMaskWordBits of word
  // v / kMaskWordBits for each of its voxels v = kEdge r + x.
  atomicOr(s_mask[lane / kLinesPerMaskWord],
           line_bits << ((lane % kLinesPerMaskWord) * kEdge));

  fill_unobserved(lane);
  transform_cube(lane, false);

  uint k = pc.coefficient_count;
  uint words = coefficient_words();
  for (uint p = lane; p < words; p += kLanes) {
    uint lo = uint(quantized(2u * p)) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint hi = 2u * p + 1u < k ? uint(quantized(2u * p + 1u)) & 0xFFFFu : 0u;
    coefficients[entry * words + p] = lo | (hi << 16);
  }
  if (lane < kMaskWords) {
    masks[entry * kMaskWords + lane] = s_mask[lane];
  }
}
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/shaders/dct_inverse.comp
```
#version 450

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

// Inverse block DCT: for each listed block, dequantize its K zigzag-ordered
// coefficients into an otherwise-zero cube, inverse-transform, and write the
// block back. An observed voxel (its mask bit set) gets the reconstructed SDF,
// scaled by trunc_dist and clamped to +-trunc_dist -- the range the integrator
// keeps, which ringing from the dropped coefficients can overshoot -- and the
// decoded weight. An unobserved voxel gets zero tsdf and zero weight, exactly
// what a freshly allocated block holds, so the mesher skips it as it skipped
// the original. A block whose tsdf or weight this leaves different is stamped
// changed with the map's tick, as the integrator stamps one, so a frame that
// repeats a block's last one leaves it unstamped. An entry
// whose coord the table does not hold (see block_ptr) is written nothing.
//
// Re-implements the prior engine's computeIDCTKernel (compute_dct.cu), which
// wrote every voxel's SDF and left weights alone; the mask is what replaces the
// weights it did not have to send.

#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "dct_common.glsl"
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/volume/shaders/grid_types.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = kLanes) in;

layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_TSDF, scalar) buffer Tsdf {
  float tsdf[];
};
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_WEIGHT, scalar) buffer Weight {
  float weight[];
};
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_COEFFICIENTS, scalar) readonly buffer
    Coefficients {
  uint coefficients[];
};
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_MASKS, scalar) readonly buffer
    Masks {
  uint masks[];
};
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_STAMPS, scalar) buffer Stamps {
  BlockStamp stamps[];
};

shared uint s_changed;

void main() {
  uint lane = gl_LocalInvocationIndex;
  uint entry = pc.item_base + gl_WorkGroupID.x;
  // Uniform across the workgroup; see dct_forward.comp.
  if (entry >= pc.num_blocks) {
    return;
  }
  int ptr = block_ptr(entry, lane);
  if (ptr < 0) {
    return;
  }
  uint voxel_base = uint(ptr);
  if (lane == 0u) {
    s_changed = 0u;
  }

  s_basis[lane] = basis[lane];
  for (uint x = 0u; x < kEdge; ++x) {
    s_work[x_line_base(lane) + x] = 0.0;
  }
  barrier();

  // Scatter the kept coefficients to their zigzag positions; the rest stay 0.
  uint k = pc.coefficient_count;
  uint words = coefficient_words();
  for (uint j = lane; j < k; j += kLanes) {
    uint word = coefficients[entry * words + j / 2u];
    int q = bitfieldExtract(int(word), int(16u * (j % 2u)), 16);
    s_work[zigzag[j]] = float(q) * step_for(j);
  }
  barrier();

  transform_cube(lane, true);

  // Write back this lane's x-line, gated by its 8 mask bits.
  uint line_bits =
      (masks[entry * kMaskWords + lane / kLinesPerMaskWord] >>
       ((lane % kLinesPerMaskWord) * kEdge)) &
      kLineBits;
  // A voxel is written only where its bits differ (-0.0 against 0.0 too, so
  // the block ends exactly as decoded), which spares a block the frame
  // repeats its writes; the stamp still compares values.
  bool changed = false;
  for (uint x = 0u; x < kEdge; ++x) {
    uint local = x_line_base(lane) + x;
    uint v = voxel_base + local;
    bool observed = ((line_bits >> x) & 1u) != 0u;
    float sdf = clamp(s_work[kHalf + local], -1.0, 1.0) * pc.trunc_dist;
    float t = observed ? sdf : 0.0;
    float w = observed ? pc.decoded_weight : 0.0;
    float old_t = tsdf[v];
    float old_w = weight[v];
    changed = changed || old_t != t || old_w != w;
    if (floatBitsToUint(old_t) != floatBitsToUint(t)) {
      tsdf[v] = t;
    }
    if (floatBitsToUint(old_w) != floatBitsToUint(w)) {
      weight[v] = w;
    }
  }
  if (changed) {
    atomicOr(s_changed, 1u);
  }
  barrier();
  if (lane == 0u && s_changed != 0u) {
    stamps[voxel_base / kBlockVoxels].changed = pc.tick;
  }
}
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/shaders/dct_observed.comp
```
#version 450

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

// Append listed blocks holding an observed voxel (weight >= observed_weight)
// to a compact device list, so the encoder downloads only a predicted prefix
// and any outgrown tail, rather than the full input list and flags. A fused
// grid's band is mostly never integrated -- room0 codes about one block in
// five of those it allocates -- so this reads weights alone where the forward
// would read the block, transform it and write it out. With pc.true_sdf it
// appends the blocks dct_surface.comp flagged instead. An entry whose coord
// the table does not hold (see block_ptr) is reported and written nothing.

#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "dct_common.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = kLanes) in;

layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_WEIGHT, scalar) readonly buffer
    Weight {
  float weight[];
};
// Up to pc.num_blocks entries, on the masks' binding: this writes no mask.
// Append order is unspecified; the encoder sorts by coordinate on the host.
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_MASKS, scalar) writeonly buffer
    Observed {
  BlockIndex observed[];
};

// One word per block slot (see dct_common.glsl), read only with pc.true_sdf.
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_KEEP, scalar) readonly buffer Keep {
  uint keep[];
};

shared uint s_observed;

void main() {
  uint lane = gl_LocalInvocationIndex;
  uint entry = pc.item_base + gl_WorkGroupID.x;
  // Uniform across the workgroup; see dct_forward.comp.
  if (entry >= pc.num_blocks) {
    return;
  }
  int ptr = block_ptr(entry, lane);
  if (ptr < 0) {
    return;
  }
  // Uniform: a push constant.
  if (pc.true_sdf != 0u) {
    if (lane == 0u && keep[uint(ptr) / kBlockVoxels] != 0u) {
      observed[atomicAdd(observed_count, 1u)] = blocks[entry];
    }
    return;
  }
  if (lane == 0u) {
    s_observed = 0u;
  }
  barrier();
  uint first = uint(ptr) + x_line_base(lane);
  bool any = false;
  for (uint x = 0u; x < kEdge; ++x) {
    any = any || weight[first + x] >= pc.observed_weight;
  }
  if (any) {
    atomicOr(s_observed, 1u);
  }
  barrier();
  if (lane == 0u && s_observed != 0u) {
    uint dst = atomicAdd(observed_count, 1u);
    observed[dst] = blocks[entry];
  }
}
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/shaders/dct_surface.comp
```
#version 450

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

// EncoderConfig::true_sdf's two passes over the map's active list, before the
// observed filter: one workgroup per block, each lane taking the kEdge cells
// anchored on its x-line, whose corners reach across the block's +x/+y/+z
// faces through its neighbourhood (block_neighbourhood.glsl). A cell counts
// when all 8 of its corners are observed.
//
// Pass 0, the cut: in each counted cell whose sign changes, every corner
// farther than cut_distance from zero sets its bit in the cut set. It reads
// tsdf and weight alone, so no cut changes which cells another tests.
//
// Pass 1, the keep: a counted cell with no corner cut, whose sign changes or
// that has a corner nearer than near_distance to zero, flags every block that
// holds one of its corners, which the observed filter then appends.
//
// Metres on the raw tsdf, strict comparisons, and a corner below 0 inside.
// Every write is an atomicOr of a bit, so the result does not depend on the
// order the workgroups run in.

#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "dct_common.glsl"
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/volume/shaders/block_neighbourhood.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = kLanes) in;

layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_TSDF, scalar) readonly buffer Tsdf {
  float tsdf[];
};
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_WEIGHT, scalar) readonly buffer
    Weight {
  float weight[];
};
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_CUT, scalar) buffer Cut {
  uint cut[];
};
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DCT_BINDING_KEEP, scalar) buffer Keep {
  uint keep[];
};

shared uint s_any;
// The octants (ox + 2 oy + 4 oz) of the neighbourhood whose block holds a
// corner of a cell pass 1 keeps.
shared uint s_needed;

void main() {
  uint lane = gl_LocalInvocationIndex;
  uint entry = pc.item_base + gl_WorkGroupID.x;
  // Uniform across the workgroup; see dct_forward.comp.
  if (entry >= pc.num_blocks) {
    return;
  }
  int ptr = block_ptr(entry, lane);
  if (ptr < 0) {
    return;
  }
  if (lane == 0u) {
    s_any = 0u;
    s_needed = 0u;
  }
  barrier();
  // A cell's first corner is its anchor block's own voxel, so a block with no
  // observed voxel anchors no cell that counts.
  uint first = uint(ptr) + x_line_base(lane);
  bool any = false;
  for (uint x = 0u; x < kEdge; ++x) {
    any = any || weight[first + x] >= pc.observed_weight;
  }
  if (any) {
    atomicOr(s_any, 1u);
  }
  vgridResolveNeighbourhood(blocks[entry].coord, ptr, lane, pc.num_buckets,
                         pc.bucket_size, pc.max_chain);
  barrier();
  if (s_any == 0u) {
    return;
  }

  const int bs = int(kEdge);
  uint needed = 0u;
  for (uint x = 0u; x < kEdge; ++x) {
    ivec3 anchor = ivec3(int(x), int(lane % kEdge), int(lane / kEdge));
    uint si[8];
    uint octants = 0u;
    uint inside = 0u;
    bool counted = true;
    bool any_far = false;
    bool any_near = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
      ivec3 c = anchor + ivec3(i & 1, (i >> 1) & 1, (i >> 2) & 1);
      if (!vgridCornerStorage(bs, c, si[i]) ||
          weight[si[i]] < pc.observed_weight ||
          (pc.surface_pass == 1u && VGRID_SLOT_BIT(cut, si[i]))) {
        counted = false;
        break;
      }
      float t = tsdf[si[i]];
      inside += t < 0.0 ? 1u : 0u;
      any_far = any_far || abs(t) > pc.cut_distance;
      any_near = any_near || abs(t) < pc.near_distance;
      octants |= 1u << uint(vgridOctantIndex(c / bs));
    }
    if (!counted) {
      continue;
    }
    bool flips = inside != 0u && inside != 8u;
    if (pc.surface_pass == 0u) {
      if (flips && any_far) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
          if (abs(tsdf[si[i]]) > pc.cut_distance) {
            atomicOr(cut[si[i] / kMaskWordBits],
                     1u << (si[i] % kMaskWordBits));
          }
        }
      }
    } else if (flips || any_near) {
      needed |= octants;
    }
  }
  // Uniform: a push constant.
  if (pc.surface_pass == 1u) {
    if (needed != 0u) {
      atomicOr(s_needed, needed);
    }
    barrier();
    if (lane < 8u && ((s_needed >> lane) & 1u) != 0u) {
      atomicOr(keep[uint(s_neighbour[lane]) / kBlockVoxels], 1u);
    }
  }
}
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/shaders/deblock_common.glsl
```
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

// Shared by deblock_flags.comp, deblock_line.comp, deblock_gauss.comp and
// deblock_store.comp, the decoder-side deblock (deblock.hpp has the filters):
// the bindings and push constants of their one layout, the per-block
// fallback's flags, the normalized field, the shell index and the stamp.
//
// ONE WORKGROUP OF kLanes (64) INVOCATIONS PER FRAME BLOCK, the entry
// item_base + the group's id in the frame's list, found by its coord through
// the grid's hash; its ptr is never read. deblock_flags.comp alone runs an
// invocation a block.

#ifndef VGRID_DEBLOCK_COMMON_GLSL
#define VGRID_DEBLOCK_COMMON_GLSL

#extension GL_EXT_scalar_block_layout : require

// The block geometry, mirroring kBlockSize / kVoxelsPerBlock /
// kMaskWordsPerBlock (codec_params.hpp) and kShellVoxels (deblock.hpp).
const uint kEdge = 8u;
const uint kBlockVoxels = 512u;
const uint kLanes = 64u;
const uint kMaskWords = 16u;
const uint kShellVoxels = 296u;  // kBlockVoxels - 6^3

// The set-0 bindings, mirroring `Binding` in deblock.cpp.
#define VGRID_DEBLOCK_BINDING_BLOCKS 0
#define VGRID_DEBLOCK_BINDING_MASKS 1
#define VGRID_DEBLOCK_BINDING_ENTRIES 2
#define VGRID_DEBLOCK_BINDING_TSDF 3
#define VGRID_DEBLOCK_BINDING_WEIGHT 4
#define VGRID_DEBLOCK_BINDING_STAMPS 5
#define VGRID_DEBLOCK_BINDING_SHELL 6
#define VGRID_DEBLOCK_BINDING_FULL 7
#define VGRID_DEBLOCK_BINDING_EXACT 8

// BlockIndex, BlockStamp and the read-only hash lookup from the volume tier
// (one definition; see hash_lookup.glsl).
#define VGRID_HASH_ENTRIES_BINDING VGRID_DEBLOCK_BINDING_ENTRIES
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/volume/shaders/hash_lookup.glsl"

// Mirrors PushConstants in deblock.cpp; all 4-byte scalars, so scalar layout
// places each at its host offset (68 bytes).
layout(push_constant, scalar) uniform PushConstants {
  uint item_base;         // first list entry this dispatch covers
  uint num_blocks;        // entries in the whole list
  uint axis;              // the line pass's: 0 x, 1 y, 2 z
  uint tick;              // the map's tick, which a written block is stamped
  int num_buckets;        // the hash table's shape, for the probes
  int bucket_size;
  int max_chain;
  float trunc_dist;       // metres; v = tsdf / trunc_dist
  float inv_trunc;        // float(1 / double(trunc_dist))
  float observed_weight;  // weight >= this marks a neighbour's voxel observed
  float saturated;        // 1 - 1e-5: a fitted |v| at or above skips the line
  float c0;               // the 3-sample least-squares line's value at the
  float c1;               // face: sum_i c_i v_i, c = (13, 4, -5) / 12
  float c2;
  float line_clip;        // the line offset's clip, in v
  float gauss_g1;         // the Gaussian's weight on a neighbour (1 on self)
  float gauss_clip;       // a Gaussian pass's clip on a change, in v
}
pc;

layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DEBLOCK_BINDING_BLOCKS, scalar) readonly buffer
    Blocks {
  BlockIndex blocks[];
};
// The frame's masks by list position: voxel l of entry e is bit l % 32 of
// word e * kMaskWords + l / 32, as the inverse read them.
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DEBLOCK_BINDING_MASKS, scalar) readonly buffer
    Masks {
  uint masks[];
};
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DEBLOCK_BINDING_TSDF, scalar) buffer Tsdf {
  float tsdf[];
};
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DEBLOCK_BINDING_WEIGHT, scalar) readonly buffer
    Weight {
  float weight[];
};
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DEBLOCK_BINDING_STAMPS, scalar) buffer Stamps {
  BlockStamp stamps[];
};
// The Gaussian's shell snapshot: kShellVoxels metres an entry, by list
// position, kUnobserved where the store leaves tsdf as it is.
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DEBLOCK_BINDING_SHELL, scalar) buffer Shell {
  float shell[];
};
// The per-block fallback's flags, a word a slot of the grid's heap, zeroed
// before deblock_flags.comp sets a frame block's to 1 when its mask is all
// ones: fully observed, which the passes may write. A 0 is a masked block --
// one holding an unobserved voxel, which keeps its exact decode -- or a slot
// the frame does not list. Read by the dispatches after it alone.
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DEBLOCK_BINDING_FULL, scalar) buffer Full {
  uint full[];
};
// The frame's masked blocks, counted by deblock_flags.comp into a word zeroed
// before it: the blocks the deblock leaves as decoded.
layout(set = 0, binding = VGRID_DEBLOCK_BINDING_EXACT, scalar) buffer
    ExactBlocks {
  uint exact_blocks;
};

// An unobserved voxel's value in the kernels' working field, and a shell
// entry the store skips. Observed values lie in [-1, 1] (metres within the
// band), so the test below is exact; finite, so fast math keeps it.
const float kUnobserved = 3.0e38;
bool vgridObserved(float v) { return v < 1.0e38; }

// tsdf / trunc_dist correctly rounded, as the CPU's float division: the
// product with the correctly rounded reciprocal is within an ulp, and one
// fused residual step rounds it correctly (Markstein), whatever division
// instruction fast math would pick.
float vgridNormalized(float t) {
  precise float q = t * pc.inv_trunc;
  precise float r = fma(-q, pc.trunc_dist, t);
  precise float v = fma(r, pc.inv_trunc, q);
  return v;
}

// Whether the frame observed every voxel of its entry @p entry: its
// kMaskWords mask words all ones. Each kernel asks it of its own entry first
// thing, so a masked block's workgroup returns before it probes the hash:
// every lane reads the same words, so the return is uniform.
bool vgridEntryFull(uint entry) {
  uint all = ~0u;
  for (uint w = 0u; w < kMaskWords; ++w) {
    all &= masks[entry * kMaskWords + w];
  }
  return all == ~0u;
}

// Whether the block at voxel base @p ptr is fully observed, so the passes may
// write it: a neighbour's flag. Every lane of a workgroup that asks of one
// block reads the same word, which no dispatch after deblock_flags.comp
// writes, so a return on it is uniform.
bool vgridFull(int ptr) {
  return full[uint(ptr) / kBlockVoxels] != 0u;
}

// The shell index of local voxel @p p (x, y, z in 0..7): its rank among the
// block's kShellVoxels shell voxels in local-index order -- the z = 0 face,
// then each z = 1..6 slice's 28-voxel ring, then the z = 7 face -- or
// kShellVoxels for an interior voxel, which no neighbour's halo reaches.
uint vgridShellIndex(uvec3 p) {
  if (p.z == 0u) return p.x + kEdge * p.y;
  if (p.z == kEdge - 1u) return 232u + p.x + kEdge * p.y;
  uint ring = 64u + 28u * (p.z - 1u);
  if (p.y == 0u) return ring + p.x;
  if (p.y == kEdge - 1u) return ring + 20u + p.x;
  if (p.x == 0u) return ring + 8u + 2u * (p.y - 1u);
  if (p.x == kEdge - 1u) return ring + 9u + 2u * (p.y - 1u);
  return kShellVoxels;
}

// Stamp the block at voxel base @p ptr changed at the pass's tick. Atomic,
// since a line pass's two workgroups may stamp one block.
void vgridStampChanged(int ptr) {
  atomicExchange(stamps[uint(ptr) / kBlockVoxels].changed, pc.tick);
}

#endif  // VGRID_DEBLOCK_COMMON_GLSL
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/shaders/deblock_flags.comp
```
#version 450

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

// The deblock's first dispatch (deblock.hpp): the per-block fallback's flags.
// An invocation a frame block, kLanes a workgroup, the entry item_base + the
// global invocation id: a block whose mask is all ones finds its slot by
// coordinate through the grid's hash and sets full[slot], which the batch
// zeroed; a masked block, which keeps its exact decode, probes nothing and is
// counted, a workgroup's count added to exact_blocks at once. No invocation
// reads a flag another writes; the dispatches after this one read them,
// after the batch's barrier.

#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "deblock_common.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = kLanes) in;

shared uint s_masked;

void main() {
  uint lane = gl_LocalInvocationIndex;
  uint entry = pc.item_base + gl_GlobalInvocationID.x;
  if (lane == 0u) {
    s_masked = 0u;
  }
  barrier();
  if (entry < pc.num_blocks) {
    if (vgridEntryFull(entry)) {
      int ptr = vgridFindBlockPtr(blocks[entry].coord, pc.num_buckets,
                               pc.bucket_size, pc.max_chain);
      if (ptr >= 0) {
        full[uint(ptr) / kBlockVoxels] = 1u;
      }
    } else {
      atomicAdd(s_masked, 1u);
    }
  }
  barrier();
  if (lane == 0u && s_masked != 0u) {
    atomicAdd(exact_blocks, s_masked);
  }
}
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/shaders/deblock_gauss.comp
```
#version 450

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

// The deblock's Gaussian (deblock.hpp), x, y and z fused: a workgroup loads
// its block B and the 1-voxel halo around it -- the 10^3 field, from B's 26
// neighbours too, since the z pass reads y's outputs, which read x's, so B's
// corner reaches its diagonal block's -- and runs the three passes in shared
// memory, each pass's outputs kept in registers until every lane has read its
// inputs, then written back over them. A halo voxel's x and y outputs are
// computed by every workgroup that needs them, from the same inputs by the
// same code, so they agree.
//
// The per-block fallback: a masked block is never written, so a masked B's
// workgroup returns at once, by its own mask, and a voxel of a neighbour
// masked by its flag (deblock_flags.comp) keeps its value through every pass
// -- its exact decode, which the line passes left alone -- read by B's taps
// like any other, its unobserved voxels dropping out.
//
// Its output goes where no other workgroup of this dispatch reads it: B's
// interior (no coordinate 0 or 7), which only B's halo-free loads read,
// straight into tsdf; its shell, which the neighbours' halos read, into the
// shell snapshot by list position, for deblock_store.comp. A voxel whose bits
// the passes leave as they were is not written.

#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "deblock_common.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = kLanes) in;

// The field: B's voxels and a voxel of halo around them, x fastest, from -1
// to 8 on each axis.
const uint kField = 10u;
const uint kFieldVoxels = kField * kField * kField;
// Each pass's outputs: x over (x 0..7, y and z -1..8), y over (x and y 0..7,
// z -1..8), z over B; per lane, rounded up.
const uint kXOutputs = kEdge * kField * kField;
const uint kYOutputs = kEdge * kEdge * kField;
const uint kXRounds = (kXOutputs + kLanes - 1u) / kLanes;
const uint kYRounds = (kYOutputs + kLanes - 1u) / kLanes;

shared float s_field[kFieldVoxels];
// The voxel bases of B's 3x3x3 neighbourhood, (ox + 1) + 3 (oy + 1) +
// 9 (oz + 1), -1 for a missing block; B at 13. And whether each is fully
// observed, 0 for a masked or missing block, whose voxels the passes keep.
shared int s_blocks[27];
shared uint s_full[27];
shared uint s_wrote;

uint field_index(int x, int y, int z) {
  return uint((x + 1) + int(kField) * ((y + 1) + int(kField) * (z + 1)));
}

// Whether field voxel (x, y, z), each -1..8, lies in a block the passes keep:
// a masked or missing one.
bool kept(int x, int y, int z) {
  ivec3 o = ivec3(x, y, z) >> 3;  // -1, 0 or 1: which block
  return s_full[(o.x + 1) + 3 * (o.y + 1) + 9 * (o.z + 1)] == 0u;
}

// One pass's output at a voxel whose input is @p v, with axis neighbours
// @p a and @p b: their weighted mean over the observed among them, its change
// clipped, then clamped; an unobserved voxel stays unobserved. Summed in the
// CPU's order, -1, 0, +1.
float gauss_step(float a, float v, float b) {
  if (!vgridObserved(v)) {
    return v;
  }
  float sw = 0.0;
  float sv = 0.0;
  if (vgridObserved(a)) {
    sw += pc.gauss_g1;
    sv += pc.gauss_g1 * a;
  }
  sw += 1.0;
  sv += v;
  if (vgridObserved(b)) {
    sw += pc.gauss_g1;
    sv += pc.gauss_g1 * b;
  }
  float mean = sv / sw;
  return clamp(v + clamp(mean - v, -pc.gauss_clip, pc.gauss_clip), -1.0, 1.0);
}

void main() {
  uint lane = gl_LocalInvocationIndex;
  uint entry = pc.item_base + gl_WorkGroupID.x;
  // Uniform across the workgroup: a masked B keeps its exact decode.
  if (entry >= pc.num_blocks || !vgridEntryFull(entry)) {
    return;
  }
  ivec3 coord = blocks[entry].coord;
  if (lane < 27u) {
    ivec3 o = ivec3(int(lane % 3u), int((lane / 3u) % 3u), int(lane / 9u)) -
              ivec3(1);
    int ptr = vgridFindBlockPtr(coord + o, pc.num_buckets, pc.bucket_size,
                             pc.max_chain);
    s_blocks[lane] = ptr;
    s_full[lane] = ptr >= 0 && vgridFull(ptr) ? 1u : 0u;
  }
  if (lane == 0u) {
    s_wrote = 0u;
  }
  barrier();
  int self_ptr = s_blocks[13];
  // Uniform: a shared value.
  if (self_ptr < 0) {
    return;
  }

  // Load: B's voxels, every one observed, and the halo's observed by its
  // weights, each voxel's tsdf with it.
  for (uint i = lane; i < kFieldVoxels; i += kLanes) {
    ivec3 h = ivec3(int(i % kField), int((i / kField) % kField),
                    int(i / (kField * kField))) -
              ivec3(1);
    ivec3 o = h >> 3;  // -1, 0 or 1: which block
    ivec3 lc = h & 7;  // its local voxel
    int b = s_blocks[(o.x + 1) + 3 * (o.y + 1) + 9 * (o.z + 1)];
    float v = kUnobserved;
    if (b >= 0) {
      uint l = uint(lc.x + int(kEdge) * (lc.y + int(kEdge) * lc.z));
      uint s = uint(b) + l;
      float t = tsdf[s];
      bool observed = o == ivec3(0) || weight[s] >= pc.observed_weight;
      if (observed) {
        v = vgridNormalized(t);
      }
    }
    s_field[i] = v;
  }
  barrier();

  // This lane's column of B, (x, y) = (lane % 8, lane / 8), as loaded.
  int cx = int(lane % kEdge);
  int cy = int(lane / kEdge);
  float input_value[kEdge];
  for (int z = 0; z < int(kEdge); ++z) {
    input_value[z] = s_field[field_index(cx, cy, z)];
  }

  // x.
  float xo[kXRounds];
  for (uint j = 0u; j < kXRounds; ++j) {
    uint o = lane + kLanes * j;
    xo[j] = 0.0;
    if (o < kXOutputs) {
      uint yz = o / kEdge;
      int y = int(yz % kField) - 1;
      int z = int(yz / kField) - 1;
      uint c = field_index(int(o % kEdge), y, z);
      xo[j] = kept(0, y, z)
                  ? s_field[c]
                  : gauss_step(s_field[c - 1u], s_field[c], s_field[c + 1u]);
    }
  }
  barrier();
  for (uint j = 0u; j < kXRounds; ++j) {
    uint o = lane + kLanes * j;
    if (o < kXOutputs) {
      uint yz = o / kEdge;
      s_field[field_index(int(o % kEdge), int(yz % kField) - 1,
                          int(yz / kField) - 1)] = xo[j];
    }
  }
  barrier();

  // y.
  float yo[kYRounds];
  for (uint j = 0u; j < kYRounds; ++j) {
    uint o = lane + kLanes * j;
    int z = int(o / (kEdge * kEdge)) - 1;
    uint c = field_index(int(o % kEdge), int((o / kEdge) % kEdge), z);
    yo[j] = kept(0, 0, z) ? s_field[c]
                          : gauss_step(s_field[c - kField], s_field[c],
                                       s_field[c + kField]);
  }
  barrier();
  for (uint j = 0u; j < kYRounds; ++j) {
    uint o = lane + kLanes * j;
    s_field[field_index(int(o % kEdge), int((o / kEdge) % kEdge),
                        int(o / (kEdge * kEdge)) - 1)] = yo[j];
  }
  barrier();

  // z, down this lane's column -- B's, which is fully observed -- and the
  // writes.
  bool wrote = false;
  for (int z = 0; z < int(kEdge); ++z) {
    uint c = field_index(cx, cy, z);
    float out_value = gauss_step(s_field[c - kField * kField], s_field[c],
                             s_field[c + kField * kField]);
    float in_value = input_value[z];
    bool changed = vgridObserved(in_value) &&
                   floatBitsToUint(out_value) != floatBitsToUint(in_value);
    float metres = out_value * pc.trunc_dist;
    uint l = uint(cx + int(kEdge) * (cy + int(kEdge) * z));
    uint si = vgridShellIndex(uvec3(cx, cy, z));
    if (si == kShellVoxels) {
      if (changed) {
        tsdf[uint(self_ptr) + l] = metres;
        wrote = true;
      }
    } else {
      shell[entry * kShellVoxels + si] = changed ? metres : kUnobserved;
    }
  }
  if (wrote) {
    atomicOr(s_wrote, 1u);
  }
  barrier();
  if (lane == 0u && s_wrote != 0u) {
    vgridStampChanged(self_ptr);
  }
}
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/shaders/deblock_line.comp
```
#version 450

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

// One axis pass of the deblock's line fit (deblock.hpp), pc.axis, in place on
// tsdf. A workgroup owns its block B's face to its +axis neighbour N, a lane
// one line across it: p_i is B's voxel at 7 - i along the axis, q_i N's at i,
// i < 3. The fit reads three voxels a side and the tent writes two, so a
// voxel lies on one line of a pass alone -- B's t 0..2 on the face to B's
// -axis block, its t 5..7 on this one -- and each lane reads its line before
// it writes it: in place is the snapshot the filter is defined on. The face
// is fitted only when B and N are both fully observed -- B by its own mask,
// N by its flag (deblock_flags.comp) -- so every sample is observed and a
// masked block is never written. The next axis is the next dispatch, after
// the batch's barrier.

#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "deblock_common.glsl"
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/volume/shaders/block_neighbourhood.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = kLanes) in;

shared uint s_wrote_self;
shared uint s_wrote_next;

// The line voxel of lane (u, w) at coordinate t along the axis, in B's frame
// (t 8..10 lie in N).
ivec3 line_voxel(int t, int u, int w) {
  if (pc.axis == 0u) return ivec3(t, u, w);
  if (pc.axis == 1u) return ivec3(u, t, w);
  return ivec3(u, w, t);
}

void main() {
  uint lane = gl_LocalInvocationIndex;
  uint entry = pc.item_base + gl_WorkGroupID.x;
  // Uniform across the workgroup: a masked B fits no face.
  if (entry >= pc.num_blocks || !vgridEntryFull(entry)) {
    return;
  }
  ivec3 coord = blocks[entry].coord;
  uint next = 1u << pc.axis;  // N's octant
  // Lane 0 finds B while lane `next` finds N.
  int self_ptr = lane == 0u ? vgridFindBlockPtr(coord, pc.num_buckets,
                                             pc.bucket_size, pc.max_chain)
                            : -1;
  vgridResolveOctants(coord, self_ptr, lane, 1u | (1u << next), pc.num_buckets,
                   pc.bucket_size, pc.max_chain);
  if (lane == 0u) {
    s_wrote_self = 0u;
    s_wrote_next = 0u;
  }
  barrier();
  // Uniform: shared values and flags no dispatch of this pass writes.
  if (s_neighbour[0] < 0 || s_neighbour[next] < 0 ||
      !vgridFull(s_neighbour[next])) {
    return;
  }

  int u = int(lane % kEdge);
  int w = int(lane / kEdge);
  // Every load at once.
  uint ps[3], qs[3];
  float p[3], q[3];
  bool saturated = false;
  for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
    vgridCornerStorage(int(kEdge), line_voxel(int(kEdge) - 1 - i, u, w), ps[i]);
    vgridCornerStorage(int(kEdge), line_voxel(int(kEdge) + i, u, w), qs[i]);
    p[i] = vgridNormalized(tsdf[ps[i]]);
    q[i] = vgridNormalized(tsdf[qs[i]]);
    saturated =
        saturated || abs(p[i]) >= pc.saturated || abs(q[i]) >= pc.saturated;
  }
  bool wrote_self = false;
  bool wrote_next = false;
  if (!saturated) {
    float delta = pc.c0 * (q[0] - p[0]) + pc.c1 * (q[1] - p[1]) +
                  pc.c2 * (q[2] - p[2]);
    delta = clamp(delta, -pc.line_clip, pc.line_clip);
    // The tent over n = 2 voxels a side: (n - i - 0.5) / (2n).
    const float tent[2] = float[2](0.375, 0.125);
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
      float d = delta * tent[i];
      if (d == 0.0) {
        continue;
      }
      float np = clamp(p[i] + d, -1.0, 1.0);
      if (floatBitsToUint(np) != floatBitsToUint(p[i])) {
        tsdf[ps[i]] = np * pc.trunc_dist;
        wrote_self = true;
      }
      float nq = clamp(q[i] - d, -1.0, 1.0);
      if (floatBitsToUint(nq) != floatBitsToUint(q[i])) {
        tsdf[qs[i]] = nq * pc.trunc_dist;
        wrote_next = true;
      }
    }
  }
  if (wrote_self) {
    atomicOr(s_wrote_self, 1u);
  }
  if (wrote_next) {
    atomicOr(s_wrote_next, 1u);
  }
  barrier();
  if (lane == 0u) {
    if (s_wrote_self != 0u) vgridStampChanged(s_neighbour[0]);
    if (s_wrote_next != 0u) vgridStampChanged(s_neighbour[next]);
  }
}
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/shaders/deblock_store.comp
```
#version 450

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

// The deblock's last dispatch (deblock.hpp): each block's shell, as the
// Gaussian left it in the shell snapshot, copied into tsdf once no
// workgroup reads it as halo any more. A kUnobserved entry -- an unobserved
// voxel, or one whose bits the Gaussian kept -- is skipped, and so is a masked
// block, whose shell the Gaussian did not write.

#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "deblock_common.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = kLanes) in;

shared int s_ptr;
shared uint s_wrote;

void main() {
  uint lane = gl_LocalInvocationIndex;
  uint entry = pc.item_base + gl_WorkGroupID.x;
  // Uniform across the workgroup: a masked block's shell was not written.
  if (entry >= pc.num_blocks || !vgridEntryFull(entry)) {
    return;
  }
  if (lane == 0u) {
    s_ptr = vgridFindBlockPtr(blocks[entry].coord, pc.num_buckets,
                           pc.bucket_size, pc.max_chain);
    s_wrote = 0u;
  }
  barrier();
  int ptr = s_ptr;
  if (ptr < 0) {
    return;
  }
  bool wrote = false;
  for (uint j = 0u; j < kBlockVoxels / kLanes; ++j) {
    uint l = lane + kLanes * j;
    uint si = vgridShellIndex(uvec3(l % kEdge, (l / kEdge) % kEdge,
                                 l / (kEdge * kEdge)));
    if (si == kShellVoxels) {
      continue;
    }
    float metres = shell[entry * kShellVoxels + si];
    if (vgridObserved(metres)) {
      tsdf[uint(ptr) + l] = metres;
      wrote = true;
    }
  }
  if (wrote) {
    atomicOr(s_wrote, 1u);
  }
  barrier();
  if (lane == 0u && s_wrote != 0u) {
    vgridStampChanged(ptr);
  }
}

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/shaders/encode_results.comp
```
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

// The encoder's front-half results (DeviceFrameWriter::record_count): one
// workgroup, last in the front's batch, that gathers what the host builds the
// frame's tables and refusals from into the front's results slot as one
// struct -- the transform's reject counts, what check_entries refuses, the
// frame words, the step layout's totals, then every model's symbol counts --
// so nothing is read back per buffer. Whole fields only: the host reads every
// byte of the struct and of the counts.

#version 450
#extension GL_EXT_scalar_block_layout : require

layout(local_size_x = 256) in;

layout(push_constant, std430) uniform Push {
  uint count_words;    // the symbol counts' words
  uint has_transform;  // 0: the transform's words are not bound, read 0
}
pc;

layout(set = 0, binding = 0, std430) readonly buffer ObservedCounts {
  uint observed_rejected;  // DctTransform's observed pass
  uint observed;
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 1, std430) readonly buffer Rejected {
  uint forward_rejected;  // DctTransform's forward
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 2, std430) readonly buffer Refusal {
  uint largest_mode;
  uint out_of_range;
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 3, std430) readonly buffer FrameWords {
  uint surplus;
  uint blocks;
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 4, std430) readonly buffer Totals {
  uint step_total;
  uint slot_total;
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 5, std430) readonly buffer Counts {
  uint counts[];
};

// Mirrors detail::FrontResults (device_frame_writer.hpp).
struct FrontResults {
  uint observed_rejected;
  uint forward_rejected;
  uint largest_mode;
  uint out_of_range;
  uint surplus;
  uint blocks;
  uint step_total;
  uint slot_total;
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 6, scalar) writeonly buffer Result {
  FrontResults result;
  uint result_counts[];
};

void main() {
  const uint lane = gl_LocalInvocationID.x;
  if (lane == 0u) {
    const bool t = pc.has_transform != 0u;
    result = FrontResults(t ? observed_rejected : 0u,
                          t ? forward_rejected : 0u, largest_mode,
                          out_of_range, surplus, blocks, step_total,
                          slot_total);
  }
  for (uint i = lane; i < pc.count_words; i += gl_WorkGroupSize.x) {
    result_counts[i] = counts[i];
  }
}

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/shaders/frame_gate.comp
```
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

// The decoder's gate (FrameGate::record_gate): one invocation that judges a
// recorded frame on the device before the grid changes, so no verdict
// reaches the host first. A decode's frame passes rows 11 to 13 -- no
// segment failed, a P-frame's survivors are its N less its new blocks, and
// no new block sits on a reference block; a rebuild's grid holds exactly the
// frame's blocks. The gate word it writes gates every later grid write of the
// batch: the removal's and the allocation's rounds close it on their own
// failures, and the apply, the inverse, the deblock and an extract run no
// groups behind a closed one.

#version 450

layout(local_size_x = 1) in;

layout(set = 0, binding = 0) readonly buffer Verdict {
  uint failed;  // the first failing segment, s << 2 | kind
  uint survivors;
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 1) readonly buffer Collision {
  uint collision_q;  // the first new block on a reference entry
  uint collision_e;
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 2) readonly buffer DiffCounts {
  uint gone;
  uint missing;
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 3) writeonly buffer Gate { uint gate; };

// detail::kNoVerdict and detail::kNoSource.
const uint kNoVerdict = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
const uint kNoSource = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

layout(push_constant) uniform Push {
  uint rebuild;    // 1 judges a rebuild's grid, 0 a decode's frame
  uint inter;      // a P-frame
  uint blocks;     // N
  uint new_count;  // A
}
pc;

void main() {
  bool open;
  if (pc.rebuild != 0u) {
    open = gone == 0u && missing == 0u;
  } else {
    open = failed == kNoVerdict &&
           (pc.inter == 0u || survivors + pc.new_count == pc.blocks) &&
           collision_q == kNoSource;
  }
  gate = open ? 1u : 0u;
}
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/shaders/frame_grammar.glsl
```
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

// A block's symbols in the v3 frame: what a writer emits, and how a reader
// takes them back. The one text a frame is coded with: the kernels include it
// as GLSL, and the tests' CPU oracle (tests/codec_oracle.cpp) includes each
// half inside a struct, after defining `uint`, `ivec3`, `uvec2` and `findMSB`,
// so on the host the same lines compile as C++ member functions.
//
// Inside a segment each block is, in order: its coordinate (the segment's
// first in full, the rest as deltas from the block before), then its
// payload: its mask class (and a partial mask, a plane and a line at a
// time), then its K coefficients. Every integer is a class -- its bit length
// -- through its model's table, then one raw field of the bits below its
// leading one, and below those its sign.
//
// A P-frame's update segment holds reference entries instead, in reference
// order and with no coordinate: each its mode symbol, then a payload for
// keep and zero alone, which the caller makes and applies (bitstream.hpp
// says what each carries): the grammar never sees the reference.
//
// The includer picks a half with VGRID_FRAME_WRITER or VGRID_FRAME_READER, and
// defines what it calls: a writer, sink_symbol, sink_bits (a raw field of 1
// to 32 bits) and coefficient(j); a reader, get, get_bits, coder_failed and
// store_coefficient. Both work on the block's mask in g_mask, and a reader
// leaves the block's coordinate in g_coord, which holds the block before's
// when it starts.
//
// Written in what GLSL and C++ mean alike: unsigned arithmetic wherever a
// value can wrap (a signed overflow is undefined in C++), one coder call a
// statement (C++ leaves argument order unspecified), no out parameters, and
// no built-in but findMSB. No include guard: the oracle includes it once for
// each half.

#ifndef __cplusplus
#include "frame_models.glsl"

uint g_mask[kMaskWords];
#ifdef VGRID_FRAME_WRITER
void sink_symbol(uint model, uint symbol);
void sink_bits(uint value, uint bits);
int coefficient(uint j);
#endif
#ifdef VGRID_FRAME_READER
ivec3 g_coord;
uint get(uint model);
uint get_bits(uint bits);
bool coder_failed();
void store_coefficient(uint j, int value);
#endif
#endif

uint bit_length(uint v) { return uint(findMSB(v) + 1); }

uint mask_line(uint l) { return (g_mask[l / 4u] >> (8u * (l % 4u))) & 0xFFu; }

// Which of the three line models a predictor selects.
uint line_context(uint predictor) {
  return predictor == 0x00u ? 0u : predictor == 0xFFu ? 1u : 2u;
}

// A line's predictor: the line before it in its plane, else the same line of
// the plane before, else (the first line of the block) unobserved.
uint line_predictor(uint z, uint y) {
  if (y > 0u) return mask_line(kLinesPerPlane * z + y - 1u);
  return z > 0u ? mask_line(kLinesPerPlane * (z - 1u)) : 0x00u;
}

#ifdef VGRID_FRAME_WRITER

void emit_unsigned(uint model, uint u) {
  const uint c = bit_length(u);
  sink_symbol(model, c);
  if (c > 1u) sink_bits(u - (1u << (c - 1u)), c - 1u);
}

// The sign is the low bit of one raw field of c bits, above it the c - 1 below
// the leading one, so a value of class c <= 12 costs one coder step rather
// than two. c is at most 32 (a step across all of int32), so the field fits.
void emit_signed(uint model, uint magnitude, bool negative) {
  const uint c = bit_length(magnitude);
  sink_symbol(model, c);
  if (c > 0u) {
    const uint below = magnitude - (1u << (c - 1u));
    sink_bits((below << 1u) | (negative ? 1u : 0u), c);
  }
}

// The signed step from a to b, which the sort keeps within 2^32 - 1.
void emit_step(uint model, int a, int b) {
  const bool negative = b < a;
  emit_signed(model, negative ? uint(a) - uint(b) : uint(b) - uint(a),
              negative);
}

// What plane z is against the plane before it (unobserved before the first),
// and so whether its lines follow.
uint plane_symbol(uint z) {
  bool same = true;
  bool empty = true;
  bool full = true;
  for (uint y = 0u; y < kLinesPerPlane; ++y) {
    const uint line = mask_line(kLinesPerPlane * z + y);
    same = same && line == (z > 0u ? mask_line(kLinesPerPlane * (z - 1u) + y)
                                   : 0x00u);
    empty = empty && line == 0x00u;
    full = full && line == 0xFFu;
  }
  return same ? kSame : empty ? kAllEmpty : full ? kAllFull : kOther;
}

void emit_partial_mask() {
  for (uint z = 0u; z < kPlanes; ++z) {
    const uint plane = plane_symbol(z);
    sink_symbol(kPlane, plane);
    if (plane != kOther) continue;
    for (uint y = 0u; y < kLinesPerPlane; ++y) {
      const uint line = mask_line(kLinesPerPlane * z + y);
      const uint predictor = line_predictor(z, y);
      const uint context = line_context(predictor);
      const uint s = line == predictor ? kSame
                     : line == 0x00u   ? kAllEmpty
                     : line == 0xFFu   ? kAllFull
                                       : kOther;
      sink_symbol(kLine + context, s);
      if (s == kOther) sink_symbol(kByte + context, line);
    }
  }
}

// Block cur's coordinate, after prev unless it is its segment's first.
void emit_coord(bool first, ivec3 prev, ivec3 cur) {
  if (first) {
    // A segment's first block, in full: the segment decodes on its own.
    sink_bits(uint(cur.x), 32u);
    sink_bits(uint(cur.y), 32u);
    sink_bits(uint(cur.z), 32u);
  } else {
    const uint dz = uint(cur.z) - uint(prev.z);  // the sort keeps z rising
    emit_unsigned(kDz, dz);
    if (dz == 0u) {
      const uint dy = uint(cur.y) - uint(prev.y);  // and y within a z slice
      emit_unsigned(kDySame, dy);
      if (dy == 0u) {
        // And x along a row: a step of at least 1.
        emit_unsigned(kDxRun, uint(cur.x) - uint(prev.x) - 1u);
      } else {
        emit_step(kDxFree, prev.x, cur.x);
      }
    } else {
      emit_step(kDyFree, prev.y, cur.y);
      emit_step(kDxFree, prev.x, cur.x);
    }
  }
}

// A payload: the mask g_mask and K coefficients.
void emit_payload(uint k) {
  bool full = true;
  bool none = true;
  for (uint w = 0u; w < kMaskWords; ++w) {
    full = full && g_mask[w] == ~0u;
    none = none && g_mask[w] == 0u;
  }
  const uint mask_class = full ? kMaskFull : none ? kMaskEmpty : kMaskPartial;
  sink_symbol(kMaskClass, mask_class);
  if (mask_class == kMaskPartial) emit_partial_mask();

  for (uint j = 0u; j < k; ++j) {
    const int v = coefficient(j);
    emit_signed(kFirstCoef + j, v < 0 ? 0u - uint(v) : uint(v), v < 0);
  }
}

// Block cur, after prev unless it is its segment's first, of mask g_mask and
// K coefficients: an intra frame's block, and a P-frame's new block.
void emit_block(bool first, ivec3 prev, ivec3 cur, uint k) {
  emit_coord(first, prev, cur);
  emit_payload(k);
}

// A P-frame's reference entry of mode `mode` (below kModeSymbols, never
// motion): the mode, then for keep and zero the payload.
void emit_entry(uint mode, uint k) {
  sink_symbol(mode_model(k), mode);
  if (mode == kModeKeep || mode == kModeZero) emit_payload(k);
}

#endif  // VGRID_FRAME_WRITER

#ifdef VGRID_FRAME_READER

uint get_unsigned(uint model) {
  const uint c = get(model);
  if (c <= 1u) return c;
  return (1u << (c - 1u)) + get_bits(c - 1u);
}

// A signed value as its magnitude, at most 2^32 - 1, and 1 if negative.
uvec2 get_signed(uint model) {
  const uint c = get(model);
  if (c == 0u) return uvec2(0u, 0u);
  const uint field = get_bits(c);
  return uvec2((1u << (c - 1u)) + (field >> 1u), field & 1u);
}

// Whether a coordinate stepped by a signed delta stays within int32, and where
// it lands.
bool step_fits(int from, uvec2 delta) {
  return delta.x <= (delta.y != 0u ? uint(from) - 0x80000000u
                                   : 0x7FFFFFFFu - uint(from));
}
int stepped(int from, uvec2 delta) {
  return int(delta.y != 0u ? uint(from) - delta.x : uint(from) + delta.x);
}

void read_partial_mask() {
  for (uint w = 0u; w < kMaskWords; ++w) g_mask[w] = 0u;
  for (uint z = 0u; z < kPlanes; ++z) {
    const uint plane = get(kPlane);
    for (uint y = 0u; y < kLinesPerPlane; ++y) {
      uint line = 0u;
      if (plane == kOther) {
        const uint predictor = line_predictor(z, y);
        const uint context = line_context(predictor);
        const uint s = get(kLine + context);
        line = s == kSame       ? predictor
               : s == kAllEmpty ? 0x00u
               : s == kAllFull  ? 0xFFu
                                : get(kByte + context);
      } else if (plane == kSame) {
        line = z > 0u ? mask_line(kLinesPerPlane * (z - 1u) + y) : 0x00u;
      } else {
        line = plane == kAllFull ? 0xFFu : 0x00u;
      }
      const uint l = kLinesPerPlane * z + y;
      g_mask[l / 4u] |= line << (8u * (l % 4u));
    }
  }
}

// The coordinate after g_coord, unless it is its segment's first, into
// g_coord. False for one outside int32; the coder's own failure carries
// everything else, including a failure partway through the deltas, whose
// zeros would otherwise decode as a run step and could be misreported as
// leaving int32.
bool read_coord(bool first) {
  if (first) {
    g_coord.x = int(get_bits(32u));
    g_coord.y = int(get_bits(32u));
    g_coord.z = int(get_bits(32u));
  } else {
    const uvec2 dz = uvec2(get_unsigned(kDz), 0u);
    uvec2 dy = uvec2(0u, 0u);
    uvec2 dx = uvec2(0u, 0u);
    bool run_past = false;  // a run step of 2^32
    if (dz.x == 0u) {
      dy.x = get_unsigned(kDySame);
      if (dy.x == 0u) {
        const uint run = get_unsigned(kDxRun);
        run_past = run == 0xFFFFFFFFu;
        dx.x = run + 1u;
      } else {
        dx = get_signed(kDxFree);
      }
    } else {
      dy = get_signed(kDyFree);
      dx = get_signed(kDxFree);
    }
    if (coder_failed()) return true;  // the segment's end check reports it
    if (run_past || !step_fits(g_coord.x, dx) || !step_fits(g_coord.y, dy) ||
        !step_fits(g_coord.z, dz)) {
      return false;
    }
    g_coord = ivec3(stepped(g_coord.x, dx), stepped(g_coord.y, dy),
                    stepped(g_coord.z, dz));
  }
  return true;
}

// A payload, into g_mask and its K coefficients.
void read_payload(uint k) {
  // TODO(codec): refuse a partial mask that decodes all-full or all-empty,
  // and the mask code's other second spellings: a plane coded line by line
  // that one plane symbol names, a line coded as the byte another line
  // symbol names. The writer makes none of them and each decodes correctly,
  // so each is a second spelling of one frame rather than a wrong one (the
  // 2026-09-27 and 2026-10-01 entries).
  const uint mask_class = get(kMaskClass);
  if (mask_class == kMaskPartial) {
    read_partial_mask();
  } else {
    for (uint w = 0u; w < kMaskWords; ++w) {
      g_mask[w] = mask_class == kMaskFull ? ~0u : 0u;
    }
  }

  for (uint j = 0u; j < k; ++j) {
    // Class < 16, so the magnitude is at most 32767: every coefficient is in
    // range.
    const uvec2 v = get_signed(kFirstCoef + j);
    store_coefficient(j, v.y != 0u ? -int(v.x) : int(v.x));
  }
}

// The block after g_coord, unless it is its segment's first, into g_coord,
// g_mask and its K coefficients. False for a coordinate outside int32.
bool read_block(bool first, uint k) {
  if (!read_coord(first)) return false;
  read_payload(k);
  return true;
}

// A P-frame's reference entry: its mode, and for keep and zero its payload
// into g_mask and its K coefficients.
uint read_entry(uint k) {
  const uint mode = get(mode_model(k));
  if (mode == kModeKeep || mode == kModeZero) read_payload(k);
  return mode;
}

#endif  // VGRID_FRAME_READER
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/shaders/frame_merge.comp
```
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

// A decoded frame's blocks in frame order and where each comes from
// (block_lists.hpp): the reference's surviving entries merged with the
// frame's new blocks, an entry an invocation, each placed by counting what
// sorts before it. With no ties -- a tie is row 13's refusal, below -- a
// block's place is the survivors below it plus the new blocks below it:
//   reference entry e that survives: ranks[e] + lower_bound(new, ref[e]),
//     its sources {e, e} for keep, {e, none} for skip, {none, e} for zero;
//   new block q: q + ranks[lower_bound(ref, new[q])], sources {none, M + q}.
// An intra frame is M = 0, its positions q. Row 13 is a new block on a
// reference block, whatever that entry's mode: the smallest such q and e,
// which on a frame rows 11 and 12 passed are one pair, the first a walk in
// frame order meets. Writes stop at position N, so a corrupt frame, refused
// before anything reads these, writes nowhere else.

#version 450
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#extension GL_EXT_scalar_block_layout : require

#define VGRID_HASH_COMMON_NO_PUSH_CONSTANTS
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/volume/shaders/hash_common.glsl"
#include "volumetric_kit/grid/volume/shaders/coord_order.glsl"

#include "block_lists_push.glsl"
#include "frame_models.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = 256) in;

// Mirrors kNoSource and ApplySource in bitstream.hpp.
const uint kNoSource = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
struct ApplySource {
  uint reference;
  uint payload;
};

layout(set = 0, binding = 0, scalar) readonly buffer Reference {
  BlockIndex reference[];  // M, strictly increasing
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 1, scalar) readonly buffer Added {
  BlockIndex added[];  // A, strictly increasing once row 11 passes
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 2, std430) readonly buffer Modes {
  uint modes[];  // M
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 3, std430) readonly buffer Ranks {
  uint ranks[];  // M + 1: the survivors before each entry
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 4, scalar) writeonly buffer Frame {
  BlockIndex frame[];  // N, ptr 0
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 5, scalar) writeonly buffer Sources {
  ApplySource sources[];  // N
};
layout(set = 0, binding = 6, std430) buffer Collision {
  uint collision_q;  // the first new block on a reference block, or ~0
  uint collision_e;  // and that reference entry
};

VGRID_COORD_SEARCH(in_reference, reference)
VGRID_COORD_SEARCH(in_added, added)

void main() {
  const uint t = pc.item_base + gl_GlobalInvocationID.x;
  const uint m = pc.reference_count;
  if (t >= pc.count) return;
  if (t < m) {
    const uint mode = modes[t];
    if (mode != kModeKeep && mode != kModeSkip && mode != kModeZero) return;
    const ivec3 c = reference[t].coord;
    const uint at = ranks[t] + in_added_lower(c, 0u, pc.new_count);
    if (at >= pc.block_count) return;
    frame[at].coord = c;
    frame[at].ptr = 0;
    sources[at] = ApplySource(mode != kModeZero ? t : kNoSource,
                              mode != kModeSkip ? t : kNoSource);
    return;
  }
  const uint q = t - m;
  const ivec3 c = added[q].coord;
  const uint e = in_reference_lower(c, 0u, m);
  if (e < m && reference[e].coord == c) {
    atomicMin(collision_q, q);
    atomicMin(collision_e, e);
  }
  const uint at = q + ranks[e];
  if (at >= pc.block_count) return;
  frame[at].coord = c;
  frame[at].ptr = 0;
  sources[at] = ApplySource(kNoSource, t);
}
```

### src/volumetric_kit/grid/codec/shaders/frame_models.glsl
```
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Tao Jin

// The v3 frame's symbol models -- one frequency table each, in this order in
// TABLES -- with each model's alphabet and its first entry in the per-symbol
// arrays (the device's counts and tables), the symbols a block's mask is
// coded with, a P-frame's reference-entry modes, and where each segment's
// entries sit. The one definition: the kernels include it as GLSL, and
// bitstream.cpp and the tests' CPU oracle as C++ (see frame_grammar.glsl), so
// it is written in what the two languages share.

#ifndef VGRID_FRAME_MODELS_GLSL
#define VGRID_FRAME_MODELS_GLSL

// The coordinate models are split by what the sort already guarantees about
// the delta: after a block in the same (y, z) row the x step is at least 1
// (kDxRun codes step - 1, so a run is a stream of zeros), within the same z
// slice the y step is non-negative (kDySame), and after a step in z the other
// two are free to go either way.
//
// A partial mask is coded a z plane at a time, and a plane a line (one byte,
// eight voxels along x) at a time, each against the one before it: a fused
// band's mask edge is a smooth surface, so most planes and lines repeat their
// neighbour or are all one value. On room0 that is 2.2 bytes a block where
// the 64 raw bytes through one table were 8.3 (the 2026-10-01 entry).
const uint kDz = 0u;         // unsigned: z step
const uint kDySame = 1u;     // unsigned: y step, z unchanged
const uint kDyFree = 2u;     // signed:   y step after a z step
const uint kDxRun = 3u;      // unsigned: x step - 1, y and z unchanged
const uint kDxFree = 4u;     // signed:   x step after a y or z step
const uint kMaskClass = 5u;  // 0 all observed, 1 none observed, 2 partial
const uint kPlane = 6u;      // a partial mask's plane: same, empty, full, lines
const uint kLine = 7u;       // then its lines, three models by predictor
const uint kByte = kLine + 3u;       // then a line's byte, by the same three
const uint kFirstCoef = kByte + 3u;  // then one model per coefficient j < K
// and, in a P-frame only, the mode model (mode_model, below).

// A class is a bit length: 0 for zero, else 1 + floor(log2 |v|). Coordinate
// deltas reach 2^32 - 1 (INT32_MIN to INT32_MAX), so 33 classes; quantized
// coefficients are within +-32767 < 2^15, so 16.
const uint kCoordClasses = 33u;
const uint kMaskClasses = 3u;
const uint kRunClasses = 4u;  // a plane's or a line's symbols, below
const uint kByteSymbols = 256u;
const uint kCoefClasses = 16u;

// A mask class.
const uint kMaskFull = 0u;
const uint kMaskEmpty = 1u;
const uint kMaskPartial = 2u;
// A plane or a line: the same as its predictor, all unobserved, all observed,
// or neither -- a plane then coded line by line, a line by its byte. The
// writer tries them in this order, so a value two of them name is written as
// the first.
const uint kSame = 0u;
const uint kAllEmpty = 1u;
const uint kAllFull = 2u;
const uint kOther = 3u;

// A block's observed mask: 512 voxels, 32 a word, line l = y + 8 z (eight
// voxels along x) its byte l % 4 of word l / 4.
const uint kMaskWords = 16u;
const uint kLinesPerPlane = 8u;  // y
const uint kPlanes = 8u;         // z

// The frame types (header byte 6) that change the models.
const uint kFrameIntra = 0u;
const uint kFrameInter = 1u;

// A P-frame's mode for each entry of its reference (bitstream.hpp gives what
// each carries): one symbol of the mode model, which has no context. Motion
// is reserved: a frame whose mode table gives it a frequency is refused.
const uint kModeKeep = 0u;
const uint kModeSkip = 1u;
const uint kModeZero = 2u;
const uint kModeRemove = 3u;
const uint kModeMotion = 4u;
const uint kModeSymbols = 5u;

uint mode_model(uint k) { return kFirstCoef + k; }

// How many models a frame of type `type` keeping k coefficients has.
uint model_count(uint type, uint k) {
  return kFirstCoef + k + (type == kFrameInter ? 1u : 0u);
}

uint model_alphabet(uint model, uint k) {
  if (model < kMaskClass) return kCoordClasses;
  if (model < kPlane) return kMaskClasses;
  if (model < kByte) return kRunClasses;
  if (model < kFirstCoef) return kByteSymbols;
  if (model < mode_model(k)) return kCoefClasses;
  return kModeSymbols;
}

// The first entry of each run of models with one alphabet.
const uint kMaskClassBase = kCoordClasses * kMaskClass;
const uint kPlaneBase = kMaskClassBase + kMaskClasses;
const uint kByteBase = kPlaneBase + kRunClasses * (kByte - kPlane);
const uint kFirstCoefBase = kByteBase + kByteSymbols * (kFirstCoef - kByte);

// The sum of every earlier model's alphabet; for one past the last model, the
// whole array's size. The mode model starts where coefficient table K would.
uint model_base(uint model, uint k) {
  if (model < kMaskClass) return kCoordClasses * model;
  if (model < kPlane) return kMaskClassBase;
  if (model < kByte) return kPlaneBase + kRunClasses * (model - kPlane);
  if (model < kFirstCoef) return kByteBase + kByteSymbols * (model - kByte);
  if (model <= mode_model(k)) {
    return kFirstCoefBase + kCoefClasses * (model - kFirstCoef);
  }
  return kFirstCoefBase + kCoefClasses * k + kModeSymbols;
}

// The stream positions [x, y) segment s covers. A P-frame's m reference
// entries come first, u to an update segment, entry e at position e; then
// its a new blocks, r to a segment, new block q at position m + q. An intra
// frame is the case m = 0. Within u32, since a frame's m + a is.
uvec2 segment_range(uint s, uint m, uint u, uint a, uint r) {
  const uint updates = m == 0u ? 0u : (m - 1u) / u + 1u;
  if (s < updates) {
    const uint first = s * u;
    return uvec2(first, m - first > u ? first + u : m);
  }
  const uint first = (s - updates) * r;
  return uvec2(m + first, m + (a - first > r ? first + r : a));
}

// The segment stream position p falls in, of the same frame.
uint segment_of(uint p, uint m, uint u, uint r) {
  if (p < m) return p / u;
  const uint updates = m == 0u ? 0u : (m - 1u) / u + 1u;
  return updates + (p - m) / r;
}

#endif  // VGRID_FRAME_MODELS_GLSL
```
